plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-process-kit

[![CI](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-process-kit)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-process-kit)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-process-kit)](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/LICENSE)

通过工程化提升产出质量的多角色+多Agent并行开发插件

## 简介

为 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 增加一套文件驱动的工程化开发流程。需求包的状态、门禁签署、流程与 bug 记录都写在目标仓库的 `docs/process/**` 里；插件只做读取、渲染、安全追加和脚手架落地，不另外保存状态。

同时内置 9 个角色 subagent，彼此有硬边界：写实现的不写测试，写测试的不做验收；产品与架构的借鉴调研在 Gate0 前**按需**并行，候选只进核对件、不直接进 AC。

## 和同类插件的差别

生态里已有 20 多个近亲（4674 条精选清单里逐个粗筛过），最容易混淆的是这三类：

| 你见过的做法 | 它的判据 | 我们的做法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 规格驱动（spec-kit / OpenSpec / BMAD …） | 靠 LLM 自查「规格写完了没」，或明写**不做硬门禁** | 状态机 + **人签 Gate**：阶段推进权在**人手**上，且**从需求到交付的纠偏不可跳过**（实现过程本身不需要人参与） |
| 角色编排（dsh-crew / dsh-swarm / dsh-expert-team …） | 用**代码强制**角色写权（权限矩阵 / 宿主中间件 / preset） | 角色是**提示词层面**的分工（管效率），**交付质量由 Gate 的人裁承担** —— 刻意不做实时拦截，理由见 [DESIGN](./docs/DESIGN.md) |
| 自动质量门（review-gate / lunheng …） | 机器 verdict 直接放行或阻断 | 机器只判**客观可判**的那半（几何 / 台账 / 落点 / 证据完整性），主观的**留给人裁**；机器侧证据进 `📎` 供抽查 |

三条不可替代的东西：**状态入仓**（`docs/process/**` 是唯一真源，[CI 不装插件也能消费](./docs/CONTRACT.md)）、**防篡改 journal**（链式指纹，读取侧重算并如实报红）、**两段式 Gate 摘要**（✅ 完成了什么 / ❓ 还需要裁定什么）。


## 特性

- **文件状态机**：进度存在 `docs/process/**` 的 frontmatter 中。每轮唤醒调用 `process_status` 即可恢复上下文，不依赖聊天记录。
- **Gate 门禁**：只在 Gate0/1/2/4 (需求核对，设计，开发，验收环节) 停下进行确认，每次输出两段式摘要（✅ 已完成 / ❓ 待裁定）。
- **角色分离**：角色技能随插件注册，项目内 `.dsh/skills/**` 的同名技能可覆盖。
- **需求借鉴调研（按需）**：用户说不清目的时，Gate0 前并行派 `product-manager` + `architect` 查 GitHub / 公开文档，把隐性需求 / 技术约束变成核对件的候选 `Q`；**并行必须汇合**，候选不直接进 AC，fast 路径不做，**不默认对所有 full 包做**。
- **零依赖**：不导入插件外库，无构建步骤。
- **只增不改**：`process_init` 默认只创建、不覆盖；已有仓库用 `process_init(upgrade: true)` 升级 —— 框架自有文件覆盖前先备份，`PROJECT.md` 与令牌类项目可定制文件永不覆盖、只报告差异。

## 安装

| 方式 | target | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| npm（推荐） | `dsh-process-kit` | 从官方 npm 仓库安装，升级只需改版本号（**npm 上最新 `0.5.0`；本工作区 `0.6.0` 未提交 / 未发布**） |
| GitHub | `github:SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit` | 免 npm；锁版本用 `#<tag>` 或 `#<commit>` |
| 本地目录 | 绝对路径，如 `/Users/<you>/dsh-plugins/dsh-process-kit` | 需要改插件源码时用，先 clone 到本地 |

安装后建议重启客户端，一般情况下无需重启

> **装不到最新版？先看这条：不是安装故障。** pnpm（11/12）默认带 24 小时供应链保护 —— `minimumReleaseAge = 1440` 分钟：**发布不满 24 小时的版本，不会被 `^范围` / `latest` 解析选中**，于是刚发的新版看起来「装不上」，实际装到的是上一个版本。三种解法：
>
> - **等**：满 24 小时后自然解析到新版；
> - **钉版本**（立即生效，显式钉版本按设计绕开该策略）：装 `dsh-process-kit@0.4.0` 这样的确切版本；
> - **加排除**：在 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里补
>   ```yaml
>   minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
>     - dsh-process-kit@0.4.0
>   ```
>   不建议直接写 `minimumReleaseAge: 0` —— 那等于把这道保护整体关掉。

## 快速开始

```text
1. 安装插件（安装即生效，无需重启）。
2. 告诉ai想做什么，比如想做一个网站，做一个app等等
3. ai自动初始化当前环境(插件需要的记录) `process_init`
4. 开始按照流程进行开发工作
5. 第一个包建议走快速路径试水：需求核对件写 `flow: fast`，人签 Gate0 后直接派 dev + 存量回归；确认这套流程在你的项目里顺手，再上全流程
```

`process_init` 生成的内容：

- `docs/process/` — `README.md`（流程总纲）、`orchestrator.md`（调度手册）、`PROJECT.md`（项目适配）、PRD 与核对件模板、`tools/README.md`
- `scripts/process/` — `journal-append.mjs`、`check-artifact-paths.mjs`、`check-rules.mjs`、`check-ui-geometry.mjs`、`sync-prd-version.mjs`
- `AGENTS.md` — 仅在不存在时创建；已存在则不改写，只输出待合并段落。传 `agents: false` 可跳过。

### 实例项目（独立仓库）

[dsh-process-kit-example](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit-example) —— 在一个**全新空仓库**里，从一句「做一个电商 app」跑到交付的端到端实例：交付成果、流程产物与 journal 证据都留在那个仓库里，不在本仓库内。

跑法与核验收的检查单见 [docs/ACCEPTANCE.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)（含可直接照抄的开跑步骤，以及一段**不装插件**就能复算 journal 链式指纹的核验脚本）。

> 仓库已建，内容由首次端到端验收跑产出。

### 升级已有仓库

```js
process_init({ upgrade: true, dryRun: true })   // 先看会动哪些文件
process_init({ upgrade: true })                 // 再落地
```

| 文件 | 升级行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 框架自有：`README.md`（总纲）、`orchestrator.md`、四份模板、`tools/README.md`、`scripts/process/*.mjs` | 内容有变才覆盖，旧版备份为 `<文件>.bak-<时间戳>` |
| 项目可定制：`PROJECT.md`、`ui/tokens.md`、`ui/recipe.md` | **永不覆盖**，只列入「需人工比对」并给出包内模板路径 |
| 数据：`input/**`、`prd/<ID>*`、`bugs/**`、`reports/**` 等 | 从不触碰 |

`PROJECT.md` 的 `processVersion` 落后时，报告会提示对照包内模板手工合并。

## 工具

| 工具 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `process_status` | 扫描 `docs/process`，返回每个包的状态、Gate 四灯、journal 尾部、未关闭的 bug 与下一步动作 |
| `gate_summary` | 生成指定包的 Gate 两段式摘要骨架，依据自动填充，✅ / ❓ 留空待填 |
| `process_journal` | 安全追加 journal：锁 + 指纹校验 + 原子替换，时间取机器时间 |
| `process_init` | 将流程骨架与脚本初始化到当前仓库：默认只创建不覆盖；`upgrade: true` 升级已有仓库（框架自有文件覆盖前备份，项目文件永不覆盖） |

## 角色

角色由插件自带技能提供，安装即注册，无需配置。技能在所有工作区可用，与仓库是否已初始化流程无关；项目内 `.dsh/skills/**` 的同名技能优先级更高。设置环境变量 `PROCESS_KIT_SKILLS=off` 可关闭。

### 角色清单（9 个）

`0.1.0` 起可用 7 个，`0.2.0` 补上 `ui-designer`，`0.3.0` 给 `ui-designer` 固定工具优先级（PhotoCraft CLI > Adobe Photoshop > 其它）并把几何门禁的空转判据补硬；`0.4.0` 移除流程看板（改为纯服务端 bundle）、流程骨架按「单 session 单包」精简并把 Gate 送审件换成实物、给 `process_init` 加上 `upgrade` 升级路径；`0.5.0` 给三个评审角色写明触发条件（技能描述随之更新）、修正快速路径与 Gate0 的口径矛盾、补上 [docs/ADOPTION.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/ADOPTION.md)；`0.6.0` 新增 `architect`（第 9 个）：

| 角色 | 职责 | 自 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `product-manager` | PRD、接口契约、《设计与说明》；UAT 后做验收完备性审核；Gate0 前可做需求借鉴调研（`input/<ID>-prior-art.md`） | `0.1.0` |
| `architect` | Gate0 前与 pm 并行做**技术借鉴与约束扫描**（`input/<ID>-tech-scan.md`，只出约束 / 代价 / 许可证）；Gate0 后按需出**架构设计与取舍**（`prd/<ID>-arch.md`） | `0.6.0` |
| `test-agent` | 按 PRD 出验收测试（红），并独立复跑 verify（裁判运动员分离） | `0.1.0` |
| `dev-agent` | 按 PRD + 契约把测试实现到绿，只改源码、禁改测试 | `0.1.0` |
| `uat-agent` | 真机黑盒验收：只判「用起来对不对得上预期」 | `0.1.0` |
| `code-review-agent` | 源码 diff 的正确性 / 回归 / 边界 / 可维护性评审 | `0.1.0` |
| `security-review-agent` | 源码 diff 的鉴权 / 越权 / 注入 / 密钥 / 敏感数据评审 | `0.1.0` |
| `logic-review-agent` | 规则表与源码的对抗式逻辑评审：规则→分支映射、未覆盖分支、具体反例 | `0.1.0` |
| `ui-designer` | 把《设计与说明》里触及 UI 的条目翻译成**可验收的 UI 规格**（组件判定 `reuse`/`change`/`new` + 交互状态矩阵 + 用户可见文案定稿），并产出**原型位图**与几何。是否派单由人在 Gate0 用需求核对件的 `uiDesign: required / not-needed` 显式决定，纯后端包流程不变；产物随 Gate1 一并送审，不新增停点 | `0.2.0` |

> **发布状态**：`architect` 是 `0.6.0` 新增；npm 上的 `0.5.0` 仍是 8 个角色。本工作区 `0.6.0` **未提交 / 未发布**，要现在用就从 GitHub `main` 安装或等发布。

**`ui-designer` 的边界**（四条，都是实测出来的）：

- **只翻译不发明**。上游没写的一律不拍板，产出「未定口径」清单交人裁。实测给一个只有原始需求、没有 PRD 的包，它交回 8 条未定口径、并明确说明"没加某状态是为了避免发明"。
- **项目令牌优先**。`PROJECT.md` §4 配了「UI 项目令牌」就**必须照抄**项目自己的设计规范，不得自创配色/字号/间距，也不得混用通用默认。门禁 **⑩** 会抽出色板来验。
- **审美留给 Gate**。门禁只判**客观可判**的那部分（几何 + 渲染对比度 + 令牌一致性），好不好看一律交人。
- **工具优先级固定：PhotoCraft CLI > Adobe Photoshop > 其它**。首选 PhotoCraft 是因为「出图」与「导几何」同源于一份 `.psd`，命令可复现、`--verify` 走得通；**Photoshop 是真人设计师的交付路径**（原生 `.psd` 分层源直接可用），几何那一环自己接 —— 读不动时手工导出的证据**必须标注「未经重导验证」**，不许冒充门禁验证过。工具仍不绑定，三条不使用路径照旧合法。

### 三个评审角色什么时候会跑到

9 个角色**不是平权的**，分两档：

| 档 | 角色 | 什么时候被派 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **单包流程**（按需） | `product-manager` · `architect`（借鉴调研 / 有架构影响时）· `ui-designer`（`uiDesign: required` 时）· `test-agent` · `dev-agent` · `uat-agent` | 包从 Gate0 走到 Gate4 的过程中按状态机派 |
| **发布回归**（默认不在单包出现） | `code-review-agent` · `security-review-agent` · `logic-review-agent` | **只在「发布前整体回归」被派**，而该环节由人显式发起 |

也就是说：**没发起过发布回归，就等于这三个角色一次都没跑过。** 实测四个自用仓库的 **3 份**可读 journal（另有 1 份只剩 `.bak`，见 [ADOPTION](./docs/ADOPTION.md) §6）+ 实例端到端那一次的 **2 份**，全文扫描：这三个角色**零命中、零份报告** —— 不是它们没用，是**触发权在人手上**，而发布回归一直没被发起过。

两个例外会让它们提前上场：① 人在任一 Gate 上点名；② 包触及 RBAC / 金额·分摊 / schema / 新增对外接口，主控会在 Gate 摘要里给出「是否提前跑评审」这一条。

`process_status` 在仓库里有包 `done` 时会**如实报** `docs/process/reports/release/**` 有没有报告 —— **没有就是没跑**，不得当已覆盖。

> `architect` 是 `0.6.0` 新增的第 9 个角色：上面的历史 journal 统计里没有它的命中记录，**不要用旧数据判断它没被用过**。它的触发点是「Gate0 前按需调研 / 有架构影响」，不在发布回归三件套之列。

## 配置

需要配置的只有 `docs/process/PROJECT.md`。流程文档不硬编码任何具体项目的路径与命令，全部引用该文件，因此插件升级不会覆盖已填写的内容，切换项目也只需重填此文件。

七个小节：§1 端与目录、§2 命令槽、§3 产物属主表、§4 项目配置、§5 UAT 前置自检、§6 环境与凭据、§7 通知（已废弃，编号占位）。

**最小可用只填三节**：§1 + §2（至少「快速验证」与「journal 追加」两行）+ §3。§4 每个键都有默认值、可先用着；§5 / §6 等到要跑 UAT 再填；§7 整节写「不适用」。**§3 是硬门槛**：不填会让落点门禁直接 `exit 1`（刻意不静默放行），不属于"以后再配也行"的那类可选项。

模板中所有 `<...>` 均为占位符，会被脚本忽略，不会成为有效配置。详见 [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md)。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md) | PROJECT.md 七个小节、占位符规则、门禁脚本 |
| [docs/CONTRACT.md](https://github.com/SHADOW-LI0327/dsh-process-kit/blob/main/docs/CONTRACT.md) | 机器可消费

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer selector with a last-request fallback
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon

[![dsh.so risk](https://www.dsh.so/badge/dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon.svg)](https://www.dsh.so/artifact/dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon/)

English · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

![The DSH session list with a different brand logo before each title (Grok, GLM, Kimi, OpenAI, DeepSeek), one per session's selected model; the models are local demo routes](docs/overview.png)

![Sidebar rendering: same-vendor selections show one logo; aggregator routes show the provider logo with the model logo in the corner (light and dark theme)](docs/screenshot.png)

<!-- problem -->
In the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar every session row looks alike, so you cannot tell which provider and model a conversation uses without opening it. This plugin shows a provider + model icon in front of each session title, read from the model currently selected in the composer, and updates it the moment you switch. When the provider and the model come from different vendors (for example `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`), the provider logo carries a small model logo in its bottom-right corner.

**Install.** DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`, Node.js `>=22.19`.

```sh
# from npm — prebuilt, no build approval
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon

# or straight from source — builds locally, approve the build when dsh asks
dsh plugin --profile web add prgrmrwy/dsh-sidebar-session-provider-icon
```

Restart DSH and refresh the Web page. Nothing else is needed: no configuration, no network access, and no files written outside the DSH profile that installs it.

In the ohmydsh repository this plugin is wired through the `dsh.yaml` entry `sidebar-session-provider-icon` (`source: local`), so a source change there only needs `dsh build` and a restart. Current behavior is specified in [`openspec/specs/sidebar-session-provider-icon`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh/blob/main/openspec/specs/sidebar-session-provider-icon/spec.md); design history lives in the archived changes [`sidebar-session-provider-icon`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh/tree/main/openspec/changes/archive/2026-08-21-sidebar-session-provider-icon) and [`sidebar-provider-icon-composite-model-badge`](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/ohmydsh/tree/main/openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-10-sidebar-provider-icon-composite-model-badge).

## How it behaves

The logo shown for a session comes from three sources, in this order:

1. **Live selection (preferred, while verifiable).** The official `dsh-client-ui-model-selection` store, read as `ctx.modelDirectories.directoryFor(sessionId).store.current`. It is the single per-session state shared by the input-box selector and the `/model` command, and it publishes `{ provider, model }` as soon as `session.selectModel` succeeds. The open session, including a blank one that has not sent a message yet, therefore follows the input-box selection. That store belongs to a client Session scope, so every session-list and DOM signal re-resolves it: when the runtime hands out a new store for the same session (leaving the session and coming back is enough) the badge re-subscribes and re-reads it, and it re-reads the snapshot even when the identity did not change. An observation is kept only while its session is the open one; once the view moves on — or the directory cannot be resolved any more — it is dropped, so a value the client can no longer verify never decides a row.
2. **Selected model (durable).** The official `modelSelection` projection's `next`: the selection the session will use for its next request. The host maintains it and it also covers a model the user picked but has not sent with yet, which is what keeps a row right after you leave its session.
3. **Last request (cold-history fallback).** A Host `provider` session projection folds the `request/header` events of the session log, so a history session whose selector has not been loaded in this browser still shows the provider of its most recent real request. It survives restarts and uses no `localStorage`.

Brand resolution has two independent dimensions: the provider route picks the **main logo**, the model id picks the **corner logo**.

| Selection | Shown |
|---|---|
| `claude/claude-opus-5`, `codex/gpt-6-luna`, `deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro` (same vendor) | a single Anthropic / OpenAI / DeepSeek logo |
| `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash`, `opencode-go/qwen3.8-flash`, `opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code` | OpenCode, with DeepSeek / Qwen / Kimi in the corner |
| `traex/GPT-5.6-Sol[1m]`, `traex/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`, `traex/Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview` | Trae, with OpenAI / DeepSeek / Gemini in the corner |
| `traex/openrouter-3o[1m]`, `traex/Seed-2.1-Pro-0915` | Trae, with OpenRouter / ByteDance in the corner |
| known route + unrecognized model (e.g. `opencode-go/omen-alpha`) | the route logo only, no corner logo |
| unknown or generic route | a single logo from the model name; if that also fails, a neutral single-letter badge |

- **Route first.** `opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash` shows OpenCode as the main logo; DeepSeek can only appear in the corner.
- **No impersonation.** A model whose vendor cannot be identified gets no corner logo, and never a letter badge in the corner.
- **Size.** The composite keeps the 14×14 footprint of a single logo, so the row layout does not move. The corner logo is the bare 10px glyph, overhanging the bottom-right by 4px, with no plate, ring or padding: at this scale any decoration eats the pixels the glyph needs.
- **Tooltip.** Hovering always shows the exact `provider · model`.

| Layer | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Host | `src/provider.ts` registers the `provider` projection (it requires the `sessionProjections` service) and folds `request/header`; it only serves the cold-history fallback |
| Client data | `selection-binding.ts` observes the open session's store of `ctx.modelDirectories` (re-resolved per signal); `provider-map.ts` prefers a verifiable observation, then the official `modelSelection` selection, then the `provider` fallback |
| Client DOM | `row-locator.ts` holds all knowledge of the official row DOM: each row is identified by its official `data-row-key="session:<id>"` (the title reverse lookup remains only as the fallback for a runtime without it), so two sessions sharing a display title never receive each other's badge; a `MutationObserver` maintains a separate badge `<span>` in front of the title |
| Brand art | `src/client/assets/*.svg`, downloaded once and bundled; `logos.ts` resolves the provider brand and the model brand separately and renders the composite when they differ |

The badge content is derived only from `(provider, model)`; `index.ts` rebuilds a badge only when those values or the tooltip change.

## Configuration

None. The plugin row carries no `config` fields and the package reads no environment variables.

Recognized brands:

| Dimension | Brands |
|---|---|
| provider and model | DeepSeek, OpenAI/GPT/Codex, Anthropic/Claude, Grok/xAI, Kimi/Moonshot, GLM (Zhipu), MiniMax, Pi, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent (the misspelling `hermas` is also accepted), OpenCode, Qwen, Tencent Hunyuan (`hy3`, `hy4-*`), Meituan LongCat, Xiaomi MiMo, Gemini/Gemma, NVIDIA (Nemotron), Meta (Muse Spark, Llama), Ant Group (Ling/Ring), OpenRouter, ByteDance Seed |
| provider only | Trae (`trae`, `trae-ai`, `traex*`; exact name or prefix, never a substring) |

The model dimension covers every identifiable model family in the OpenCode Go / Zen catalogs, plus the GPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenRouter and ByteDance Seed families in the current TraeX catalog.

Brand art is pinned and vendored, never hand-drawn and never fetched from a CDN at runtime:

- every brand except OpenCode: `@lobehub/icons-static-svg@1.94.0`, MIT; the color variant is used where one exists;
- OpenCode: the official provider SVG from `anomalyco/opencode` at commit `5e75e5e9901f0d178f425bfb47f1bd46cbe78a59`, MIT.

Per-file source URLs and SHA-256 checksums are listed in [`src/client/assets/README.md`](src/client/assets/README.md). Some color SVGs carry gradient/clip ids; the corner instance suffixes them with `-sub` so copies on the same page never resolve each other's definitions.

# dsh-peak-hours

A run-window switch for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

It adds a control to the right of the composer's mode buttons that chooses between **running always** and
**running only in off-peak hours**. In the second mode every dsh task — including one that is already
running — is paused when a peak-price window starts and resumed automatically when it ends.

Available in **English** (this file) and **[中文](README.zh.md)**.

[![中文文档](https://img.shields.io/badge/%E4%B8%AD%E6%96%87%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3-README.zh.md-red)](README.zh.md)
[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blue)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)

## Run windows

Off-peak is the half-price window. Peak, in Beijing time (UTC+8), is:

| When | Phase |
| --- | --- |
| Monday–Friday, 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding Chinese statutory holidays | peak |
| Everything else — 00:00–09:00, 12:00–14:00, 18:00–24:00, all weekend, all statutory holidays | idle |

Make-up workdays (weekends that are worked to offset a holiday) stay **idle**: the rule only looks at the
weekday and whether the date is a statutory holiday.

## Install

From the dsh CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lion231226/dsh-peak-hours
```

The plugin is pure JavaScript with no build step and no runtime dependencies, so a source install is enough.

For a desktop profile that is currently running, this repository also ships `install.ps1`, which copies the
package into `%DSH_HOME%\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\` and maintains one managed row in the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml`. It validates the patch file with js-yaml before writing (a malformed patch file stops the
Loader from reconciling the whole profile), waits for the plugin to answer, and re-activates the entry with a
fresh row id if a previous attempt left it failed. No restart is required.

> **Do not mix the two install paths.** `dsh plugin add` registers the package as a profile bundle, and the
> bundle layer then contributes the patch row from the package's own `cordis.patch.yml`. `install.ps1` writes
> that row by hand instead; running it against a profile that already has the bundle would leave two entries
> with the same id, and nothing downstream de-duplicates them (the patch applier pushes inserted rows as-is and
> the cordis Loader has no duplicate check). The script now refuses to run in that case.

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Uninstall
```

## Using it

The button sits in the composer tool row, immediately to the right of the mode buttons (the permission and
plan selectors). It has three states:

| State | Label | Dot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Run always | 全天运行 / Run always | neutral |
| Off-peak only, currently idle | 空闲时段 · 运行中 / Off-peak · running | green |
| Off-peak only, currently peak | 空闲时段 · 已暂停 / Off-peak · paused | amber |

Clicking it opens a panel with the two modes, the current Beijing time, the next switch and a per-second
countdown, today's holiday (when there is one), a warning when the holiday calendar has no data for the year,
and a note while a clock override is active.

While a peak window is in force, a banner above the composer card states that submitted tasks will start
automatically at the end of the window, with a live countdown.

## How the pause works

The host half hooks two waterfalls and only acts in `idle-only` mode:

1. **`agent/pre-step`** — before every model call. An abort during the wait is re-thrown, which is the control
   flow the agent loop already expects (`signal.throwIfAborted()` follows the waterfall).
2. **`tools/pre-execute`** — before every tool body is dispatched, covering a step that runs into a peak
   window. On abort it returns the runtime's designed `{ kind: 'cancel' }` instead of throwing, because a
   throwing listener is classified as a scheduler failure and fails the whole step.

The gate releases immediately when the phase is idle, and while a peak window is in force it registers a
waiter and arms a single timer at the exact next transition instant — no polling, no busy loop. When the timer
fires, the phase is re-evaluated and every waiter is released, so the work continues on its own.

`llm/stream` is deliberately not gated: it returns an `AsyncIterable` rather than a promise, and the agent loop
has a call path that bypasses it, so the primary gate already covers every model call.

Nothing is lost while waiting: messages and tool calls stay in the session log, no model request is made, and
the wait is abortable (pressing stop cancels it).

## HTTP API

Registered on the host's loopback web server; no GUI token is required on loopback.

The mode is **per session**: every session carries its own choice, and a task is judged by the session that
owns it. A session with no explicit choice follows `default`.

| Method | Path | Body / result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/peak-hours/health` | `{ ok, plugin, version }` |
| GET | `/api/peak-hours/state?session=<id>` | the state envelope below; without `?session=` it reports `default` |
| POST | `/api/peak-hours/mode` | `{ "mode": "always" \| "idle-only" \| null, "session"?: "<id>", "scope"?: "session" \| "default" }` — `mode: null` with a session clears that override; neither field writes `default`. Requires `Content-Type: application/json` |
| POST | `/api/peak-hours/clock` | `{ "offsetMs": <int\|null>, "ttlMs"?: <int> }`; `ttlMs` is capped at 30 minutes |

```jsonc
{ "ok": true, "state": {
  "mode": "always", "defaultMode": "always", "modeSource": "session",
  "sessionId": "session-abc", "phase": "idle", "reason": "off-hours",
  "now": 1791541815888, "nowText": "2026-10-09 18:30:15",
  "nextTransitionAt": 1791766800000, "nextTransitionText": "2026-10-12 09:00:00", "nextPhase": "peak",
  "msUntilTransition": 224984112, "paused": false,
  "waitingTasks": 0, "waitingTasksTotal": 0, "waitingTasksUnresolved": 0,
  "holidayToday": null, "holidayCoverage": "known", "unknownHolidayYear": null,
  "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)", "peakWindows": ["09:00-12:00", "14:00-18:00"],
  "clockOverride": null, "config": { "allowClockOverride": true } } }
```

`waitingTasks` counts **the session named by `?session=`**, and the whole host when the parameter is absent —
which is why the older session-less curl examples keep their meaning. `waitingTasksTotal` is always host-wide.
`waitingTasksUnresolved` counts waiters whose session could not be resolved; those follow `default`, and the
count exists so a resolution failure is visible instead of looking like "nothing is waiting".

`clockOverride` shifts the host's notion of "now" so a peak window can be simulated without waiting for one.
It always carries a TTL (10 minutes by default) and clears itself: without that, a session that is held by the
window it created has nothing left to release it. Set `DSH_PEAK_HOURS_ALLOW_CLOCK=0` to disable the endpoint.

## Holiday data

The built-in calendar lists every statutory day off in 2025 (28 days) and 2026 (33 days), taken from the
State Council holiday notices. Make-up workdays are not part of the set. Each entry keeps its source titles
and URLs in `HOLIDAY_SOURCE_DETAIL` inside `lib/core/holidays.js`.

The 2027 notice has not been published yet, so that year reports `holidayCoverage: "unknown"` with
`unknownHolidayYear: 2027` and treats the date as a non-holiday (a weekday inside a window is peak); the UI
surfaces the warning. Adding a year is one data entry.

Callers can overlay their own dates with `createCalendar({ extra: { '2027-01-01': '元旦' } })`; `extra` wins and
is not restricted by `years`.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `allowClockOverride` | `true` | Whether `POST /api/peak-hours/clock` is accepted |
| `version` | from package.json | Version reported by `/health` |

Per-session choices live in `%DSH_HOME%\peak-hours-state.json` as
`{ "version": 2, "default": "always", "sessions": { "<sessionId>": "idle-only" } }`, written with serialized

# dsh-peak-guard

> **梁文峰是谁？我只认识梁文谷！**
>
> 高峰计价时段，DSH 不许调模型。被拦下的那次调用**不产生任何费用**，
> 用户收到的是一句说明，以及一份「高峰期间拦下了哪些请求」的列表。

[English](README.en.md) · 中文

一个 DSH **宿主 + 客户端**插件。谷时（含周末与法定假期）什么都不做；高峰时段在
`llm/stream` 这个瀑布式事件上直接短路 —— **不调用 `next()`，所以一个字节都不会发往任何模型适配器**，
然后自己捏一段合法的分片流回去，于是那句说明就长在模型的回复位置上。

## 1. 装好之后是什么样

高峰期（默认北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 的工作日）你在 DSH 里发一句话，
模型的回复位置出现的是（默认**正经版**话术）：

```
⛔ 高峰时段暂停模型调用（本次未产生费用）

— 现在是 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00），高峰单价约为谷时的 2 倍；本次调用没有产生费用。
谷时 18:00 开始（还有 3 小时 12 分），届时再发即可。
需要现在继续：`/peak off 30`（放行 30 分钟） · 查看状态：`/peak status`
```

想要最初那个彩蛋版（`现在是梁文峰时间，你马内不要了？胆子真是肥嘟嘟的`），
把配置里的 `tone` 设成 `joke`；也可以用 `message` 写任意自定义话术。
不想看下面那几行说明（只留第一句），把 `hint` 设成 `false`。

会话标题生成、上下文压缩这类「管家调用」**默认不拦** —— 拦了只会让标题变成那句说明、
让上下文压不动。真想「高峰期一个 token 都不发」，把 `blockUtilityCalls` 设成 `true`。

### 输入框那一带的两块 UI

**① 左边的盾牌开关**（插槽 `conversation.input.left`）——高峰保护总开关：

| 外观 | 含义 | 悬停提示 |
|---|---|---|
| 灰色盾牌 + 斜杠 | 开关关着 | 「点击打开：高峰时段不调用模型」 |
| 品牌色盾牌 + 对勾 | 开着，现在是谷时，待命中 | 「现在是谷时，模型调用放行；下一段高峰 09:00 开始（2 天 11 小时后）」 |
| 橙色盾牌 + 右上角橙点 | 开着，**现在正在拦** | 「现在是高峰，模型调用会被拦下；谷时 18:00 开始（还有 3 小时 12 分）」 |
| 左上角数字角标 | 被拦截列表里有 N 条（超过 99 显示 `99+`） | —— |

开关状态**落盘**（重启 DSH 后仍然记得），和 `/peak enable|disable` 是同一个状态。
宿主未就绪时它会呈现为灰色不可用态（提示「宿主半边未就绪」）—— 那说明插件代码改过但
**还没重启 DSH**，见下面 §3 的生效方式。

**② 输入框上方的「被拦截列表」卡片**（插槽 `conversation.input.dock` —— 和 DSH 那张「任务」卡同一个座位）
**只读记录 + 两个无害小动作**：高峰期间拦下了哪些请求，看得见、不动作（不排队、不重投、不打扰任何会话）。
只在有记录时出现：

```
⠿ 高峰期间有 2 条请求被拦下    这些请求没有发给模型，也没有产生费用          [ ˇ ] [ ✕ ]
  ● 把 README 里的截图换掉                                              09:52
  ⊘ 帮我看看这个报错                                                    09:41   ← 被关闭收起过的：空心环+斜杠
   ↑ ≤3 条默认展开（最新在前），>3 条默认折叠只留标题；点箭头展开/收起，点 ✕ 把没处理的收起
```

* **✕ 关闭**：卡片把「当时还没处理」的记录**交给宿主收起**（盖上「跳过」戳），并从此默认不再展示已办 ——
  于是卡片随即变空、自己消失；**之后新拦下的请求照旧会出现在卡片上**（关掉之后再勾的已办也仍留在卡上，
  直到下一次关闭）。
  想捞回来就去「拦截记录」页点一下那条的图标，它会恢复成正常待办。与折叠键共用同一套图标键样式
  （20×20、圆角、悬停底色），叉号是 **1.3px**（= DSH 自带的 `ICON_MEDIUM_STROKE`）圆头描边 SVG。
* **● → ✓ → ⊘ 三态勾选**：行首那颗图标有三种状态，**共用同一个 SVG**：
  **实心点**（正常待办）→ 点一下变**对勾**（已办，绿色，文字变淡划掉）→ 再点变回点；
  被「关闭」收起的显示为**空心圆环 + 一道斜杠**（琥珀色，含义是「关掉展示框时它还没被处理」），
  点一下**恢复成正常待办**（单向：没有手动改回跳过态的入口）。
  动画都在同一套描边里完成：圆环由同一个 `<circle>` 从实心撑开（`r` 3→3.7、`fill-opacity` 1→0、
  `stroke-opacity` 0→1，190ms `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`），对勾与斜杠各自用
  `stroke-dasharray` / `stroke-dashoffset`「画」出来 / 收回去（240ms / 220ms）；
  勾选是**乐观更新**（先动观感再发请求，失败回滚），点了不会有延迟感；
  `prefers-reduced-motion` 下自动关掉过渡。
* **卡片列什么**（纯函数 `cardItems(list, dismissedAtMs)`）：跳过的永不展示；已办则**按时间判** ——
  只有「**关掉那一刻之前**就已办」的才收起。所以**在卡片上勾「已办」不会让那行当场消失**，
  得再关一次卡片才会收起 —— 勾错了随时反悔。开关上那个角标数的就是「还等着处理」的条数。
* 三态都是**纯本地状态**：不影响任何拦截行为，但都会**落盘**
  （`POST /peak-guard/set` 的 `{check:{id,done}}` / `{restore:[id]}` / `{dismiss:true}`），重启后还在。

### 卡头那两枚图标键

* **两个图标键的 DOM 结构必须对称，且 SVG 要 `display:block`**：
  曾经折叠键外面多包了一层 `<span>`，而那条 span 的样式在一次 CSS 重写里被删掉 →
  inline SVG 按**文字基线**对齐，被顶高 **1.44px**（量截图才发现）。
  现在两边都是「按钮里直接装 SVG」，并有回归测试盯着。
* **整组的纵向位置由一个常量控制**：`CHEVRON_Y_SHIFT`（0.5px 一档，负值 = 上移），
  两个箭头方向共用同一段 y 区间，所以展开/收起切换时图标不会上下跳。
* **卡头三枚图标（lead / chevron / close）统一描边 `ICON_STROKE = 1.3`**（对齐 DSH 自带的
  `ICON_MEDIUM_STROKE`，官方那个 16px 关闭键就是 1.3）；列表里的对勾用 `CHECK_STROKE = 1.6` 略重一点。

### 设置 → 拦截记录（管理页）

除了输入框上方那张小卡片，插件还在 **DSH 设置**里注册了一整页「拦截记录」
（插槽 `settings.section`，注册形状照 `dsh-archived-chats`：`{id, order, label}`，
`label` 决定左侧导航文案）。页面结构对齐 DSH 自带设置页：

```
拦截记录  v1.0.0                              [ 全部标为已办 ]  [ 清空记录 ]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  全部 12      待办 6      已办 3      跳过 3
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 🔍 搜索请求内容或会话 id                                              │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
⊘ 帮我看看这个报错                    09:41   a1b2c3d4        [⊘]  [🗑]   ← 跳过：点一下恢复为待办
● 把 README 里的截图换掉              09:52   e5f6a7b8        [✓]  [🗑]
…（没有记录时是收件箱图标 +「暂无拦截记录」空态）
```

* **标签页**：全部 / 待办 / 已办 / **跳过**，各带实时计数；**搜索**匹配请求原文与会话 id
  （大小写不敏感），与标签页叠加生效。「待办」只算正常待办，被展示框收起过的那些归到「跳过」。
* **每行**：三态图标键（实心点 ↔ 对勾 ↔ 空心环 + 斜杠，同一套 SVG 与描边动画；**跳过态点一下
  即恢复为正常待办，单向**）、请求原文（截断）、时间、会话尾号、删除键。
  操作都是即时反馈，失败会在页面上写明错误码。
* **批量**：「全部标为已办」走 `POST /peak-guard/set` 的 `{checkAll:true}`（一条请求，不是 N 条）；
  「清空记录」是**两步确认**（第一次点变成「确认清空？」，再点才真删），避免误触。
* **一次拉全量**：`GET /peak-guard/state?limit=200`（卡片用默认 20 条，设置页要 200）；
  超过 200 条时页面顶上一行说明「只显示了最新的 200 条」。
* 这个页面只跟插件自己的两个路由打交道，**不读任何会话数据**。

> 💡 **提示：在设置里把「跳过」改回「待办」之后，对话界面那张卡片可能要等一会儿才会显示它。**
> 改动是立刻落盘的，设置页也会顺手把新状态推给两边共用的那份内存状态，所以切回对话界面
> **通常立刻就能看到**；万一那张卡片还是旧样子（比如两个窗口各开着一份），最多等 **20 秒** ——
> 卡片每 20 秒轮询一次，窗口重新获得焦点时也会立刻刷新。

> **为什么没有「一键补发 / 谷时自动补发」**：做过一版，投递链路脆弱（要跨会话 resume + 排队 +
> 串行等待，还容易和用户手上的回合并发）且语义上自相矛盾 —— 这个插件的意义是"高峰期别烧钱"，
> 而"谷时替你自动发一遍"是在你不在场时替你花钱。**已整体砍掉**，相关路由、命令、依赖
> （`sessionController`）、界面控件、配置键全部删除。插件现在只做一件事：**拦下 + 记账 + 让你看见**。
> 之前的设计推演留在 [`docs/DESIGN-replay-tradeoffs.md`](docs/DESIGN-replay-tradeoffs.md) 里当记录。

**几何是照官方那张卡片的 CSS 抄的**（`aSus8q_*` 那组规则：`width/max-width` 用
`--dsh-composer-card-max-width` 与 `--dsh-composer-*` 那套 composer 变量、`border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-lg)`、
`background: var(--dsw-specific-menu)`、`box-shadow: var(--dsw-elevation-panel)`、`__body` 内边距 `6px 12px`、
列表 `gap:8px / max-height:180px / item 行高 20px`），所以它跟输入框**同宽、同一水平中线**，
不会自己长出另一种宽度或节奏。折叠箭头是 SVG 描边图标（16px 画布 / 1.6px 描边 / 圆头圆角 `currentColor`），
不是 `^` `ˇ` 字符 —— 字符的字形和粗细随字体走，跟官方那枚对不上。

三个不写就会"看起来不对"的细节（都有测试盯着）：

* **表头那格灰色说明永远渲染**（没内容时是空元素）。它是 `flex:auto` 的弹簧 ——
  少了它，折叠箭头就会贴在标题后面，而不会靠右。
* **圆角胶囊/圆点必须 `corner-shape:round`**：DSH 全局把圆角做成了 superellipse，
  不自带这行的话角标和提示点会被渲染成方圆角（自带组件就是这么写的）。
实现上的三条自我约束（照 DSH 官方插件开发 skill 的硬规矩）：

* **不 import 任何 DSH 自带的客户端包**（连 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 都不许），UI 全手写；
* **样式只用主题令牌** `--dsw-alias-*`，浅色/深色自动跟随 —— `test/client.test.mjs` 里有自动检查：
  CSS 里出现任何非 `--dsw-alias-` 的变量、或硬编码颜色，测试就判失败；
* 装样式 / 起定时器 / 挂监听器全在 `ctx.effect` 里（factory 阶段零副作用），随插件卸载回收；
  插槽注册失败只打日志，绝不连累输入区。两块 UI 共用**一份**轮询，不各打各的请求。

## 2. 判定口径（不是拍脑袋定的）

| 规则 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 高峰窗口 | 本地（默认 `Asia/Shanghai`）09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，半开区间 `[start, end)` |
| 周末 | 本地周六/周日**全天谷价** |
| 法定假期 | 默认内置 2026 年中秋 + 国庆共 10 天，全天谷价（每年需更新一次） |

这套口径与 `dsh-cost-meter` 的峰谷计价**逐项一致**（那边的窗口来自 DeepSeek 控制台公告
并跟随官方页面同步）。`test/peak.test.mjs` 里有一段差分测试：从 2026-08-22T16:00Z 到
2027-03-01、每 7 分钟采一个点，逐点比对本插件的 `isPeak` 与 `dsh-cost-meter` 的
`isPeakHour`，另有 60 天、每 53 分钟一次的「下一个切换点」比对。**两边有一个点不一致，
测试就红。**

## 3. 安装

```powershell
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1            # 装进 desktop（默认）
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1 -WhatIf    # 只看要做什么，不落盘
pwsh -File install-profile.ps1 -Uninstall # 卸载
```

脚本做四件事：备份 profile 的 `package.json` → 加一条 `link:` 依赖 → 把包名追加进
`dsh.profile.bundles` → 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下建 junction。做完会自校验
（依赖 / bundles / 链接 / 入口可达），任一项不过就以非零码退出并告诉你怎么用备份还原。

> `desktop` 是 Electron 保留 profile，命令行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被
> 拒绝（"managed exclusively by the Electron application"），所以走脚本。

**生效方式（分两种，别混）**：

| 改了什么 | 怎么生效 |
|---|---|
| **profile 组合**（装/卸插件、`dsh.profile.bundles`、profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`） | **就地热生效**。本机实测：脚本写完 profile 不到一秒，`include:peak-guard` 就是 `enabled + active` |
| **插件自己的代码**（`lib/*.js`、`package.json` 里的 `dsh.client`） | **必须完全退出并重开 DSH Desktop**。宿主模块是启动时 import 的，客户端产物也在启动时扫描一次（`dsh-hmr` 只 watch 配置文件，不管模块代码）—— 实测：改完代码后新增的 HTTP 路由与 `/plugins/dsh-peak-guard/client.js` 都还是 404，重启后才出现 |

## 4. 逃生门

被锁在门外还进不去，那就不是插件是牢房。所以留了这些路，任何一条都能把人捞出来：

| 逃生门 | 怎么用 | 生效范围 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入框左边那个开关 | 点一下（走 `fetch`，**不需要模型参与**） | 立刻，且落盘 |
| `/peak enable｜disable` | 等价于上面那个开关 | 立刻，且落盘 |
| `/peak off [分钟]` | 临时放行（命令走 `commands` 服务，不需要模型） | 运行时，最长到重启 |
| `/peak force` / `/peak on` | 现场强制拦 / 立刻收回 | 运行时 |
| `allowSessions` | 配置里写 session id 白名单 | 直到改配置 |
| `DSH_PEAK_GUARD=off` | 启动 DSH 前设环境变量（`0/off/false/no/disable` 都算关） | 整进程，重启前一直有效 |

`/peak` 的全部子命令：

```
/peak                     看当前峰谷状态、窗口、拦截计数、话术与被拦截列表
/peak test                不下发请求，先看看提示语长什么样（dry-run）
/peak force [分钟]        无视峰谷强制拦一段时间（默认 5 分钟）—— 用来现场验收
/peak enable|disable      高峰保护总开关（和输入框左边那个开关同一个状态，会落盘）
/peak off [分钟|forever]  临时放行（默认 30 分钟；forever = 放行到重启）
/peak on                  立刻恢复拦截（同时收回 force / off）
/peak list                列出高峰期间被拦下的请求（只是记录，插件不会替它们重投）
```

## 5. 配置

配置在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`

plugins.description: Monet (Material Design 3) dynamic-color wallpaper theming for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-m3-monet · 莫奈美化

Monet wallpaper theming for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, built on
Material Design 3 dynamic color. The wallpaper seed goes through the official
Material color pipeline (HCT → quantize → Score → tonal palettes) and maps the
M3 roles onto the Harness design tokens per color scheme.

- 壁纸取色：本地图片/图片链接/内置渐变 → 莫奈种子提取（`Quantizer`-style 采样 + `Score` 评分）
- 换图即自动重取色：壁纸以内容哈希标记，选择新壁纸后立即重新提取种子并应用（无需手动切色源）
- MD3 Token 映射：`--dsw-alias-*` 全套别名令牌（100+ 项，亮暗各自取值）由 `theme.overrideTokens` 注入
- 毛玻璃：**侧边栏与主体分别配置**（各自开关 / 模糊 / 饱和度 / 不透明度），`backdrop-filter` 直接作用于壁纸
- Material You 视觉与动效：MD3 运动/形状令牌 + `m3ui` 控件样式（开关/滑块/芯片/卡片）+ 壳层配色交叉淡入 + 设置页入场动画，可一键关闭并尊重系统「减少动态效果」
- 壁纸背景：整窗口背景（带亮/暗各自的暗化层），并把顶层表面改为半透明使其透出
- 顶部标题栏固定为主题纯色，不参与壁纸与毛玻璃
- 侧边栏底部原「阴影式」软边界替换为主题色 1px 横线
- 设置对话框背景透视：全屏遮罩恢复为半透明 scrim、面板改为半透明 + 毛玻璃，壁纸从设置页背后透出
- 调色控制：风格（标准/鲜艳/柔和/表现/单色）、色彩强度、明度微调，实时预览
- 内置 8 组 Material palette 预设 + 8 组渐变壁纸（随当前调色联动）
- 设置全部持久化在 `localStorage`（`dsh.m3monet.v1`），跟随系统亮暗自动切换

## 壁纸图层处理

壁纸画在 `.BynINW_frame` 的背景上，而布局的子列会在其上再铺自己的底色，导致壁纸被完全遮住
（源码见 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/lib/client.js`）：

| 图层 | 覆盖色 | 处理方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `[data-windows-titlebar] .BynINW_centerCol` | `--dsw-alias-bg-base` | 开启壁纸时按「主体毛玻璃不透明度」或「界面不透明度」改为 `color-mix(... transparent)` |
| `.BynINW_sidebarCol` | `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` | 开启壁纸时按「侧边栏毛玻璃不透明度」或「界面不透明度」改为半透明 |
| `.BynINW_sidebarCol ._2H3hWW_root` | 同上（第二层） | 壁纸开启时置为 `background: transparent`，避免两层叠加 |
| `[data-windows-titlebar] .BynINW_frame:before` | `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` | **改为主题纯色**（`surfaceContainer`），并清掉 `backdrop-filter` |
| `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2/3` | 卡片/面板底色 | 取「界面不透明度 + 14%」，保持正文可读性 |
| `.wCInkW_mask`（设置页全屏遮罩） | `--dsw-alias-bg-mask-1` | 遮罩 token 恢复为半透明 scrim（stock `#0000003d` 语义），并加 `backdrop-filter` 毛玻璃 |
| `.wCInkW_panel`（设置页 800px 面板） | `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-2` | 开启壁纸时改为按「主体毛玻璃不透明度 / 界面不透明度」的 `color-mix(... transparent)` + 毛玻璃 |

> `--dsw-alias-bg-mask-1/2/3`、`bg-mask-photo/drop`、`bg-skeleton`、`border-inverted(2)` 在 stock 主题里都是**半透明**叠加层；
> 早期版本把它们错误地映射成了不透明 `scrim`，会让设置页遮罩变成纯黑（壁纸完全看不见），现已按语义修正。

毛玻璃 `backdrop-filter` 按分组分别作用于侧边栏（`.BynINW_sidebarCol`）与主体（`.BynINW_centerCol`），
二者直接坐在 frame 背景上，因此模糊的正是壁纸本身；标题栏条不参与模糊。

> 该模糊**不能直接写在列元素上**：`backdrop-filter`（与 `filter`、`transform` 一样）会让元素成为其
> `position:fixed` 后代的包含块，而侧边栏的折叠按钮 `._2H3hWW_toggle` 恰好是
> `position:fixed; left:12px; top:calc((var(--dsh-windows-titlebar-height) - 28px) / 2)`——靠它落在
> Windows 标题栏那一行。模糊一旦写在列上，按钮就以「侧边栏列」为基准定位，整体下移一个标题栏高度，
> 压到 `deepseek HARNESS` 品牌行上（因为列本身已经被 frame 的 `padding-top` 推低了一个标题栏高度）。
> 因此改为在列内绘制 `::before` 毛玻璃层：
> `position:relative;z-index:0` + `::before{inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;backdrop-filter:…}`。
> 该层位于列内容之下（`z-index:-1`，不会把侧边栏自己的文字糊掉），且自身没有任何后代，
> 不会再改变任何元素的定位基准。主体列同理。

侧边栏底部（`_2H3hWW_footArea`，账号行上方）原有软性阴影边界，现替换为
`border-top: 1px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l2)` 的主题色横线。

## Material 3 视觉与动效

设置页与主题表面按 Google Material 3（Material You）规范重构：

- **静态样式表**：MD3 运动令牌（`--m3-ease-standard/emphasized`、`--m3-dur-short…medium4`）、形状令牌
  （`--m3-radius-xs…xl`）与全套 `m3ui-*` 控件样式，经 `data-m3-monet-base` 样式表**注入一次、永不重写**——
  重写样式表会重启 CSS 动画；随设置变化的规则仍在独立的动态样式表（`data-m3-monet`）里。
- **控件**：开关（MD3 轨道 40×22、拇指 14→18、悬停状态层光晕）、滑块（4px 轨道 + 主色拇指 + 按压光晕）、
  分段选择与按钮（药丸形芯片，选中用 secondary-container / primary 填充）、色板与预设圆点、
  卡片（MD3 elevation level 1——阴影色取自当前方案的 `shadow` 角色而非硬编码灰色）。
  颜色全部走 `--m3-*` 令牌并回退到 `--dsw-alias-*`，插件禁用时控件自动退回主题令牌样式。
- **壳层交叉淡入**：壁纸/毛玻璃/调色变化时，`frame`、侧边栏、主体列与内部侧边栏根的背景/边框/文字色以
  250ms `ease-standard` 过渡（列 `::before` 毛玻璃层同步过渡）。只过渡颜色属性，**不**对宿主元素使用
  `transform`/`will-change`（避免再次触碰 fixed 定位包含块问题）。
- **入场动画**：设置页行级 4px 上滑淡入；壁纸预览图更换时 200ms 淡入（key 重挂载触发）。
- **运动开关**：设置页「过渡动画」可整体关闭（立即生效）；系统 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 时自动全部禁用。

## 壁纸取色

壁纸每次变化都会重新走一遍取色流程，用「壁纸标记」（`wallpaperTag`）判断是否需要重算：

```js
function hashString(str) {            // FNV-1a
  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i += 1) {
    hash ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  }
  return hash.toString(16) + '-' + str.length;
}
wallpaperTag = kind + ':' + hashString(value);
```

早期版本用 `kind + value.slice(0, 64)` 当标记，而所有 JPEG data URL 的前 64 个字符都是同一段
`data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAAAQABAAD…`，于是换壁纸后标记不变、被判定为「已提取过」而跳过重算，
主题就一直停留在上一张壁纸的颜色。改为内容哈希（并附上长度）后，任何换图都会触发重新提取。

- 图像一变即提取，不再要求 `palette.source === 'wallpaper'`；若当前色源为「预设色板」，会自动切到「壁纸自动」。
- 提取结果以内存中的最新设置为基座合并后落盘（避免存储回读把它覆盖回旧值）。
- 提取失败时落盘 `seeds: []` + `extractError: true`，设置页给出提示而不是静默沿用旧色。
- 插件激活时若存储里的标记与当前壁纸不符（例如升级前留下的旧标记），也会重新提取一次。
- 提取是异步的，因此结果以「立即应用」写回并**取消仍在排队中的防抖应用**：否则那次延迟 120ms 的防抖回调
  会在提取完成后拿着更新前的快照再跑一遍，把刚取到的新颜色覆盖回上一张壁纸的颜色（表现就是「换壁纸后颜色不变，
  手动把色源切走再切回来才刷新」）。同时用自增序号丢弃过期的提取结果，连续换图时只有最后一次生效。

## 入口

- 仅插件设置页：`设置 > 插件 > 莫奈美化 > 配置`（`settings.section` 槽位，页面内容可上下滚动）
- 不在主页面显示，也不占用主页面左侧栏——只作为插件自身设置存在

## 说明与限制

- 主题覆盖随会话临时生效：关闭插件或卸载后恢复默认界面；设置项保留在本地。
- 仅使用 Harness 主题令牌与 `--dsw-*` CSS 变量绘制 UI，不引入任何客户端 UI 包。
- 远端图片链接受页面 CSP 限制时可能无法作为壁纸显示；本地图片（data URL）不受影响。
- 引擎为离线打包的 `@material/material-color-utilities`（Apache-2.0，见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md）。

## 开发

```bash
node scripts/build.mjs      # 由 src/engine-core.js + src/engine-ext.js 生成 lib/engine.js 并内联进 client.js
node scripts/test.mjs       # 引擎单元测试（HCT 已知值、Scheme 角色、Monet 取色、Token 映射）
node scripts/smoke-client.mjs  # 浏览器端冒烟：模块装载、槽位注册、Token 注入、壁纸取色
```

包体结构：`index.js`（Host 空实现）、`client.js`（浏览器端全量逻辑）、`cordis.patch.yml`（一行插件行）。

- 设置页背景透视由冒烟测试覆盖：断言 `--dsw-alias-bg-mask-1` 为 24% 半透明 scrim（非不透明）、`bg-skeleton` 半透明、`border-inverted` 亮色为 `transparent`；壁纸开启时 `.wCInkW_mask` 与 `.wCInkW_panel` 均带 `backdrop-filter`，面板背景为 60%（主体毛玻璃不透明度）的 `color-mix`；无壁纸时不下发 `.wCInkW_panel` 规则。
- 壁纸自动取色由冒烟测试场景 5/6 覆盖：场景 5 用「旧版前缀标记 + 已存紫色种子」模拟升级前状态，断言重新提取出的标记与旧标记不同、种子来自新壁纸（纯绿 64×64，`greenFromArgb > blueFromArgb`）、最终 `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` 亮色不再是 `#6750a4`（实测 `#006e21`，种子 `#48a850`）且主题被重复应用；场景 6 断言开启壁纸后色源自动从 `preset` 切到 `wallpaper`。
- 「换壁纸后颜色不刷新」的竞态由场景 5 守住：测试等待 `settle(260ms)` 越过 120ms 防抖窗口后才断言，要求最终生效的主题既不是旧种子 `#6750a4`、也不等于旧种子推出的 `brand-primary`。把修复临时还原（`applySoon` 用旧快照 + `applyFresh` 不取消防抖）后该断言确实失败（实测回落到 `#6750a4`），证明断言不是空转。
- 「侧边栏折叠按钮下移到品牌行」由冒烟测试守住：断言毛玻璃只出现在 `.BynINW_sidebarCol::before` /
  `.BynINW_centerCol::before` 上，并列元素本身**不带** `backdrop-filter`（`/\.BynINW_sidebarCol\{[^}]*backdrop-filter/`
  与 `/\.BynINW_centerCol\{[^}]*backdrop-filter/` 都必须不命中）——一旦把模糊写回列元素，这两条断言立即失败。
- Material 3 视觉与动效由冒烟测试守住：断言恰好两张样式表（静态 base + 动态）、base 含 MD3 运动令牌与
  `prefers-reduced-motion`、壳层过渡被 `html.m3-monet-on:not(.m3-motion-off)` 门控、base 不含 `backdrop-filter`；
  遍历设置页渲染树（含函数组件调用与 children 拍平）断言控件使用 `m3ui-switch/chip/card/slider/dot` 类、
  行带 `m3ui-row-in` 入场类；`motion:false` 时断言 `m3-motion-off` 根标记出现（默认不出现）。

## 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Regex520/dsh-m3-monet.git
```

克隆后把该目录作为本地 bundle 装入 Harness profile（以 `link:` 方式登记，因此改工作区文件即改已装包内容），
**重载应用**后生效：设置 → 插件 → 莫奈美化 → 配置。

## 许可证

- 本插件：MIT（见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)）。
- 离线打包的引擎代码来自 [`@material/material-color-utilities`](https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities)（Apache-2.0），出处与许可全文见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-bridge

Observe and steer a local **Codex** (OpenAI) session from **DeepSeek Harness**.

The plugin talks to `codex app-server` — the same protocol the Codex app itself
uses — which is what makes the live parts possible at all:

| | Reading the rollout `.jsonl` | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Transcript | after it is written | live deltas, plus polls |
| Reasoning | only what was flushed | summary deltas as they stream |
| Rate-limit budget | not present | `account/rateLimits/read` |
| Send a message | not possible | queue (the only cross-process path) |
| Answer an approval | not possible | only for turns this bridge started |

It was built as a DSH counterpart to a Codex session running in the Codex desktop
app: read what that session is doing, hand it the next instruction, and know
exactly which parts are impossible rather than guessing.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `codex_status` | Account, plan, rate-limit budget, local processes, latest thread, pending approvals. Degrades to a readable message when Codex is not reachable instead of throwing. |
| `codex_threads` | Recent threads, optionally filtered by a search string. |
| `codex_transcript` | Items of one thread, newest first. |
| `codex_watch` | Watches a thread for N seconds and returns what streamed past, merging the live notification stream with transcript polls and labelling each event's `source`. |
| `codex_send` | `queue` (default), `turn`, or `steer`. Falls back to the queue when the desktop app holds the thread's write lock. |
| `codex_approvals` | Lists pending approval requests and answers them. |
| `codex_queue` | Shows the messages still waiting on a thread (`action=list`), and cancels one with `action=delete`. Reports what the app-server confirmed, since a live session usually consumes a queued message first. |
| `codex_budget` | Reads the rate-limit buckets and says whether Codex is out of quota, quoting the server's own flags. A high `usedPercent` is a level, not a limit, so 100% is not reported as "out of quota". |
| `codex_ask` | One question on a throwaway Codex thread, with a chosen model and effort, then hands the answer back into a development thread verbatim (`feed:false` to only read it). It is the DSH↔Codex quick-chat path; a model override that Codex declines fails the call instead of quietly asking the default model. |
| `codex_handoff` | Builds a takeover brief out of the thread's own records — the objective, the instruction quoted verbatim, what it touched, where it stopped, the quota at that moment, and what the brief cannot know. `saveTo` writes it to a file. `action: "prepare"` writes it as a **takeover** of a thread whose quota is gone; `action: "claim"` records that a person or this session has actually taken it over. |

## Board

The same projection is also a panel inside Harness: a sidebar row named **Codex**
opens a board whose columns are **Needs you** (red), **Blocked** (orange),
**Running** (green) and **Nothing observed** (grey), in that order — the four
states live in `src/task-state.js`, one rule per state.

Every judgement is made on the host, in pure functions, so the panel cannot invent
a status the protocol never reported. Each card shows the state, whether it was
`reported` or `inferred`, the reasons behind it, the evidence it rests on, the
newest recorded turn statuses as a strip, and a progress bar **only when Codex
reported a denominator** (a goal's token budget, or plan steps). With no
denominator the card shows the counts it really has and says
`no progress denominator reported` instead of drawing a bar from nothing.

Six rules keep it honest:

- A thread holding an approval this connection is responsible for is **Needs you**,
  and it is never filed under Blocked even when it also has queued messages.
- *Running* means Codex reported the turn as advancing, **or** this bridge's
  connection saw `turn/started` and has not seen it finish, **or** the rollout was
  touched seconds ago — and that last case is printed as `inferred`. The fourth
  column is **Nothing observed**, never "idle": silence from a connection-scoped
  protocol is not proof that nothing is happening.
- Every card carries a **last** line: the newest item the rollout reports that is not
  encrypted reasoning, with that item's own status printed verbatim. It reports what
  the thread last did; it is not a claim that a turn is running.
- Age is part of the judgement, not decoration, and the age is the **turn's own
  end time** (`completedAt`), never when the thread was last touched — opening a
  thread, or restarting Codex, bumps `updatedAt` and would otherwise make a
  day-old failure look new. A failed turn is **Needs you** while it is fresh; on a
  thread with no goal, a failure older than `FAILURE_ATTENTION_MS` (48 hours)
  keeps its error text as evidence and the card settles to grey. The board's first live run was three red cards whose failures
  were seconds, 3.6 days and 12.8 days old, and only the first wanted anything —
  a red column that never empties is one people stop reading. The same failure on a
  thread that still carries a goal stays red at any age, because the goal is Codex's
  own standing statement about work that is meant to be running.
- Queue, item, turn and goal inspection are sampled (a bounded number of threads per
  refresh, all of it reported in the snapshot's `probe` block), and the board says so
  rather than presenting a partial read as a total.
- The account line and the quota line come from the same predicate as
  `codex_budget`, and a reached quota is a warning that quotes the server's flag.

### When Codex runs out: prepare, then claim

A reached quota is the one failure nothing here retries — it is not a run that
stopped, it is an account that ran out, and a red card that can never change is one
people stop reading. So a quota card offers **Prepare a takeover**: the plugin writes
the handoff brief to `<project>/.codex-handoff/<threadId>-<time>.md` and the card says
so.

**A prepared brief is not a handover, and the panel keeps saying so.** The plugin
cannot push into a Harness conversation, so `claimed` may only be set by an explicit
`codex_handoff action=claim` (or the card's **Mark taken over** button). Until then
the card reads *takeover prepared, unclaimed*, with that sentence attached. The
records live in memory for the run; the file is on disk for whoever looks next.

The panel's controls are almost all reads, and exactly one of them can reach Codex.
**Refresh** re-reads the snapshot. **Takeover brief** renders the same markdown
`codex_handoff` builds, with Copy and Close buttons. **Pause this thread** /
**Resume this thread** stops the autopilot from touching that one thread. **Prepare
a takeover** and **Mark taken over** drive the local takeover store — the first only
where a card is actually asking, the second only after the first. **Evaluate one
pass** runs a single autopilot pass through the same guards, so with the autopilot
off it writes nothing.

**Keep Codex moving for 30m** is the one that arms the autopilot. While armed, and
only then, a host-side timer may queue a continuation message into a **Blocked**
thread, or into a **Needs you** thread whose failure the supervisor can read as
transient, through `thread/queue/add` — the same single write `codex_send` uses.

### What it sends

Not a bare "continue". Every automatic message is a **supervision brief** built from
that thread's own record — and only from it: the goal objective Codex was given,
Codex's own last `agentMessage` word for word (with its phase), the newest turn's
status and, when it failed, the error text Codex recorded plus how long ago that was,
the item counts for the turn, and whether a queue is still unconsumed. Nothing is
paraphrased and nothing is invented; where the record is empty the brief says so
(`这个线程没有记录目标`, `没有留下可读的回复文字`).

### Resume, do not replay

Before a supervised message is sent, the thread's working directory is read with
`git status --porcelain` (read-only, 5s, never fatal). A resume is not a re-run: if
the directory already carries uncommitted work — or the failing turn recorded file
