## What this is

By default the `+` button left of the composer opens a file picker. Everything else you may want to point the model at — a browser tab you are looking at, an earlier conversation, a skill, an MCP server, one of the plugins installed on this machine — has to be typed by hand, or referenced with `@`.

`dsh-composer-launcher` replaces that button with a **three-group menu**:

| Group | What is in it |
|---|---|
| **Add** | files and folders, earlier chats, plan mode, goal mode |
| **Capabilities** | slash commands, skills, MCP servers |
| **Common plugins** | one row per installed plugin, plus an "all plugins" row |

What you pick does not get pasted in as text. It becomes a **reference chip** on a rail above the input box — the same native chip kind the host already renders for `@` references — and only turns into message text when you actually send.

There is also an **optional browser extension** (`DSH Tab Bridge`) which pushes your real browser's tabs to the plugin over a loopback HTTP bridge, so the Tabs row lists the pages you genuinely have open rather than a throwaway debug instance.

---

## What it does

### 1. The `+` menu (three groups)

A 360px panel, opened from the button at the `conversation.input.left` slot.

- **Add** — *Files and folders* (the host's own picker, multi-select, drag-and-drop; falls back to `@` references when the host exposes no folder picker), *Chats* (via `remote.sessionReferenceResolver`; chats only, no files), *Plan*, *Goal*.
- **Capabilities** — *Commands* (whatever the host's slash-command service offers), *Skills* (read live with `ctx.remote.skills.list({ sessionId })`), *MCP* (needs the host's `remote.mcpManager`).
- **Common plugins** — one row per plugin returned by `ctx.remote.pluginInventory.list()`. That list is read from the host on every load, so installing, removing or disabling a plugin is reflected immediately and there is no cache to keep in sync. Three modes decide which rows appear: `pinned`, `frequent`, `mixed` (see [Settings](#settings)).

Every row can be switched off individually from the settings card.

### 2. Reference chips

Picked items land on a rail **above** the input box (`conversation.input.dock`). A chip is `{ label, kind, icon }` plus an optional `url`, where `kind` is one of `web`, `plugin`, `skill`, `mcp`. Clicking the `×` removes it.

Two properties are worth naming, because both were bugs before they were features:

- **A web chip keeps its address.** A page title with no URL is useless to whoever reads the message — the chip carries the URL and the payload includes it.
- **A session reference stays a chip.** Writing a reference back through the plain-text draft API silently downgrades it to body text; the plugin renders it as a chip instead and never round-trips it through the text editor.

Chips are **per session**, so two chat tabs never share a rail.

On send, each chip is serialised into the message with a short marker, so the model can tell a referenced page from an attached file:

| Chip kind | Marker |
|---|---|
| web page | `【参考网页】<title> — <url>` |
| plugin | `【使用插件】<name>` |
| skill | `【技能】<name>` |
| MCP server | `【MCP】<name>` |

> These markers are literal and stay in Chinese in both interface languages. They are part of the text the **model** reads, not interface copy — translating them would change what the model sees.

### 3. Settings card

Registered on the `settings.plugin.item` slot as a card titled **Launcher** — 「启动器」 in the Chinese interface. It is collapsed the first time you open it and remembers that choice. All twelve fields are listed under [Settings](#settings).

### 4. Debug browser (fallback)

The Tabs row can also read tabs over a remote-debugging port from a Chromium process it starts itself. That is what **Launch debug browser** does — and when the extension is staged, the same call attaches it with `--load-extension` and then verifies through the debugging port that it really mounted, so this route needs no manual step at all (see [The browser extension](#the-browser-extension)). It stays a fallback rather than the primary path because it only ever sees that one throwaway-profile instance, never the browser you already have open.

### 5. Loopback bridge

The host half owns a small HTTP bridge on `127.0.0.1:43130` (override: `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT`) so the extension can push tabs into it. It binds loopback only, yields politely if an older instance already holds the port, and is used for nothing else.

---

## Screenshots

**The `+` menu — Add / Capabilities / Common plugins — with the Tabs row fed by the extension**

![The composer + menu with the Tabs group and the connected extension](screenshots/01-composer-menu-tab-bridge.png)

**The Tabs row reading a real Microsoft Edge window over the bridge**

![Tab list pushed from Microsoft Edge](screenshots/02-tab-list-edge.png)

**The MCP servers the Capabilities group can reference — the row is built from the host's `remote.mcpManager`**

![MCP servers listed by the host](screenshots/03-mcp-servers.png)

**The plugin inventory the Common plugins group is built from, including its "N / M" narrowing counter**

![Plugin inventory with composition filtering](screenshots/04-plugin-inventory.png)

---

## The browser extension

The plugin works without it — the Tabs row simply says the extension is not installed and points at the button. With it, the row lists the tabs of your **everyday browser**.

### Three ways to get it loaded

Chromium will not let anything silently sideload an extension into the browser you use every day. That is a browser security rule with no plugin-side workaround, so the goal is a different one: make every *remaining* step either automatic or one click.

| Route | What happens | Manual steps |
|---|---|---|
| **A — a browser this plugin starts** | The plugin spawns a separate Chromium process with `--load-extension` pointing at the staged copy, then **verifies through the debugging port that the extension really mounted** | none |
| **B — your everyday browser** | The Tabs row offers *Open the extensions page* and *Copy the extension path*, so loading it once is a paste and a "Load unpacked" | one time, ~20 seconds |
| **C — managed machines** | Chromium enterprise policy (`ExtensionSettings` / `ExtensionInstallForcelist`) pointing at a self-hosted, signed CRX plus an HTTPS update manifest | admin rights; **not shipped here** |

**Route A is verified, not assumed.** After launching, the plugin asks the debugging port for its raw target list and looks for *this* extension's own worker (`chrome-extension://<id>/background.js`) rather than "some extensio

plugins.description: A Restart button for DeepSeek Harness Settings: replaces the dsh web process serving the page, then reconnects the page by itself.
plugins.readme_text: **A Restart card in DeepSeek Harness Settings.** One click replaces the `dsh web` process that is serving your page — and the page reconnects by itself. No terminal, no re-opening the desktop icon. That matters because some changes cannot hot-reload: - you changed a plugin's **host half**, and Node caches imported ES modules by URL; - you edited `config.json`, the port, or the workspace; - a session holds in-memory state you want gone. Today those mean walking back to a terminal. This plugin turns them into one click. ## Try it ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:chenkui-luo/dsh-plugin-restart ``` Then **refresh the page once** and open **Settings → Restart**. Without the `dsh` CLI (no pnpm, or a patched profile): copy the package into `/node_modules/dsh-plugin-restart` and add this row to `/cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - insert: - id: restart name: 'dsh-plugin-restart' ``` The bundled installer does both steps with a backup and a read-back check before it writes: ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 -Action disable powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\Install-RestartPlugin.ps1 -Action uninstall ``` ## What happens when you click | Step | What runs | | --- | --- | | 1 | The page sends `POST /dsh-restart/restart` — same origin, authenticated | | 2 | The host half starts a **detached helper** and answers the request *before* anything is stopped | | 3 | The helper waits for the port to stop accepting connections, then hands over to your launcher | | 4 | The launcher starts a fresh `dsh web` with a new launch token and writes its token file | | 5 | The helper confirms the replacement is up, then lets the old process exit — gracefully | | 6 | The page sees a new instance id on its next poll and reloads itself | Nothing is force-killed in the middle of the response, and the old process is stopped **last**, by itself. A restart that fails leaves a diagnosis in the log instead of failing silently. ## Why the helper is a detached **node** process This part was measured on a real Windows machine, not assumed: | how a background helper is started | does it run | does it outlive the process it must replace | | --- | --- | --- | | PowerShell, `detached: true` | **no** — exits 0, silently | — | | PowerShell, attached | yes | no — dies with its parent | | **node, `detached: true`** | yes | **yes** | | node, attached | yes | no | On Windows a "detached" PowerShell child gets no console and never runs the script — the same trap [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) documents. An attached helper dies together with the process it is supposed to replace. So the helper is a detached node process, and it gives its own children a hidden console through `powershell -WindowStyle Hidden`. Force-killing the whole tree is the other half of the story: it leaves a Windows port unbindable long enough for the replacement to die with `EADDRINUSE`. Waiting for the port to go quiet and only then starting the replacement is what makes the handover reliable. ## Verified, not asserted | Check | Result | | --- | --- | | Helper generation, offline (`runtime-test/CheckHelperScript.mjs`) | 11/11 | | End to end, real plugin code (`runtime-test/VerifyRestartPlugin.mjs`) | 21/21 | | **Real** launcher + **real** `dsh web`, full restart cycle (`runtime-test/SmokeRestartReal.ps1`) | pass | The end-to-end runs cover: the installer writing a managed patch row, the host half claiming its routes, an unauthenticated request being fenced off, the restart being accepted before the port goes away, a second click inside the guard window being refused, the port wait, the launcher handover, the successor process appearing, and the page noticing it. These live in the toolkit this plugin was built in; this repository is the packaged plugin. ## API Every route passes the connection trust fence (loopback peer + matching `Origin` + login cookie), so only an authenticated same-origin page can reach them. | Method | Path | Meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | GET | `/dsh-restart/status` | `instanceId` (this server's pid), port, workspace, launcher path and availability, whether a restart is in flight | | POST | `/dsh-restart/restart` | Arms a restart. A second request within 15 s gets `409`. The response carries **no** launch token | | GET | `/dsh-restart/log` | Tail of the shared restart log | If the automatic reload comes back unauthenticated — a fresh launch token is minted on every start — the page's own token is handed back to the *same* browser connection once, so it can reopen itself with `?token=…`. ## Logs `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\restart-plugin\logs\restart.log` — append-only, so the record of a restart survives the process that performed it. The helper writes the launcher's exit code, whether the port is still being served, and whether a fresh token file appeared, because the process that would normally log a failure is the one that just exited. ## Configuration | Variable | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `DSH_RESTART_INSTALL_DIR` | Launcher runtime directory (default `%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness`) | | `DSH_RESTART_DATA` | Plugin-private data directory (default `\restart-plugin`) | | `DSH_RESTART_LAUNCHER` | Point at another launcher script (portable installs, tests) | **Restart target.** By default it delegates to the launcher a hosted install already has (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeekHarness\Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`), which owns the reliable stop/start/readiness sequence. When that file is missing the button reports a clear error instead of pretending to work, and the status card shows the path it looked for. Making the plugin fully standalone is the next step on the roadmap. ## Safety - Authenticated same-origin loopback only; proxy-forwarded requests are not honoured. - No admin rights, no system configuration touched. - It **interrupts a running conversation turn** — that is what a restart is, and the card says so. - If the port is owned by a process the launcher does not recognise (a `dsh web` you started by hand), the restart takes that port over, including its terminal's process tree. ## Credits - **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** — the open-source agent harness this plugin extends and is built on: its `dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml` declaration, the dual host/browser plugin shape, and the webserver's trust fence. [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · MIT. - **[dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market)** — the community plugin market. Its `restart.js` is the reference for the approach used here: delegate to a detached helper, wait for the port instead of guessing with a fixed delay, and make a failed restart leave evidence. ## License MIT

plugins.description: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet for DSH on Linux (X11 / XWayland)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-desktop-linux

[**English**](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A desktop pet for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) on Linux: a small transparent,
always-on-top GTK3 window that floats over your desktop and animates according to
what your DSH sessions are doing — idle, working, waiting for an answer, failed,
or finished and awaiting review. It is not click-through: the window keeps its
input region, so clicks on the pet land on the pet.

**Platform: Linux with X11 or XWayland only.** Windows, macOS and native Wayland
(no XWayland) are not supported. See [Requirements](#requirements).

![The pet floating transparently over the desktop](assets/screenshots/desktop-pet-linux-1.png)

The window has no background and no border — the wallpaper shows through, and the
pet stays on top of ordinary windows. The sprite follows your DSH sessions:

![Idle, working, waiting, failed and review poses](assets/screenshots/desktop-pet-linux-2.png)

> **Canonical copy:** this plugin is only published as
> `dsh-pet-desktop-linux` (no scope) under the `Wlaeg` account. Any other
> package with this name is not ours.

---

## This is not a meta-package

This plugin ships **its own working program**; it is not a bundle that only
re-exports somebody else's dependency list:

| Part | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop program | `desktop/pet.py` | The pet window itself: GTK3 transparent window, spritesheet animation, right-click menu, work-status dialog |
| Host half | `lib/index.js` | Probes system dependencies, spawns/stops the Python program, exposes the HTTP routes, reads and writes the config file |
| Browser half | `client.js` | The **Desktop Pet** panel in DSH Settings, with the packaged `locale/{en,zh}.json` manifest strings |

The single dependency, `@michengai/dsh-codex-pet`, is used **only to read the pet
sprite sheets**. This plugin deliberately does not copy that artwork into its own
repository: store rules require a bundle's dependencies to resolve to the original
author's published package, so this plugin depends on the upstream npm package
and resolves the artwork path at runtime
(`require.resolve('@michengai/dsh-codex-pet/package.json')`). See
[Artwork and licensing](#artwork-and-licensing).

The upstream plugin draws a pet **inside the DSH web page**. This plugin draws a
**separate always-on-top desktop window** that works while the page is in the
background, minimized, or closed. They are different things, not duplicates.

---

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Platform | **Linux with X11 or XWayland.** Verified on Manjaro GNOME (Wayland session, pet runs through XWayland) |
| DSH | Any DSH build with the Cordis plugin system that provides `webServer` and the `settings.section` slot |
| Node | **>= 22** (DSH's own requirement) |
| Desktop session | A GTK3-capable session. Under GNOME/Wayland the pet is an XWayland client — a **pure Wayland session with XWayland disabled will not work** |
| npm dependencies | `@michengai/dsh-codex-pet` (artwork lookup only) |

### System packages

The Settings panel probes five of these — Python 3, PyGObject, GTK3, GdkPixbuf
and `xdotool` — and shows the matching install hint for your distribution when
one is missing. The other two rows (the WebP loader and `zstd`) are not probed;
check them yourself with the commands below if the pet starts but looks wrong.

| Component | Arch / Manjaro | Debian / Ubuntu | Fedora |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python 3 | `python` | `python3` | `python3` |
| Python 3 + PyGObject (`import gi`) | `python-gobject` | `python3-gi` | `python3-gobject` |
| GTK3 typelib | `gtk3` | `gir1.2-gtk-3.0` | `gtk3` |
| GdkPixbuf typelib | `gdk-pixbuf2` | `gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0` | `gdk-pixbuf2` |
| WebP loader for GdkPixbuf | *(built into `gdk-pixbuf2`)* | `webp-pixbuf-loader` | `webp-pixbuf-loader` |
| `zstd` CLI *(only if Python < 3.14)* | `zstd` | `zstd` | `zstd` |
| xdotool | `xdotool` | `xdotool` | `xdotool` |

```sh
# Arch / Manjaro
sudo pacman -S python python-gobject gtk3 gdk-pixbuf2 zstd xdotool

# Debian / Ubuntu
sudo apt install python3 python3-gi gir1.2-gtk-3.0 gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0 webp-pixbuf-loader zstd xdotool

# Fedora
sudo dnf install python3 python3-gobject gtk3 gdk-pixbuf2 webp-pixbuf-loader zstd xdotool
```

The session event files are zstd-compressed. Python 3.14 and newer decode them
with the standard library (`compression.zstd`); on older interpreters the plugin
falls back to the `zstd` command-line tool, so install `zstd` if your `python3`
is older than 3.14. Without either, the pet still runs but never leaves `idle`.

The sprite sheets are WebP files, so GdkPixbuf must be able to decode WebP.
Depending on your distribution's GdkPixbuf version this may need the separate
`webp-pixbuf-loader` package (Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora). You can check yours with
the command below; if it prints `False`, install the loader package:

```sh
python3 -c "import gi; gi.require_version('GdkPixbuf','2.0'); \
from gi.repository import GdkPixbuf; \
print('webp' in [f.get_name() for f in GdkPixbuf.Pixbuf.get_formats()])"
```

The plugin's dependency probe checks GTK3, GdkPixbuf and `xdotool` by name but
does not decode a WebP sprite itself; if the loader is missing, the pet window
appears and the sprite fails to load, which shows up in the log tail.

`xdotool` is used for the two EWMH window hints GTK3 cannot set by itself:
`_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE` (keep above) and `_NET_WM_STATE_STICKY` (show on every
workspace). Without it the pet still appears, but it will not stay on top of
other windows or follow you across workspaces.

Decoding goes through `GdkPixbuf.PixbufLoader` and frames are drawn as
`Gtk.Image` pixbufs, so **Pillow is not needed**, and because no drawing goes
through a `cairo.Context`, **pycairo is not needed either**.

---

## Installation

This is a DSH Cordis plugin **bundle**. Install it through DSH's plugin manager
(`plugin_manager`, action `install_bundle`), pointing `target` at either:

- the **Git repository** — `https://github.com/Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux`
- or a **local checkout** — the absolute path to this directory

Equivalently, from a DSH shell:

```sh
# once published to npm
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet-desktop-linux

# straight from the repository
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux

# from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pet-desktop-linux
```

The bundle declares its own patch in `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
    "client": {
      "platform": "web",
      "immediately": true,
      "inject": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer"]
    }
  },
  "icon": "./assets/icon.png"
}
```

(`dsh.client.inject` is a client-module **load-order** declaration: DSH loads the
listed packages' browser bundles before this one. It is not Cordis service
injection. The browser half declares the services it actually needs itself:
`return { inject: ['slots', 'locale'], apply }`.)

and that patch is a single `insert` that mounts the host half:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-pet-desktop-linux
      name: 'dsh-pet-desktop-linux'
      config: {}
```

The browser half is declared by `dsh.client` and bound to the row whose `name` is
the bare package name — subpath rows do not carry a browser half.

After installing, reload the DSH Web UI page so the browser half registers its
Settings panel. Nothing else is required: **DSH starts the pet window by itself**
as soon as it boots (`autostart` defaults to `true` — see “Configuration”). The
pet process stops when you stop it or uninstall the bundle.

> Replacing an already-installed copy (for example after editing the source)
> needs a restart of the DSH host process — the running process keeps the JS
> module generation it loaded at startup. A page reload is not enough.

---

## Features

**Window**

- Borderless, transparent GTK3 window — only the pet is visible, the window
  background is fully transparent
- Always on top (`_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE`), so it stays above normal windows
- Sticky across workspaces (`_NET_WM_STATE_STICKY`, via `xdotool`) — no API for
  this exists in GT

# 避峰岗（dsh-peak-valley-router）

> 峰时站岗换班：谷时让 DeepSeek 干苦力，峰时换 ChatGPT Plus 顶班，你的 API 账单从此不再被高峰期收割。

DeepSeek Harness 的跨 provider 峰谷路由插件 + 公开 SKILL。详见 [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)。

当前版本：**v0.12.0**（pre-1.0）。版本号唯一来源是 `package.json`；运行时可在设置页标题下方或 `debug.log` 的 `apply: vX.Y.Z, …` 行确认当前加载的是哪一版。变更记录与版本策略见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

## 它做什么

- **设置页「避峰岗」**：配置有序策略。每条策略 = 触发条件（生效星期 + 峰时窗口）+ 主模型（谷时）+ 可选副模型（峰时）。另有**高级思考模型**，它是**另一根轴**：只在会话本身要求 `max` 思考时使用（`reasoningEffort === 'max'`），**不作为未命中策略时的兜底**。未命中任何策略的时刻（周末、假期）→ 用**第一个方案的主模型**。设置页顶部会写明「此刻生效：model@effort · 原因」，例如「无匹配方案（周末/假期），用首个方案的主力模型」，所以任何一次目标都能解释，不会像故障。
- **Provider / 模型一律下拉选择**：候选来自运行时**已注册的全部 provider**——API 与你装的订阅套餐并列（如 DeepSeek、ChatGPT Plus / Codex、Claude、Grok、Copilot、Antigravity），模型经该 provider 的 `listModels` 接口读取。避峰岗自身**不会**出现在候选里：它是 provider 之上的一层选择器逻辑，不是 provider。
- **左侧「启用避峰岗」开关**：默认关闭 = 纯透传，行为与未装插件一致。开启后由避峰岗决定实际调用的模型，**连会话里已经选过的模型也会被改写**（会话自带的模型选择器本身不改动，只做功能接管 + 尽力而为的置灰提示）。
- **每会话独立状态 + 会话列表小灯 + 全局解耦**：
  - **全局 = 总闸**：侧边栏底部那个开关，切换它会对所有「跟随中」的会话一次性生效（扫一遍）。
  - **局部可单独改**：composer 输入区左侧第一个按钮切换**当前会话**；一旦单独改过，该会话就**不再被全局切换带走**（两个方向都是）。
  - **显式的「全局解耦」开关**：composer 左侧第二个按钮。两个圆环相接＝跟随全局，分开＝已解耦；点一下在「解耦 / 接回」之间切换。它**只切换连接关系**，不改变此刻是否生效。右键第一个按钮也能恢复跟随（等价快捷方式）。
  - **会话列表小灯**：每行一个微微发蓝光的小灯，亮 = 该会话此刻生效；已解耦的会多一圈淡环。全局默认开着时每行都会亮（它们跟随默认），只有被单独关掉的会话不亮。
  - **全局侧可见**：侧边栏开关的提示里会显示「· N 个已解耦」。
  - **已知限制**：行首位置由宿主条件渲染，下列四种行**不渲染**该插槽，小灯在这些时刻不显示——归档（archived）、空白（blank）、**正在运行**（显示状态点）、**有未读标记**。依据：`.recon/workspace.client.js` 里 `!row.archived && !row.blank && (showStatus ? … : unread ? … : renderSlot("sidebar.session.row.leading", …))`。这是宿主行为，插件不去改它。
  - 另需注意：小灯反映的是**开关意图**，不是"此刻一定生效"。若策略目标不在 provider 目录里（模型下线/改名），路由会**静默回落到会话原模型**，只在 `debug.log` 留一行——此时小灯仍是亮的。
- **多端可用**：开关同时挂在左侧边栏底部与 composer 输入区左侧。窄屏（<1024px 侧边栏自动收起、Windows/macOS 收起态整列宽度为 0）时由 composer 入口兜底，两个入口共享同一份状态。

## 目录

- `SKILL.md` — 「避峰岗」技能说明
- `lib/index.js` — Node 端：策略引擎、`agentDefaultModel` 门控、`agent/request` 覆盖、RPC
- `lib/text.js` — **唯一维护文件**：默认定义（`DEFAULTS`）+ 中英文案（`zh`/`en`）
- `src/client/*.js` — 客户端源码（开关 / 选择器 / 策略编辑 / 设置页 / 入口）
- `lib/client.js` — **生成物**：由 `src/build-client.mjs` 拼接各 source 并注入 `lib/text.js` 文案，请勿手改
- `src/build-client.mjs` — 客户端构建脚本
- `scripts/verify.mjs` — 仓库自检（契约、不变式、版本一致性、产物新鲜度）
- `scripts/roundtrip.test.mjs` — 副模型往返回归（防止形状错配复发）
- `scripts/copy.test.mjs` — 界面文案单一来源与本地化映射检查
- `scripts/session-state.test.mjs` — 每会话状态语义（覆盖 / 跟随默认 / 清除 / 容量上限 / 会话 id 读取）
- `scripts/session-fuzz.mjs` — 随机化差分属性测试：200 次随机操作 × 12 个探针 id（含 `__proto__`、`constructor`、超长与 Unicode id），**期望值独立地从 `state.json` 重算**，用来抓跨会话串扰与身份透传违规（`npm run fuzz`，可传种子）
- `CHANGELOG.md` — 变更记录与版本策略
- `cordis.patch.yml` — 自激活 patch（bundle 安装用）
- `package.json` — 插件清单（含 `dsh.client` 声明）

## 开发

```bash
node src/build-client.mjs   # 重建 lib/client.js（改了 src/client 或 lib/text.js 后必跑）
npm run verify              # 五套检查（只读，不写任何产物）
npm run fuzz                # 只跑随机化差分属性测试（可传随机种子）
```

`npm run verify` 覆盖：文案 key 完整性/双语对称、client↔node RPC 契约、关键不变式
（`inject=['llm']`、`agent/request` 带 `prepend`、无 `registerAdapter`/`llm/stream` 残留、
未触碰会话模型选择器）、版本一致性（`package.json` ↔ `CHANGELOG.md` ↔ `README.md`/`SKILL.md`
的「当前版本」）、产物新鲜度（**构建到临时文件比对，不重写仓库里的产物**）、仓库顶层文件集合、
副模型形状往返、界面文案无硬编码中文、每会话状态语义、随机化差分属性测试。

## 安装

1. 装成 bundle（推荐，GUI 生效）：
   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库路径或 git URL>
   ```
2. 或手工 patch `insert`（仅 Node 端，无 GUI）：
   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-peak-valley-router
         name: <本仓库/lib/index.js 绝对路径>
         config: { ...见 SKILL.md 的配置结构... }
   ```

装完**重启 DSH**，打开「设置 → 避峰岗」即可在 GUI 里配置多模型协同策略。

## 峰谷规则

- 高峰：北京时间周一至周五（不含法定节假日）09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00
- 谷时：其余时间（含周末、节假日全天），价格为峰时 1/2

## 运行时数据

插件只在 `DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-peak-valley-router/` 下写三个文件：

- `policy.json` — GUI 保存的策略
- `state.json` — 开关状态：`{ enabled, sessions }`。`enabled` 是**全局默认**，`sessions` 是**每会话覆盖**表（没有覆盖的会话跟随默认；上限 500 条，按最近写入淘汰）。旧文件（只有 `enabled`）行为完全不变。
- `debug.log` — 诊断日志（只在 apply / 目录读取失败 / 开关切换 / 每个新接管目标时各记一行）

## 已知限制

- **跨窗口/多进程不同步**：开关状态在插件加载时读一次，客户端也不轮询。同一台机器上开两个窗口，A 的改动要等 B 重新加载才可见；两个 DSH 进程共用同一个 `DSH_HOME` 时，各自持有自己的快照，后写的一方会覆盖**整张** `sessions` 表（写入是原子的，但没有合并语义）。单窗口单进程使用不受影响。
- **目标模型不在目录里时静默回落**：策略目标（主模型/副模型/高级思考模型）若不在该 provider 当前的模型目录中（下线、改名、订阅登出），路由会保留会话原模型，只在 `debug.log` 记一行。此时开关与小灯仍显示"开"——它们反映的是**开关意图**，不是"此刻一定生效"。
- **配额/限流不归避峰岗管**：它只决定"用哪个 provider/model"。若目标 provider 的账号池处于 429 冷却（如订阅套餐的 5 小时窗口用尽），请求会在 provider 层失败。避峰岗不会自动改道到别的模型——那会让"为什么换模型"变得不可预测；需要时请改配置或暂时关掉开关。
- **行首小灯的显示条件**：见上文「每会话独立状态」一节的四条隐藏条件（宿主行为）。
- **并发点击**：写盘期间开关按钮是禁用的，被丢弃的那次点击不会报错（没有队列）。

plugins.description: 给 DSH 里助手回复加气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质；工具条、过程行、统计行等周边信息也能一起同步
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-assistant-bubble [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) 使用皮肤插件从wallpaper里导入深色壁纸时，会发现ai回复的文字是无背景的，导致字和壁纸糊在一起无法阅读。所以让大肥鱼单独写了一个小插件实现气泡功能。 这下可以愉快地使用壁纸了。 . 有一些气泡间距的小问题，可能对观感有小影响，但是不太好修，所以就放在那里了， 插件开启前 开启后。气泡透明度之类的可以自己调，单独在设置里开了“助手回复气泡”的分区页。 ————以下内容都是肥鱼写的 给 DSH 里**助手回复**加一层自己的气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质；工具条、过程行、统计行等周边信息也能一起同步。 ## 为什么需要它 DSH 官方会话界面里，气泡（`..._bubble`）只属于**你发送的消息**；助手回复是一段**没有背景**的正文， 直接压在壁纸上。所以壁纸 / 皮肤类插件的"气泡不透明度""玻璃透明度"都管不到助手回复 —— 深色壁纸下助手的字就看不清了。这个插件补的就是这一块。 ## 功能 - **助手回复气泡**：圆角 + 可调底色；可选液态玻璃（白釉高光 + 模糊 + 厚玻璃折射 + 落地阴影）。 - **周边信息同步**：工具条（复制 / 点赞 / 分享 / 用量 / 时间）、过程折叠行、过程分组头（运行中）、 思考触发条、会话统计行、上下文占用环、运行行 —— 同一份材质、同一组参数，滑块一动一起变。 - **只给"真的有内容"的元素画底**：每个锚点都先核对有没有看得见的文字（≥2 个字）或可见的按钮 / 图标， 空壳一律不画 —— 所以不会出现"只有底色、没有文字"的空白气泡。 - **「工作步骤展示」明细行**：工具调用行（「运行命令」「网页获取」等）与「思考」行也有气泡 —— **折叠**时是紧凑小胶囊、**展开**时保持宿主原本的大横条。 - **非会话页面也有底**：「插件」「自动化任务」「技能中心」「上下文洞察」这些独立页面在皮肤下同样能看清文字 —— 用一条**通用规则**覆盖所有注册到主内容槽的页面（含第三方），并排除会话槽，所以聊天区仍是"气泡浮在壁纸上"。 设置页里有一个**可展开的分组**，可以单独开关、单独调浓度。 - **操作条常驻**：取消宿主"非最后一条要悬停才显示"的门控。 - **宽度跟随内容**：气泡不拉满整行。 - **宽表格收进气泡**：宿主原本让宽表格按滚动容器整屏出血，这里改为气泡内横向滚动。 - **无障碍**：系统开启「减少透明度」时自动去掉模糊与白釉。 ## 非会话页面 皮肤把 AppFrame 的背景令牌弄透明后，独立页面的文字会直接压在壁纸上。插件用一条通用规则给这些页面的内容根铺底， 并在设置里给了独立开关与浓度： ![非会话页面铺底（插件页示例）](docs/assets/non-chat-pages.png) 设置 → 助手回复气泡 → 最下方那个**可折叠分组**（折叠时只有一行字，展开后是开关 + 滑块）： ![设置里的「非会话页面底色」](docs/assets/page-setting.png) ## 安装 **目前最省事的方式：在 dsh-market（插件市场）里搜 `Assistant bubble` 或作者 `yutianliang`，点一下安装。** 或者直接从 GitHub 装（最新 `main`）： ```bash # 从 GitHub 安装（最新 main） dsh plugin --profile web add github:yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble ``` 官方桌面端也可以走侧边栏 **插件** 页 → 添加插件 → 填 `github:yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble`。 本地改代码时用 `link:`：`dsh plugin --profile web add link:E:\path\to\dsh-assistant-bubble`。 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-assistant-bubble`。 ## 设置 安装后，**设置 →「助手回复气泡」**（独立分区，10 个控件）： | 控件 | 作用 | 默认 | | --- | --- | --- | | 液态玻璃 | 白釉高光 + 模糊 + 厚玻璃折射；关掉 = 平实心气泡 | 开 | | 周边信息同步 | 上面那七处周边信息是否同材质 | 开 | | 气泡不透明度 | 关闭液态玻璃时的底色浓度 | 60% | | 玻璃底色浓度 | 玻璃挡下的底色浓度，越高越不透 | 50% | | 雾化 | 玻璃的模糊半径 | 3px | | 玻璃颜色 | 6 个预设色块 + 取色器自定义 | #ffffff（深色 #12141a） | | 白釉强度 | 表面高光与边缘折射强度，0–200% | 100% | | 深色单独设置 | 打开后深色主题用另一套上面四项 | 关 | | 非会话页面底色 | 给「插件」「自动化任务」「技能中心」「上下文洞察」等独立页面铺底（可展开分组） | 开 | | 页面底色浓度 | 独立页面的底色浓度，只影响非会话页面 | 60% | 值保存在浏览器本地 `localStorage["dsh-assistant-bubble:settings"]`（清缓存会回默认值）。 ## 兼容性 - **不声明 `engines` / `peerDependencies`**：安装与启用不会被版本检查拦下。 - 客户端半区**不声明** `dsh.client.inject`：模块无条件加载，气泡样式一定生效； `slots` / `locale` 两个服务用 `ctx.inject` 运行时等待，拿不到只丢设置页。 - 唯一外部依赖是宿主写在 DOM 上的语义属性与 CSS-Module 类名后缀。宿主大版本更新后最坏的情况是 **样式静默失效**（看起来像没装），不会报错、不会牵连其它插件。 ## 实现要点 所有参数走 CSS 变量，设置页把值内联写到 `body` 上： ``` --dab-solid-alpha 实心气泡底浓度 --dab-glass-alpha 玻璃挡底浓度 --dab-glass-color 玻璃色（r, g, b） --dab-blur 雾化半径 --dab-sheen 白釉强度倍数 ``` 玻璃配方对齐 [`dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine`](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine) 的玻璃面： 白釉渐变 + `blur() saturate(1.3) brightness(1.04)` + 双向内阴影折射 + 落地阴影。 ### 思考面板的标题行 展开「思考」时，宿主会给面板内部的**粘性标题行**铺一层实心底色（`--dsw-alias-bg-base`，深色主题下近黑， 展开后就是压在内容上的一条黑带）。这里把它换成**同一颜色的半透明版**并保留吸顶： ```css background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dsw-alias-bg-base) 80%, transparent) ``` 滚到顶部时仍能遮住下方内容，但不再是一条实心黑条。（不用 `backdrop-filter`：那会把下方的浅色文字 糊成一条白带。） ### 挂在哪些锚点上 | 位置 | 锚点 | | --- | --- | | 助手回复正文 | `[data-chat-flow-kind="assistant-step"] div[class*="_root"] > div[class*="_body"]` | | 工具条（复制 / 点赞 / 用量 / 时间） | `[data-turn-tail] [class*="_actions"]` | | 过程折叠行「已完成，用时 N 秒」 | `[data-turn-process]` | | 过程分组头「正在分析请求 · ⋯」 | `[data-process-activity]` | | 思考触发条 | `[data-turn-trigger]` | | 工具调用行（运行命令 / 网页获取…） | `[data-tool] [data-disclosure-row]` | | 「思考」行 | `[data-variant="think"] [data-disclosure-row]` | | 会话统计行「N 轮 M 步 · tok/s」 | `[data-composer-stats]` | | 上下文占用环「41%」 | `button[class*="_trigger"]:has(> svg[viewBox="0 0 14 14"])` | | 运行行「深度求索中⋯」 | `[data-chat-running]` | | 宽表格 | `.md-table-wide` | ## 开发 实现细节、设计取舍与踩过的坑见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。 ## License MIT

plugins.description: DSH 助手人格与长期记忆插件：独立可用，不依赖其它插件。管 AI 自身的名字与角色、对用户的称呼、回复风格与自定义指令；人设支持全局 + 按工作区两级覆盖；长期记忆走三段式（候选捕获 → 待审缓冲区 → 用户裁决才生效），并支持一键导入其它 AI 的历史记忆。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-anima

DSH 的**助手人格与外挂记忆层**——一个独立插件，装上即可用。

它管的是「**你自己（助手）是谁**」：AI 的名字与角色、你对它的称呼、回复风格、
以及你自己写的行为准则；再加一套**带待审缓冲区的长期记忆**，
以及输入框光轨、输入框快捷开关、工具确认门槛这些界面能力。
字段集不依赖任何其它插件，也不从别处读取配置。

> **工具名为什么是 `set_assistant_persona`**：`tools.register()` 遇同层重名直接抛错
> （`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2634`），与生态里任何同名工具共存时必有一方注册失败、
> 被 `.catch` 吞成一行 warn —— 那是发布级的静默故障。功能相似不要求撞名。

---

## 它解决什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **AI 自己的名字与角色** | `agentName` / `agentRole` —— 决定它怎么称呼自己、以什么身份说话 |
| 用户的称呼 / 背景 / 语气 / 长度 / 语言 | `addressUserAs` / `userOccupation` / `userBio` / `style` / `replyLength` / `language` |
| **按工作区两层覆盖** | 只覆盖声明的字段，其余继承全局；覆盖文件随目录走、可 git |
| **长期记忆** | 自动沉淀 → 待审缓冲区 → 用户裁决 → 注入 |
| 输入框光轨 / 快捷开关 / 工具确认 | 界面与安全开关 |
| 人设预设 | 6 条内置 + 自建；也可把当前配置存成预设 |
| **十二个字段全是自由文本** | 存的就是注入的原话，另有「一键填入 + 示例」按钮组 |
| **记忆随工作区分层** | 全局记忆处处生效，工作区记忆只在匹配时注入 |
| **注入可解释 / 字符预算** | 每条为什么进 / 不进，条数与字符双约束 |
| **本地聚类与冲突提示** | 纯本地 bigram 相似度，只提示不自动合并 |
| **人设变更审计日志** | 谁在什么时候把哪个字段改成什么 |
| **一键导入外部 AI 的记忆** | 复制提示词 → 粘贴结果 → 机械切分 → 逐条裁决层级 |
| 长期记忆的「自动写入」 | ❌ 刻意不做（见下） |

### 关于与 `dsh-soul` 的关系

上表左侧的能力划分与 `dsh-soul` 0.7.0 的字段集**有交集**，实现上也刻意与它保持一致
（工具确认语义、光轨动效参数、重置保留预设）。但本插件**不依赖它**：
字段集完整自持，不读它的配置文件，两者可同时安装且标识全部错开。
这层关系的完整说明见下方「[致谢与差异化声明](#致谢与差异化声明)」。

## 四个差异化设计

功能对齐不等于没有自己的判断。以下四点是本插件相对主流记忆插件的**真实增量**，
每一条都对应一个具体的失败模式。

### 1. 双约束注入：条数与字符同时生效

多数实现只有一个「最多注入 N 条」的上限。问题是 40 条长记忆一样能挤爆上下文，
而用户看到的是「我只设了 40 条啊」。

本插件的 `selectForInjection` 同时受 `memory.maxInjected`（条数，默认 40）与
`memory.maxInjectedChars`（字符，默认 4000）约束，**取先到者**。两条上限各有各的适用场景：
条数管「别让模型看太多碎片」，字符管「别让一次注入吃掉半屏上下文」。

### 2. 注入可解释：看得见每条为什么进 / 不进

注入不是黑箱。设置页的「注入情况」列出**每一条已采纳记忆**的去留与原因：

| 原因码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `included` | 已注入提示词 |
| `other-workspace` | 属于别的工作区，不在本会话注入 |
| `no-workspace-context` | 当前会话没有工作区信息，无法匹配工作区记忆 |
| `workspace-scope-unknown` | 标记为工作区记忆但没记录属于哪个工作区 |
| `over-max` | 已采纳条数超过注入上限，按时间取最新的 |
| `over-budget` | 单条就超出字符预算，取不下 |
| `dropped-by-budget` | 前面几条已占满字符预算 |
| `no-injection` | 记忆层已关闭或上限为 0 |

区分 `over-budget` 与 `dropped-by-budget` 是刻意的：前者要删那条，后者要腾位置 ——
报同一个码，用户不知道该动谁。原因文案由宿主下发（`INJECTION_REASON_TEXT` 只有一份），
客户端不重写翻译。

### 3. 本地聚类：只提示，不自动合并

待审缓冲区里若有多条明显在说同一件事，插件用**字符二元组（bigram）的 Jaccard 系数**
（纯本地、零依赖、零模型调用）算出相似度，把「这 3 条像在说同一件事」摆到用户面前。

**刻意不做自动合并**：合并意味着生成一段用户没说过的话。本插件的立场是
「判断什么值得记交给模型，什么真的生效交给用户」——自动合并恰好违背它。
聚类只让裁决更快，不替他裁决。同理「候选撞上已采纳记忆」只提示冲突，不改任何数据。

### 4. 人设变更审计日志

本插件有三个入口能改人设：设置页、`/anima` 命令、模型调用的 `set_assistant_persona` 工具。
而「工具确认」**默认是关的** —— 也就是说，模型可以直接把你叫它什么、它用什么语气回话改掉，
而你无从知道是谁在什么时候干的。

审计日志只记「改了什么」，不做判断、不参与提示词。它挂在 `StateStore.updateConfig` 这**一个**
收口上，而不是在各调用点分别埋点：所有写入路径最终都走这里，分散埋点迟早会漏掉一条，
而漏掉的那条恰恰可能是模型的静默改写。`resetConfig` 也走审计 —— 否则
「昨天还好好的，今天全空了」在日志里查无此事。

记录上限 200 条，独立成表（不塞进 `config`）：`config` 每次启动整条读入内存，
审计会涨到几百条，混在一起等于让启动开销随使用时长上升。
长值在写入时截断为 200 字并附「共 N 字」，数组/对象只记规模 —— 审计是索引，不是备份。

看到它的地方有两处：设置页「变更记录」卡（完整列表，可按条清空），
以及 `/anima show` 的**「最近变更」一行**——只显示最新那条，格式是
`[MM-DD HH:mm] <来源>：<字段名>`，**刻意不带具体值**：值可能很私人，而 `show`
的输出会被复制到对话里问人。

## 致谢与差异化声明

本插件的功能集**参考**了 [dsh-soul](https://github.com/Aliuyanfeng/dsh-soul)（MIT）与
`dsh-checkpoint-rewind` 的设计，并在若干处刻意与它们保持行为一致（存储惰性解析、
失败关闭的确认语义、重置保留用户预设、光轨动效参数）。

需要明确的是：

- **代码全部独立实现**，未拷贝上述项目的源码、注释、提示词文案或图形资源。
- 两处**动效参数刻意取同值**（8 层错位描边、虚线段长 12 / 步进 2.2 / 圆角 22 等），
  理由是避免同一台机器上出现两套观感。这类数值属于思想与参数，不受著作权保护；
  记在这里是为了不让读者误以为拷贝。
- **导航图标刻意画得不同形**：dsh-soul 用「光轨弧 + 火花」，本插件用「人像（头+肩）+ 火花」，
  单色 `currentColor`，viewBox 也另行收紧。
- **各类标识全部错开**，避免共存时互相顶替或注册失败：

  | 类别 | dsh-soul | 本插件 |
  |---|---|---|
  | 工具名 | `set_persona` | `set_assistant_persona` |
  | 设置页 id | `soul-settings` | `anima-settings` |
  | 光轨槽位 id | `soul-trail` | `anima-trail` |
  | 开关槽位 id | `soul-quick-toggle` | `anima-quick-toggle` |
  | 提示词 section | `soul:persona` | `anima:identity` / `:memory` / `:pending` |
  | 存储域 | —（自有文件） | `anima` |
  | 注入来源 kind | `plugin:dsh-soul` | `plugin:dsh-anima` |

工具名错开不只是礼貌：`dsh-tools` 的 `register()` 遇同层重名**直接抛错**
（`lib/index.js` 的 `NamedEntries` 冲突工厂），两者共存时必有一方注册失败、
并被 `.catch` 吞成一行 warn —— 那是发布级的静默故障。



## 核心设计：三段式记忆

这是本插件与市面上 15+ 记忆插件最不一样的地方。

```
对话中通过 remember 工具投递
        ↓
   待审缓冲区（不生效）
        ↓  每晚自动整理：去重 / 淘汰 / 与已采纳项比对
        ↓
   通知用户「有 N 条待你裁决」
        ↓
   用户在设置页逐个「采纳 / 丢弃 / 删除」
        ↓
   已采纳 → 注入提示词
```

**为什么不做静默自动写入**：记忆一旦静默写入就直接影响后续所有回答，写错了用户很难发现。
本插件把「判断什么值得记」交给模型，把「什么真的生效」交给用户。

整理这一步**纯本地、不调用模型**——只做去重、淘汰、与已采纳项比对，不做语义归纳。

记忆**分两层**：`global` 处处生效，`workspace` 只在 `cwd` 归一化后完全相等时注入。
不做「子目录继承」——工作区覆盖是精确匹配语义，记忆若采用继承语义，
用户在子目录里会看到父目录的记忆，排查起来极难。
分层之外的注入解释、预算与聚类见上文「四个差异化设计」。

## 凭据闸门

任何命中凭据形态的内容**在进入缓冲区之前就被拒收**（不落盘、不留痕），
覆盖私钥块、OpenAI/AWS/GitHub 令牌、通用 api_key / secret / 密码赋值、Bearer、
URL 内嵌凭据等 11 类模式。

理由：内容一旦落盘缓冲区，就处于「等待进入提示词」的状态，凭据不该走这条路。
凭据判定用的是 11 类正则的机械匹配，没有语义理解，会有误判——所以被拦下时界面会
把命中规则名一起说出来，用户可以删掉那串字符再粘贴。

## 一键导入外部 AI 的记忆

设置页记忆卡里有一个「导入外部 AI 的记忆」按钮，展开后是两步：

1. **复制提示词**——把一段整理画像的提示词发给你用得最多的那个 AI，让它把你的偏好
   整理成清单。按钮只在真的写进剪贴板后才显示「已复制」；没有剪贴板 API 时会明说
   「复制失败，请手动选中后复制」，不假装成功。
2. **粘贴结果**——粘贴框接受 AI 的输出，也接受你自己手写的笔记（不要求必须是 AI 生成的）。

解析后逐条预览，每条都能改层级（全局 / 本工作区）或直接丢弃，确认后才写进**待审缓冲区**
——和手动添加、模型投递走同一条路，仍然要用户逐条裁决才生效。

**切分是机械的，不做语义理解**：按 Markdown 标题、列表项、空行三种边界切；刻意不按句号切，
因为中文画像里「偏好：结论先行。」被切成两条会读不通。小节标签（如「我的使用画像」）
不进候选——它长得像记忆但没有可采纳内容。

**归类是建议不是判决**：`suggestLayer` 只看措辞——提到具体磁盘路径或「本项目 / 这个项目」
建议 `workspace`，提到「所有项目 / 一律 / 每次都要」建议 `global`。两条都没有时默认 `global`，
理由是把「记忆动不动就不生效」当默认体验，比跨项目污染更糟。每条建议都带一句理由显示在
条目下方，用户看到「本工作区」就能立刻知道凭什么。

**解析阶段就分流**：一条原文切完后按顺序过五道闸，没通过的会被分别归到不同的桶里，
每一桶都在界面上显示出来，**不静默少一条**：

| 处置 | 判定 | 界面上 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 过短（`< 4` 信息量） | 切出的碎片太短，通常是编号残留 | 只在汇总里报个数 |
| 超长（`> 500` 字） | 单条超过记忆上限 | 不截断，明确告知「请拆成几条」 |
| 凭据 | 命中 11 类正则之一 | 整条拦下并说明命中了哪条规则 |
| 重复 | 与已有记忆文本相同 | 单独列出 |
| 超条数 | 超出单次上限（默认 60 条） | 余下部分不进这一批，另开一次导入 |
| 同义 | 与待审缓冲区里的某条相似度 ≥ 0.6 | 在条目下方提示「已有一条很像」，**不自动合并** |

原文上限 40000 字符，超出直接报错而不是截断（截断等于偷偷丢掉用户画像的后半段）。
同义提示刻意只提示不合并：自动合并会生成一段用户从没说过的话。

---

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

本插件尚未发布到 npm，从仓库直接装：

```
dsh plugin add github:Melody-cx/dsh-anima#v1.0.0
```

或者手工改 profile 的 `package.json`：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-anima": "github:Melody-cx/dsh-anima#v1.0.0"
  },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ... */ "dsh-anima" ] } }
}
```

`#v1.0.0` 是标签（也可以写 commit SHA，或整个省略以跟随 `main`）。**建议 pin 住一个版本**，
否则上游的任何改动都会在下次安装时直接进入你的 profile。git 源下载的是**整个仓库 tarball**
（本仓库很小），首次安装可能比 npm 源慢一些，超时的话重试一次即可。

然后 `pnpm install`，**重启 DSH**。宿主侧改动一律需要重启才生效。

### 从源码安装（开发用）

在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖（也可以用 `/plugins` 界面）：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-anima": "file:<仓库目录的绝对路径>"
  },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ... */ "dsh-anima" ] } }
}
```

本地 `file:` 依赖是**复制**语义：改完源码要**重新安装**才生效，且重跑安装时若 pnpm 判定
`changed:false` 会直接跳过 —— 正确姿势是先 `remove_bundle` 再 `install_bundle`
（或比对 `node_modules` 副本与源码的 SHA256）。

**运行前提**（`package.json` 里已声明，装不上时先看这几条）：

- `engines.node` = `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，`engines.dsh` = `>=0.1.6-0 <0.2.0 || >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`
- `peerDependencies` 四包：`@deepseek-ai/cordis`（`^4.0.1 || ^4.0.5-alpha.1`）、
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`
  —— 它们由宿主提供，插件不打包它们
- `dependencies.zod`（`^4.4.3`）是唯一真正要装的运行时依赖
- 存储栈需在 profile 里组合：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json`（配 `root`）
  + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`（配 `backend: json`）。缺了不会崩，但插件会退化成
  「存储不可用」，设置页会明说原因（见下「存储」一节）

## 配置

设置页新增一栏「**灵台**」（`settings.section` id = `anima-settings`，order 51）。

- **助手身份**：`enabled` / `agentName` / `agentRole` / `addressUserAs` / `userOccupation` / `userBio`
- **回复风格**：`style` / `headingLists` / `emoji` / `tables` / `replyLength` / `language` / `customInstructions`
- **工作区覆盖**：`workspaceOverridesEnabled` / `workspaceFileDir`
  覆盖文件默认写在 `<工作区>/.dsh-anima/override.json`（目录名可用 `workspaceFileDir` 改），随目录走、可 git、可拷给别人；
  该目录会自动写入 `.gitignore`（内容 `*`），避免私人语气设定被推到远程。
- **输入框光轨**：`trailEnabled` / `trailColor`（`#RRGGBB`，落盘统一大写）/ `trailSpeed`（`slow|normal|fast`）/ `trailWidth`（`thin|normal|thick`）
- **工具确认**：`requireToolConfirmation` —— 开启后模型调 `set_assistant_persona` 只**提交提议**，不写配置
- **长期记忆**：`memory.enabled` / `autoCapture` / `nightlyTriage` / `nightlyHour` / `maxPending` /
  `maxInjected` / `maxInjectedChars` / `notifyOnSessionStart` / `defaultLayer`

### 不做任何迁移

本插件**不读任何其它插件或自己旧版本的配置**。它是 1.0.0，此前没有发布过任何版本 ——
没有「老用户的介质」这种东西需要兼容，所以代码里既没有一次性迁移，也没有存储格式回退。
这两块曾存在于开发期，都已删除；留着它们的唯一作用是让后人以为有一批需要照顾的存

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes the running Harness as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for other agent harnesses.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH MCP Server

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that publishes a **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** server from the
running Harness host, so other agent harnesses — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, another DSH, any MCP
client — can call DSH: start sessions, drive turns, wait for them, read transcripts, and cancel work.

The plugin is a Host-only bundle with **zero dependencies** (no DSH import, no third-party module),
so it installs into a profile and survives Harness upgrades that keep the service contracts.
Every request is attributed to the calling agent and every session is recorded against its creator,
so several harnesses can share one endpoint and still ask "which sessions are mine?".

The same tool table is also registered into the local Harness, so a DSH agent calls these tools
directly — switchable on this bundle's row in the Web **Plugins** page, and clamped to the calling
session's own authority (see [DSH-local tools](#dsh-local-tools)).

```
other harness ──MCP (Streamable HTTP or stdio)──> DSH MCP Server ──> DSH services
                                                                     sessionController / sessionQuery / tools
```

## What it exposes

| MCP tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dsh_run_prompt` | Start a **new** DSH session and run one prompt; returns the assistant's final text and the new `sessionId`. Supports `cwd`, `agentPreset`, `permissionPreset`, `model` (`provider/model`), `wait: false`, `timeoutMs`. |
| `dsh_continue_session` | Send a prompt to an **existing** session (resuming it if it is cold). Keeps the session's context and workspace; `permissionPreset` re-pins the session's sandbox mode and approval policy before the prompt, and `model` (`provider/model`) overrides the session's model. Without `model` the session keeps the model it already runs. |
| `dsh_list_commands` | The slash commands a session's agent can currently run: the global command layer plus whatever that agent's preset composes, so availability differs per agent preset. |
| `dsh_run_command` | Run one slash command in a session and return its settled `{ kind, text, commandId }`. `line` takes a complete command line (`"/compact"`, `"/permission danger-full-access"`); `command` (+ optional `args`) takes a bare name. The command executes immediately without a model turn. |
| `dsh_list_sessions` | A page of the session index: `sessionId`, title, running state, archival state, activity time, and the recorded owning agent (`view: "full"` adds cwd and liveness). Narrow server-side with `query` (title/cwd/owner/id), `mine: true` (or the `restrictToOwner` setting), `owner: "<id>"`, and `running`; page with `cursor`/`nextCursor`. Archived sessions are hidden unless `includeArchived: true`, mirroring the Web UI. |
| `dsh_read_session` | A window of one session's transcript (user-authored and assistant messages only), plus the last durable `permissionPreset`. `mode: "tail"` (default, last 10) / `"head"` / `"outline"` (one compact row per message with a preview and length, no full text); `roles`, `afterSeq` + `window.nextAfterSeq` to page, `maxChars` (default 2000) to cap a single answer. Reports `totalMessages`, `matchedMessages` and `returned`, so the caller always knows what it has not read. `limit: 0` still means everything. Works while the session is archived. |
| `dsh_answer_request` | Answer a parked decision, only when the deployment sets `answerUserRequests: true`: `decision: "allow"|"deny"` for an approval (a one-shot grant, or a denial) or `answers: [{ id, selected }]` for a question. Ids come from `dsh_list_requests`, which marks what this endpoint parked with `answerable: true`. The GUI stays in the race — whoever decides first wins — and an unanswered request still fails closed at `requestAnswerTimeoutMs`. An internal DSH caller may only settle an **approval** while it already holds `danger-full-access`; questions are always answerable (see [DSH-local tools](#dsh-local-tools)). |
| `dsh_wait_session` | Block until the turn a session is already running ends, then return the assistant text it produced — for `wait: false` starts, GUI-driven sessions, or another caller's work. Never prompts, steers, or cancels: reaching `timeoutMs` returns `status: "timedOut"` with the turn still running, so call it again; `status: "idle"` returns immediately when nothing is running. |
| `dsh_list_requests` | The user decisions a session — or the newest visible sessions, running first — is waiting on: approval requests (`approval/asked` with no matching `approval/decided`, the one-shot permission decision behind a sandbox escalation) and unanswered `ask_user_question` calls, with tool, reason, call id and seq. These audit events are invisible to the model, so this is how a caller learns *why* a delegated turn stopped progressing. Reporting only: the decision is granted in the Harness GUI. |
| `dsh_search_sessions` | Find sessions by content server-side and get bounded snippets instead of transcripts: title/cwd/owner/id (`scope: "title"`) or the messages themselves (`"messages"`, `"both"` by default). Looks at the newest `scan` sessions the caller can see (default 20), reports `where`/`seq`/`snippet` per match, and then `dsh_read_session` reads just that session. |
| `dsh_whoami` | How this endpoint identifies the calling agent — `x-dsh-mcp-client` header, else `initialize` `clientInfo`, else `User-Agent` — plus the sessions that agent created. Attribution, not authentication: callers share the endpoint token. |
| `dsh_cancel_session` | Cancel the active turn of a session without dropping its pending inbox. |
| `dsh_archive_session` | Archive one session durably: hidden from every grouping surface, and it cannot run a model step until restored. A session with running work is refused unless `stopActivity: true` (which archives first, then stops that work). Archiving drops the pin. |
| `dsh_unarchive_session` | Drop a session from the archive set; it is listed again and returns to its recorded workspace position. |
| `dsh_list_permission_presets` | The deployment's permission presets (each bundles a sandbox mode with an approval policy) plus the default for new sessions, for the `permissionPreset` argument above. |
| `dsh_list_tools` | The tools DSH exposes to its own agents, for choosing what a delegated prompt can do; `query` narrows by name or description and `limit` caps the list. |
| `dsh_open_session` | Ask the running Web GUI to open one session and select it in the sidebar — for pointing the person at a session this endpoint started. Queued for the page that is open and consumed once; the session itself is untouched. |
| `dsh_status` | Endpoint, profile, version, session/live-agent counts, default model, active turns, the default permission preset, the delivery policy, and the local tool surface (`dshTools`). |

Archival needs the Host's `workspaceRegistry` service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`). Without it the
two archive tools report that the service is unavailable and listings simply omit the `archived`
field instead of guessing.

Permission presets need the Host's `permissionPresets` service
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets`). `permissionPreset` is applied through that service's own
`set()` — the same write path as the GUI `/permission` command — once the session is live and before
its prompt is admitted, so the turn's own tool calls already see the chosen sandbox mode and approval
policy. The outcome echoes the applied preset; `dsh_read_session` folds the session's last durable
`permission/preset` event back into its payload, and `dsh_status` carries `defaultPermissionPreset`
plus the catalog. Without the service the permission fields are omitted and
`dsh_list_permission_presets` reports that the service is unavailable. A session created without a
`permissionPreset` keeps the deployment default, exactly as a GUI-created session does.

Commands need the Host's `commands` service and are addressed by **agent**, not by session: the
registry merges a global layer with the layers of the preset that agent is mounted under, so
`dsh_list_commands` must be asked per session

plugins.description: LeetCode Hot 100 learning plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): lessons, sandboxed judge, AI tutor, spaced review, and an AI agent that adds LeetCode problems from a plain description. 力扣热题 100 学习插件。
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepSeek Harness LeetCode **Learn algorithms inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): lessons, all of LeetCode Hot 100, a sandboxed judge, and an AI tutor.** English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2%20%E2%86%92%200.2.x-4D6BFE) ![Hot 100](https://img.shields.io/badge/LeetCode%20Hot%20100-100%2F100-FFA116) ![Desktop & Web](https://img.shields.io/badge/Desktop%20%26%20Web-supported-2EA043) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey)
## Why - **All of LeetCode Hot 100**, plus 8 more classics — each with an original summary, three progressive hints, and an explained solution. Statements stay on LeetCode; every problem links to the official page. - **A real judge on your machine.** Code runs in Docker with no network. Hidden boundary, random, and large cases catch wrong and slow solutions — including design classes, in-place edits, and linked-list/tree node problems. - **Lessons before problems.** 16 topics, from hashing to dynamic programming, each with a worked example you can trace step by step. Then the tutor writes a short check about the lesson, reviews your answers, and decides when you're ready for the practice problem. - **Add problems by just describing them.** "3 medium BFS problems I haven't done" — an AI agent finds them on LeetCode, writes the tests, and adds them only if they pass validation. ## A closer look


Hot 100 — LeetCode's own grouping, with your progress per group

Solve — editor, Run and Submit, hidden tests Submissions — runtime, memory, and every past attempt


Your record — solved by difficulty, a yearly calendar, streaks, and recent passes

Learn — worked examples you can trace Hints — direction, key idea, outline, solution


Tutor check — questions written for the lesson, answers reviewed by the tutor (real DeepSeek output)

Also included: an AI tutor chat, spaced-repetition reviews with fresh validated variants, progress by concept, and optional daily reminder email. ## Quick start 1. **Install Docker Desktop.** Learn then guides the rest: it can start Docker and download the runner images with one click, or run `docker pull python:3.13-alpine node:24-alpine` yourself. 2. **Install the plugin** from `github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode`: - **Desktop:** Plugins → install from GitHub. - **Web:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode dsh web ``` 3. **Open Learn** in the sidebar. Explanations default to Chinese; switch to English in Learn → Settings. Needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3 (tested on 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.3). A default model (for example, signed in to DeepSeek) is optional: it powers the tutor, tutor-written lesson checks, AI feedback, and Add problems. Running, judging, written hints, and the lessons' built-in check questions work without one.
Install from the command line on Desktop Quit Desktop completely, then run its bundled CLI and reopen Desktop: ```sh "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode ``` The repository ships prebuilt files in `lib/`, so installing runs no build script. Pin a commit for reproducible installs: `github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode#`.
## How judging works Every verdict comes from test execution only. Your code runs in a Docker container with no network, a read-only filesystem, and memory, CPU, and process limits; expected answers never enter the container. Each suite combines official example inputs with hidden boundary, random, and large cases, built from a reference solution and checked against an independent brute-force solution. A pass means **"passed local tests"**, not LeetCode acceptance. The optional AI judge adds feedback but can never change the verdict. ## Add problems Practice → **Add problems**. Describe what you want and pick how many (1–5). Progress streams live, and you can stop at any time; problems already added stay. - The agent follows the bundled skill [`skills/learn-problem-author/SKILL.md`](skills/learn-problem-author/SKILL.md), which is visible only to the finder agent, never in your normal Sessions. - Number, title, difficulty, tags, signature, and examples always come from LeetCode's metadata, never from the model. Paid-only problems and problems that need a judge Learn does not provide are skipped. - Each problem must pass the same validation as the built-in ones before it is added. - In our live tests with DeepSeek, a run took 70–300 seconds and added every problem requested.
## Privacy - Your code runs only inside offline Docker containers. - With a default model, Submit (unless `agents.judge: false`), hints, tutor chat, reflections, and variant generation send the problem summary and your code to that model through DSH. Lesson checks send the lesson and your answers. Add problems sends your description and LeetCode metadata, never your code. Each run appears in your Session history. - Add problems queries LeetCode's public GraphQL API for problem metadata only: no login, no statements, paced requests with a per-run budget. - Nothing else leaves your machine, except reminder email if you configure SMTP.
Configuration The plugin adds two rows to your profile: `learn` (the service) and `learn-ui` (the Remote API and UI). Override settings in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch replaces the row's whole `config`, so keep `dataRoot`: ```yaml - id: learn config: dataRoot: !!js dshHomePath('learn') defaultLocale: en reviewDailyLimit: 3 agents: judge: false # deterministic judging only, no AI feedback variantGeneration: true finder: enabled: true maxProblems: 5 # problems per Add problems run maxSubmissionsPerProblem: 3 maxLeetcodeRequests: 40 # LeetCode requests per run requestIntervalMs: 1000 email: transport: capture # 'smtp' sends only with liveSendingAuthorized: true ``` Data lives in `learn/` under your DSH home (`~/.dsh` by default); Settings can export it as JSON or reset it. Real email needs `email.transport: smtp`, `email.liveSendingAuthorized: true`, `email.smtp.host`/`port`/`user`, and the SMTP password stored as the DSH credential named by `email.smtp.passwordRef` (default `DSH_LEARN_S

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 会话导出插件：在 dsh Web 会话「更多」菜单注入「导出 Markdown / 导出 PDF」，纯前端注入、零 npm 依赖。Export DSH sessions to Markdown or PDF from the web GUI.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-export-plugin · 会话导出 Markdown + PDF 在 dsh 会话行"更多"菜单里,于"归档会话"下方注入两项: - **导出 Markdown** —— 与 PDF 同一套**极简问答对**（只有用户输入 + 该轮最后一条助手可见回复）转成 `.md` 下载。 - **导出 PDF** —— 只取**用户输入 + 该轮最后一条助手可见回复**(文字与图片),排成干净的问答对,A4 排版后经系统打印对话框"另存为 PDF"。 ## 设计 复用官方 `dsh-session-log-export` 包的 `/api/session.export` route(返回 ZIP,内含 canonical JSONL log + `media/.` 图片),前端 fetch 拿 ZIP → 浏览器原生 `DecompressionStream('deflate-raw')` 解压 → 迷你 ZIP 解析器找根 `session*.jsonl`(PDF 再解 `media/*`)→ 按 V4 event type 转换 → `.md` 下载,或渲染打印专用 HTML 到隐藏 `iframe srcdoc` 并调 `contentWindow.print()`。 **纯前端注入,零 npm 依赖,不读 zstd**(官方已用 persistence read handle 把 log 解好放进 ZIP),不碰 persistence。PDF 走 `window.print` 而不是 jsPDF/pdfMake:零依赖、中文用系统字体、图片与 CSS 排版交给浏览器。 ## PDF 导出范围 | 事件 / 内容 | 是否导出 | |---|---| | `user/message` 且 `source.kind === 'user'`(真实用户输入,含图片) | ✅ | | `agent/inbox/spliced` 里 role=user 的插入消息 | ✅ 与上一条是**同一个 message id**,按 id 去重只出一次 | | `runtime-context` / `time-context` / `skill-catalog` / 工作区指令等**系统注入** | ❌ 它们也走 `user/message`,按 `source.kind` 滤掉 | | `assistant/message` 的 `text` block | ✅ 但**每轮只留最后一条** | | `assistant/message` 的 `image` block | ✅ | | 同一轮里工具调用前后的**过渡说明文本** | ❌ 被该轮最后一条覆盖 | | `thinking` / `reasoning` block(思考过程) | ❌ | | `tool_use` / `tool_result` / `tool/call` / `tool/result` | ❌ | | `system/message` / `developer/message` | ❌ | | `assistant/attempt`(半途草稿、流式分片) | ❌ | | 子代理会话(`includeDescendants=false`) | ❌ | | 未知/其它事件类型 | ❌ | 即 PDF 是一份干净的"我问了什么 / 最终答了什么"记录,不含模型内部过程。配对规则:以 `turn/end` 作为一轮的边界,把该轮的用户输入与**最后一条**助手可见回复排成一组;日志末尾再收尾 flush 一次,所以被打断 / 未正常结束的回合也不会丢内容。用户消息里的图片会内嵌到 PDF(缺图时输出 `[图片未随会话导出]` 占位)。 > **为什么必须"按 id 去重 + 按 source.kind 过滤"**(来自真实会话日志的教训): > 同一条用户输入在 `agent/inbox/spliced` 与 `user/message` 里**各记一次、共用同一个 message id**, > 不去重就会每句提问出现两遍;而 `runtime-context`、`time-context`、`skill-catalog`、工作区指令 > (如 CLAUDE.md,实测上万字符)也是 `user/message`,不按 `source.kind === 'user'` 过滤就会**冒充用户提问** > 混进 PDF。两者叠加曾是 PDF 里"重复提问 + 莫名其妙的成段内容"的直接原因。 ## 导出的 Markdown 结构 Markdown 与 PDF **共用同一套"极简问答对"**（同一份 `jsonlToBlocks` 输出），只有标题、角色、正文和图片占位： ``` # Session - Created: - Workspace: ## 👤 用户 <用户消息> ## 🤖 助手 <助手回复（保留 Markdown 代码块与列表）> ## 👤 用户 …（每轮如此） ``` 不再包含工具调用 / 工具结果 / 系统提示词 / 思考过程 / 上下文注入 / 未知事件的 JSON dump。图片位置输出 `[图片]` 占位（Markdown 不做 base64 内嵌，避免文件膨胀）。 实测（同一会话 `session-5494db1e`）：**旧导出 146,662 字节 → 新导出 3,208 字节**（约 2.2%）。 > 需要**完整会话日志**（含工具调用、系统提示词）时，用会话菜单里官方 `dsh-session-log-export` 提供的导出项，它仍会给出完整的 ZIP/日志。 ## 菜单挂载的真实 DOM 官方菜单行由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `MenuItemButton` 渲染(类名是 CSS module 哈希): ```html
``` 注入做法:按文本 `归档会话` / `取消归档` 找到 `[role="menuitem"]`,再取它的外层 `div.itemWrap`,**克隆整个 `itemWrap`**(不是只克隆 button——`.itemWrap` 是 `position:relative` 的整行单元,只克隆 button 会让两个 button 挤在同一个包裹层里),然后改 `itemLabel` 文字、替换 svg 图标、移除 `shortcut`、绑定 click,依次插到原行后面(Markdown 在前、PDF 在后)。 ## 文件 - `index.js` — apply 注入,通过 `webServer.tapIndex` 把 HTML 注入 `` 前 - `inject.mjs` — 导出 `exportInjectHtml` 字符串,含 CSS + JS IIFE(两个导出项 + ZIP 解析 + MD/PDF 两条转换链) - `cordis.patch.yml` — 插件 bundle 声明 - `package.json` — 包配置 - `test-inject.mjs` — 回归测试(见下) ## 安装 ```bash npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add D:\dsh-code\export-plugin ``` 插件以**目录链接**安装(profile 的 `dsh-export-plugin` → `link:D:/dsh-code/export-plugin`),改 `inject.mjs` / `index.js` 后**只需重启 dsh**(`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`),不必重新 add;改 `package.json` 结构字段需重新 add。 > `inject.mjs` 的注入串在服务启动时随模块加载定格,重启前改动不会生效。 ## 自测(改完 inject.mjs 先跑这个) ```bash node test-inject.mjs ``` 它做六件事: 1. 断言外层模板字面量里**没有残留的单反斜杠** `\n` / `\.` / `\d`; 2. 提取内联 `

plugins.description: Balance and per-session spend HUD for DeepSeek Harness, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# dsh-balance-hud

An always-on HUD in the bottom-right corner of the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** Web GUI that shows your
DeepSeek **account balance** and the **cost of the current session**.

[简体中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) · [设计说明](docs/DESIGN.zh-CN.md) · [LICENSE](LICENSE)

![The two states of the HUD: a collapsed corner badge and the expanded detail panel](assets/preview-en.png)

> **About these images:** they are not photographs of a live DSH window. They are renders of the
> plugin's own layout and colours, driven by its real style values and real figures — a capture tool
> for the running GUI was not available when they were made. Treat them as a faithful layout
> reference, not as evidence of a running install. Pull requests replacing them with genuine
> screenshots are welcome.

- **Account balance** — recharge balance + bonus balance, read through the same service the
  *Settings → Account & balance* page uses (`ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()`).
- **Two cost figures** — a token-based *estimate* from the official price table, and an *actual*
  figure accumulated from real balance decreases (external reductions excluded).
- **External balance changes, both ways** — a top-up raises the balance, and a lapsed bonus grant is
  reclaimed by the platform; money moving in or out externally never touches the spending counter.
- **Per session** — the tracker is keyed by session id; refreshing the page or switching sessions
  never damages or clobbers another session's record, because the read → modify → write round trip
  is lossless.
- **No credentials, and no outbound network unless you opt in** — the plugin never touches your API
  key. It reaches the network only after you turn price syncing on (see
  [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)); until then it makes zero external requests.
- **Two halves, one relay** — a browser half renders the HUD; a Host half exposes read-only loopback
  HTTP routes (balance, bonus signal, price sync, model list), so the browser itself never talks to
  anything but loopback.
- **Configurable, and budgeted** — a preference row in *Settings → General* sets the model, the poll
  intervals, the budgets and the warnings; the card gains a coloured edge as spending approaches a
  budget, and the panel counts down to the next peak/off-peak switch.

```bash
# Windows — double-click tools\install.cmd, or:
tools\install.cmd

# macOS / Linux:
sh tools/install.sh
```

Both launchers find Node for you — including **the runtime DSH already ships**, which is not on
`PATH`. If your machine has no Node at all, they say so and tell you what to do, instead of failing
with `node: command not found`. Install into a different profile with `--profile <dir>`, preview with
`--dry-run`, undo with `--uninstall`.

Prefer to run it yourself? The plain form assumes Node is on `PATH`:

```bash
node tools/install.mjs    # install into ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop, then restart DSH
node tools/smoke.mjs      # offline smoke suite (83 assertions), no DSH install needed
```

**Then restart DSH.** Adding a plugin changes the profile's bundle list, which is not hot-reloaded;
a page refresh alone will not pick it up.

## The HUD

```text
                                                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                                                        │  Balance             ¥43.42  │
                                                        │  Session est.         ¥0.59  │
                                                        └──────────────────────────────┘
```

Hovering the card expands a detail panel: balance rows (recharge / bonus / total), the three priced
components of the estimate, the actual figure, token counts, and — with parallel sessions — the
apportionment rows (`Session share`, `Other sessions`, `Tracked sessions`, `Account total`). The
panel uses 4 decimals; the card uses 2. The interface ships in **Chinese and English** and follows
DSH's language by default; the English names below are what each row means.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Balance | Total account balance (recharge + bonus), 2 decimals |
| Session est. | Estimate for the current session; 2 decimals on the card, 4 in the panel; `—` when the session has no token usage yet |
| Actual charged | Accumulated real spending for this session (single session; becomes `Session share` when parallel) |

Amounts below the smallest displayed unit render as `<¥0.01` on the card and `<¥0.0001` in the
panel, so real spending is never rounded down to a flat zero.

## Interaction

- **Hover** the card and the detail panel expands; move away and it closes.
- The card and the panel are separate elements with an intentional **8 px gap** between them, and the
  pointer must be able to cross that gap without the panel closing. The hover decision is attached to
  the card and the panel themselves — each has its own enter/leave handler — never to the enclosing
  positioning container. A **140 ms** pending-close timer carries the card's `mouseleave` across the
  gap so the panel's `mouseenter` cancels it.
- Leaving the **left** edge of the card *or* the **left** edge of the panel closes the panel. This is
  deliberate: the container reserves extra space above and to the sides, so hanging the close
  behaviour on the container box would keep the panel open over dead space.
- **Click** the card to fold it down to a small corner badge showing 2 cells — label and balance;
  click again to restore it.
- **Keyboard:** the card is a `role="button"` with `tabIndex=0` and toggles the fold on `Enter` and
  `Space`. The panel is a `role="dialog"`.
- The panel header carries a **Refresh** button that immediately shows a busy label and then an
  `Updated at HH:MM:SS` timestamp, plus the manual *I just topped up* button, which shows a querying
  state while it works.
- **There are deliberately no `title` attributes anywhere in the HUD.** A native browser tooltip
  appears as an opaque black box about a second after hover and covers the panel, so the summary
  lives in `aria-label` instead — asserted by the smoke suite as a regression guard.

## Settings

The plugin contributes **one preference row** — `余额与花费 HUD` — to the DSH slot
`settings.general.item`, which DSH declares as *"one preference row inside the General section — the
additive seat for a single setting that needs no page of its own"* (a whole page is
`settings.section`; the same slot carries DSH's own Language, link-opening and performance-usage
rows). Find it at **Settings → General → 余额与花费 HUD**. It does **not** take over a whole settings
page.

| Setting | Values | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Model (`计价模型`) | `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro` | `deepseek-flash` | Price table used for the estimate and the apportionment weights |
| Price auto-sync interval (`自动同步价格`) | off / 6 h / 24 h / 3 d / 7 d | off | Auto-sync cadence for the official price table; nothing runs until you pick one (see [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)) |
| Foreground poll interval (`前台刷新间隔`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 60 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is visible |
| Hidden interval (`后台（页面隐藏）`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 300 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is hidden |
| Peak-warning lead time (`峰前提醒`) | 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 min | 10 min | How early the peak/off-peak warning appears |
| Session budget (`本会话预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for this session's estimated spend |
| Daily budget (`每日预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for the Beijing-day confirmed spend |
| Show account total row (`显示账户级合计`) | on / off | on | `Account total` row in the panel when parallel sessions exist |
| Peak warnings (`峰时提醒`) | on / off | on | The peak/off-peak warning line in the panel |
| System notification on budget breach (`预算超限发系统通知`) | on / off | off | Optional `Notification` when a budget level is first reached |

The shipped row is labelled in Chinese; the English names above are what each control means.

**Persistence.** The row writes the `localStorage` key `dsh-balance-hud:settings:v1` — deliberately
**separate** from the accounti

plugins.description: Agent 体检诊所 —— 用可复核证据诊断 Agent 使用体验问题
plugins.readme_text:
# agent-clinic · Agent 体检诊所

**装为 Skill**（一行命令，无需克隆、无需选位置、无需回答任何提问）：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/main/install.sh | bash
```

**装为 DSH 插件**（侧边栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**，粘贴下面这行）：

```bash
https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic.git
```

> 装成插件后有侧边栏「🩺 体检」入口和全页面板。**装完必须完全退出并重启 Harness**——插件只在启动时装载。

> **你的 Agent 体检诊所。** 只读扫描本地 Agent 会话，用**可逐条复核的证据**诊断真实发生的使用体验问题（token 浪费、死循环、跨会话失忆、资产闲置），并为每个问题开出可执行的处方。

[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-blue)]()
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)]()
[![smoke](https://img.shields.io/badge/smoke-345%2F345-brightgreen)]()
[![CI](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> `smoke N/N` 是**本地自检的通过数**（由 smoke 自己在跑完后核对，数字对不上就以退出码 1 结束）——
> 想知道 CI 此刻是红是绿，看旁边那枚 **CI** 徽章（它就是 GitHub Actions 的实况，改不了）。

---

## 它解决什么问题

大多数 Agent 使用分析工具只给你一堆统计数字，你看完也不知道该干什么。

agent-clinic 的做法不同：**它给证据，也给处方。**

- 不只说"你有死循环"，而是说"10 月 8 日这个会话，`list_agents` 用同样的参数失败了 4 次，在 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L108`"——一条命令你就能自己复核。
- 不只给建议，而是给**可执行的动作**：能整段粘进 profile 的 YAML 片段、斜杠命令、已核实插件的安装入口，或明确说没有插件能解。
- **读你的真实配置**再开口：处方会说"你现在 `maxInlineTokens=12500`（随附默认，profile 未覆盖）→ 建议 6000"，而不是"建议调低一点"。当前值已经不弱于建议时，这条处方会被撤掉 —— **而且会写出来**（报告里的「已评估但未给出的处方」段会列出被撤的原因和当前值，你才能复核这个判断，不会以为"根本没有这条建议"）。
- **宁可承认做不到，也不假装有数据**：从未实现的维度一律列在报告里并写明原因。第二轮评估用原始日志证伪了旧的"数据源缺失"说法后，E3/N3/N4 从"不可实现"变成**已实现**；K1/K2 曾如实写成"隐私取舍下的方案未定"，2026-10-15 定案（写入本地加盐指纹快照）后也已实现 —— 现在报告里"尚未实现的维度"是**空的**，而这一节会保留并显示"没有"。
- **检索插件目录做针对性推荐**：按「能力标签 + 关键词」匹配你的问题，并说明**为什么推荐它**（例如"能力标签 token-saving 对上 C1；你的问题描述里出现了 token、消耗"）。目录有三个来源并逐一标出：**人工核实 / npm registry 同步 / GitHub 核实**（经 `gh-proxy.com` 中继 GitHub API，按 star 数与最近更新检索；API 不通时退回人工种子清单 + `git ls-remote`）。**已经装过的插件不再推荐**，**官方内置包单独标注**（通常已随 dsh-base 挂载）。热度（star / 下载量）如实展示，只用于同分排序、不参与对症打分。
- **面板里一切皆可折叠**：问题卡点开能看到证据与**挂在它下面的处方**；处方卡点开才展开分步操作、片段、风险与出处。
- **同类型合并**：同一指标在多个会话命中（或同一种模式出现多次）只会显示**一张卡**并标出「N 处」，展开后每一处仍保留自己的会话、结论与证据定位 —— 不重复展示，也不丢信息。

> **不做的事**：不主动推送、不代你安装、不改你的配置、不诊断代码质量、不把任何对话内容发到外部。

---

## 诊断维度

**22 项已实现**

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 严重度 |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | token 消耗过快 | 会话**单位请求** output 超**其余主会话**基线 2 倍（基线逐会话排除自身；且总量 ≥2 万） | 高 |
| C2 | 上下文膨胀 | 末轮/首轮 input 增长 >10x 且 cacheRead <30% | 高 |
| C3 | 长会话疲劳 | 单会话消息数 >200 | 中 |
| C5 | 压缩可观测性 | 单会话压缩 ≥3 次，给出 **DSH 实测**释放 token（非估算） | 中 |
| C6 | 工具面成本 | 工具 schema >20000 字符（每请求重发）+ 窗口内 0 调用的工具 ≥5 个 | 中 |
| C7 | 上下文注入量 | 上下文被注入 ≥20 次且 ≥100000 字符 | 低 |
| E1 | 死循环 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 同错误，≥3 次 | 高 |
| E2 | 反复失败 | 会话工具错误率 >30% | 中 |
| E3 | 工具结果过大 | 单条工具结果 >8192 字符，会话内 ≥5 条 | 中 |
| E4 | 计划执行脱节 | 写计划后又大量调用工具，但 0 条完成 | 中 |
| E5 | 冗余重复调用 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 无错误，≥3 次 | 中 |
| N1 | 环境命令反复失败 | 命令类调用失败 ≥3 次 | 中 |
| N2 | 高风险操作 | 命令执行类工具命中 `rm -rf` / `--force` / `reset --hard` 等 | 高 |
| N3 | 权限审批摩擦 | 审批请求 ≥5 次（给出等待时长，以及**被拒 / 结果无法识别 / 无对应决定记录**三者分列） | 中 |
| N4 | API 重试频繁 | 模型请求重试 ≥3 次（给出失败码与累计退避） | 中 |
| A2 | skill 闲置 | 已装 skill 在 ≥30 天**日历窗口**内 0 次触发 | 中 |
| A3 | 高频手动序列 | **非通用工具**的两步序列 ≥5 次（去镜像、跨会话合并） | 低 |
| A4 | 子代理开销 | `delegationDepth>0` 会话 token 占比 >40% | 中 |
| A5 | 辅助 LLM 开销 | 辅助模型调用（联网检索 / 会话标题）≥20 次，给出 maxTokens 上界 | 中 |

> **C5/C6/C7/A5 是第三轮新增的"实测数据源"**（依据 `agent-clinic-待优化报告-DSH单平台.md`）：
> C1/C2 是**推断**浪费，而 DSH 自己就把**实测值**写进了日志 ——
> 压缩释放了多少 token（`shadowedTokenCount`）、工具 schema 多大、上下文注入多少、
> 辅助请求跑了几次。这四项**零隐私代价**（只记数字），
> 本机实测：压缩释放 **638,171** token、工具 schema **29,779** 字符/请求、
> 注入 **158,393** 字符、辅助调用 **96** 次。定义与阈值见 [docs/diagnostics.md](docs/diagnostics.md)。

# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate)


**关键词**：密钥轮换 · 密钥管理 · 证书轮换 · 证书过期 · 密钥过期 · 密码周期 · 密钥复用
**Keywords**: key rotation · secret rotation · certificate rotation · key management · cryptoperiod
**密钥轮换** —— 查密钥与证书多久没换了、有没有轮换制度、有没有跨环境复用。

## 不装它会怎样

你的 `id_rsa` 是两年前配的，一直没动。制度文档也许写了「密钥每年轮换」。

**但事实上它就是没换过。**

等保测评会问「鉴别信息多久更换一次」，客户尽调会问「密钥管理流程」——
你拿不出证据，因为**文件时间戳就摆在那里**。

## 它查什么

| 级别 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 高 | 密钥/证书文件超过一年未更新（按 mtime）|
| 🟡 中 | 文档里找不到轮换策略 |
| 🟡 中 | 同一密钥在多个环境配置里被引用 |

## 为什么这是可判定的

```
密钥文件 mtime → 距今多少天 → 对比阈值（默认 365 天）
```

制度写在纸上，**时间戳不会说谎**。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-key-rotate --demo          # 看检出效果
dsh-key-rotate --list-rules    # 列出规则和依据
dsh-key-rotate --html r.html
```

![dsh-key-rotate 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/report.png)

![dsh-key-rotate 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/demo.png)

![dsh-key-rotate 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/rules.png)

## 边界

- **年龄 ≠ 未轮换** —— 密钥可能在 KMS 里，本地只是副本。报出来需你确认。
- **不解析证书内容** —— 不校验有效期、签发者、密钥长度。
- **跨环境复用只看 .env 类文件** —— KMS / CI secrets 看不到。
- 与 [dsh-bundle-cn-skills](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-bundle-cn-skills) 分工：那个查「密钥有没有被提交」，这个查「多久没换」。

本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。**

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 38 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规**（12）｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [AI 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理**（6）｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)
