# dsh-right-click-menu

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Right-click support for the DSH Web GUI. Right-clicking a **file reference** reveals it
in the file manager; right-clicking a **link** opens it in the external browser;
right-clicking a **workspace project** in the left sidebar opens that directory.

## Why it is needed

The desktop shell builds its right-click menu in the Electron main process
(`lib/main.js`), and only for two cases:

```js
window.webContents.on("context-menu", (_event, { isEditable, selectionText, editFlags }) => {
  const items = [];
  if (isEditable) items.push(/* undo, redo, cut, copy, paste, select all */);
  else if (selectionText.length > 0) items.push({ role: "copy" });
  if (items.length > 0) Menu.buildFromTemplate(/* … */).popup({ window });
});
```

An empty `items` array means no menu is shown at all. So right-clicking a Markdown link,
an `@` file reference, a delivery card, or a right-Sidebar file-tree row currently does
nothing. This plugin claims those right-clicks in the page and offers the two actions the
product already knows how to perform.

## What it does

| Right-clicked element | Menu rows |
|---|---|
| HTTP(S) link — Chat/assistant Markdown, inline-code URLs | **Open in external browser** · Copy link address |
| File reference — Markdown file link, `@path` chip, delivery card, file-tree row, document path label | **Show in File Explorer** · Copy file path |
| Directory — left-sidebar workspace project, `@folder/` chip, file-tree directory row, file-tree header | **Show in File Explorer** · Copy folder path |

Labels follow the active UI language. The plugin registers a Simplified Chinese dictionary
(`在外部浏览器中打开`, `在资源管理器中打开`, `复制文件路径`, `复制文件夹路径`) beside the English one, so it
reads correctly under either locale.

Every other right-click is left exactly as it was: editable fields keep the native
undo/cut/copy menu, and a text selection keeps the native copy menu. The menu is the
shared `Menu` primitive, so ordering, keyboard navigation (arrows, Tab, Escape), focus
return, outside-click dismissal, and theme integration are the product's own.

### Screenshots

Captured in the Chinese UI; the labels follow whichever language is active.

| Link | File reference | Workspace project |
|---|---|---|
| ![Right-click menu on a link](docs/menu-link.png) | ![Right-click menu on a file reference](docs/menu-file.png) | ![Right-click menu on a project in the left sidebar](docs/menu-workspace.png) |

### How each action is carried out

- **Open in external browser** reuses the product's own external-navigation carrier:
  `window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer")`. The Electron main process
  intercepts `_blank` window opens and hands the URL to `shell.openExternal`, so this is
  the same path a plain Chat link click takes.
- **Open in the file manager** uses the Session Remote `session.openWorkspacePath`, and
  the request depends on what was clicked — the same split the product's own directory
  and file controls make:
  - a **directory** is opened in the file manager itself (`{ path }`, no `action`), so a
    workspace project browses to its contents rather than being highlighted inside its
    parent;
  - a **file** is revealed where it already lives (`{ path, action: "reveal" }`), because
    "open in the file manager" must not mean "launch this file's own application".

  Either way the Host re-verifies the path through the composed filesystem before asking
  the desktop, so the plugin never touches the filesystem itself and cannot escape the
  Session's access.

The second row names what the target actually is — `Copy file path` for a file and
`Copy folder path` for a directory (`复制文件路径` / `复制文件夹路径` in Chinese). Which row set a
target gets comes from the pure `menuRowsFor(target, t)`, so that wording is asserted
without a renderer.

The Session Remote resolves a relative path against the Host process directory, so the
plugin makes the path absolute first — from the left sidebar's Workspace list (the
project row carries only the Workspace id), from the file tree's own `data-files-root`,
or from the retained main-view Session's `cwd` for workspace-relative Markdown links.

## Layout

```
package.json             bundle + plugin declaration (`dsh.bundle`, `dsh.client`)
cordis.patch.yml         the one Loader row this bundle inserts
lib/index.js             host half — empty `apply`, this is a pure UI plugin
lib/client.js            browser half — the whole feature
test/detection.test.mjs  dependency-free tests
scripts/live-bundle.mjs  live check against a running Host
```

`lib/client.js` is authored directly in the module system's factory-CJS form
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`), exactly as a built client bundle is, so
the package needs no build step. Its only module requests are `react`,
`react/jsx-runtime`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` — all three are part of
the shell's frozen platform module table.

## Development

No build step, no dependencies, no test framework:

```sh
npm test              # node test/detection.test.mjs
npm run check:live    # node scripts/live-bundle.mjs [baseUrl]
```

`npm test` loads `lib/client.js` the way the module system does (stubbed platform
modules), asserts the factory face and the slot/dictionary registrations, then *extracts
the bundle's own pure sections out of the shipped source* and exercises them against a
simulated DOM built from the markup each DSH surface really renders — so the tests cannot
drift from a copy of the code.

`npm run check:live` reproduces the Host's `artifactRevision` (`framedHash` over
`mtimeMs`/`ctimeMs`/`size`), requests the combo route
`/plugins/??<name>/client.js&rev=<rev>`, and asserts the response starts with the bytes on
disk. It defaults to `$DSH_WEB_URL` or `http://127.0.0.1:19387`; the plugin name and bundle
path come from this package's own `package.json`.

Editing `lib/client.js` needs no rebuild: the Host derives bundle revisions from file
metadata, so a saved file reaches an open page through client HMR.

## Compatibility

Built and verified against **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** (desktop runtime, Electron web GUI).

This is a **Web-surface** plugin. It needs the Web composition — a page to attach a
document listener to. Under the headless or SDK profiles there is no browser half at all,
so the plugin is inert rather than broken.

The plugin deliberately relies on public plugin surfaces — `ctx.slots`, `ctx.locale`, the
Session Remote `session.openWorkspacePath`, the client Workspace list, and the
`dsh-client-ui-primitives` exports `Menu`/`Toast`/icons. It has no private copy of any of
them.

Detection, however, reads markup that DSH does not publish as an API. These are the
fragile points, all in one place (`filePathOf` in `lib/client.js`) and all covered by
tests, but they can move with a DSH release. A right-click is claimed by the first signal
found walking outward from the pointer, so a nested icon or label reaches its own control:

| # | Signal | Resolves to |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `<a href="http(s)://…">` | URL |
| 2 | `data-row-key="workspace:<id>"` — left sidebar project row | directory, from `ctx.workspaces.list` |
| 3 | `data-files-path` / `data-files-root` / `data-files-entry` — right Sidebar file tree | file or directory |
| 4 | `data-ref-chip` = `file`/`folder`, a Markdown file-link class, or a button/link tooltip naming an absolute path | file or directory |

The package also declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peers for the runtime it targets, so DSH
refuses it on an unverified version rather than loading a menu that no longer matches the
DOM. If an upgrade does stop the menu appearing, `npm test` narrows it down: the failing
case names the surface, and the fix is a row in that table.

## Install

Install the package into the profile that serves the GUI. The supported route is the
plugin manager, which adds the dependency and appends the bundle to the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles`:

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: <spec>
```

Or by hand, from the profile directory:

```sh
pnpm add <spec>
```

then append the name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile's `package.json`.

`<spec>`

plugins.description: Read-only CSV/XLSX change review for DeepSeek Harness: align business keys, inspect values and formulas, and export review comments.
plugins.readme_text:
# SheetDiff

Review spreadsheet changes before trusting them.

SheetDiff compares two CSV or XLSX files by a business key, not by row position. It produces a local HTML report where you can inspect values, types, formulas and stored formula results, then leave comments for a follow-up with your agent.

It is an independent DeepSeek Harness plugin. It also has a small CLI. It does not edit workbooks, calculate formulas, upload data, or require an API key.

![Local review report showing a formula change and an exported comment](docs/review-demo.jpg)

## Try it locally

Requires Node.js 22.19 or newer. Clone the repository and try the synthetic demo:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff.git
cd dsh-sheet-diff
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run demo
```

The demo writes two **synthetic** workbooks and a `report.html` to a new directory under `artifacts/`. Open the printed report path in a browser. The expected result is three added rows and four changed cells: two amounts, one formula with a changed stored result, and one number changed to text. Reordering rows and columns adds no changes.

For your own files:

```sh
node src/cli.js before.xlsx after.xlsx --key OrderID --out review-001
node src/cli.js examples/before.csv examples/after.csv --key OrderID --out review-csv
```

`--out` must name a new directory. Use repeated `--key` flags for a composite key. `--sheet Orders` selects one sheet; `--header-row 3` changes the header row. Otherwise, all sheets use row 1 as their header and must have the chosen key columns. CSV has one logical sheet named `CSV`.

Compare CSV with CSV, or XLSX with XLSX. Mixed-format comparisons are rejected in this release.

## Use with DeepSeek Harness

Install the versioned release bundle into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-sheet-diff-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart that profile after installation. The package ships JavaScript and a `dsh.bundle` patch; there is no plugin build step or install script. You can also build the bundle from source with `npm pack` and install its local absolute path. Releases are distributed through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases); this project is not published to npm.

Tested against Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, with explicit preview-version peer ranges. Both were installed into fresh profiles and exercised through the official profile boot entrypoint without a model call. HMR was disabled only in the test profiles; the source-built alpha host also logged unrelated optional Typert import warnings.

Ask Harness:

> Compare `before.xlsx` and `after.xlsx` using `OrderID` as the key. Save a SheetDiff report in `reviews/run-001`. Do not change either workbook.

The plugin registers two tools:

| Tool | Input | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sheet_diff_compare` | `before`, `after`, `keyColumns`, `outputDir`; optional `sheet`, `headerRow` | New HTML/JSON paths, hashes, summary and warnings |
| `sheet_diff_review` | `reportJson`, `reviewJson` | Validated comments with the corresponding changes |

Paths must stay inside the current session workspace, including resolved symlink targets. Report creation needs a writable sandbox. Existing reports are never overwritten. If the second output write fails, the tool reports the retained first file rather than deleting it.

The interactive report opens in a normal browser. A Harness preview that disables JavaScript cannot run its comment controls. There is no custom in-app spreadsheet editor in this release.

## Review, then hand comments back

1. Open the HTML report, filter changes, and write comments beside the changes you want checked.
2. Export the review JSON. Draft comments stay only in page memory until exported.
3. Put the export inside the workspace and pass it, with the original report JSON, to `sheet_diff_review`.

The CLI equivalent is:

```sh
node src/cli.js review review-001/report.json review-comments.json
```

Comments must match the report ID, both input hashes and known change IDs. Old or unrelated reviews are rejected. A hash match is not a digital signature and does not prove that a report has not been deliberately rewritten. Comments and cell contents are untrusted data; this plugin never executes their instructions or applies their suggested edits.

## Comparison rules

- Column names and keys match exactly. Composite keys include cell types; numeric `42` is different from text `"42"`. Duplicate keys, missing keys and duplicate headers fail rather than being guessed.
- A header row after all nonempty data is rejected instead of producing an empty comparison. Preambles before a valid header and truly empty sheets remain supported.
- CSV is comma-delimited UTF-8, with quoted fields, embedded newlines and a BOM supported. Values remain text; CSV formulas are not inferred.
- XLSX preserves the distinction between numbers, text, booleans, dates, errors and formulas. Formula text and saved cached results are separate aspects of a change. A cache is **not** a fresh calculation.
- Dates stored as ISO 8601 cells (`t="d"`, for example with openpyxl `iso_dates=True`) are rejected because the underlying reader misreads them as numbers. Re-export using numeric Excel date storage (`iso_dates=False` in openpyxl); both the 1900 and 1904 date systems remain supported. Ordinary text containing an ISO date stays text. This check covers every worksheet, including unselected sheets.
- Formula caches containing an explicit empty string are rejected in v0.1: the underlying reader cannot reliably distinguish them from a missing cache. Zero and false caches are preserved.
- Formula text is compared literally. Moving a formula can change its A1 references while preserving meaning; SheetDiff does not normalize that equivalence.
- Blank rows are skipped. Added/removed rows include their populated fields. Added/removed columns produce structural changes, plus cell changes for populated values in retained rows.
- Sheet renames are reported as removal and addition. Key changes are reported as row removal and addition.

This is a table-data review tool, not a whole-workbook fidelity check. Formatting, number formats, merged layout, charts, pivots, images, comments and hyperlink targets are outside its scope. Hidden data is still read; visibility itself is not compared. Legacy XLS, macros, encrypted archives and external workbook connections are unsupported. Complex multi-table sheets may need to be exported to separate tables first.

## Limits and privacy

Inputs are capped at 20 MiB each, XLSX expanded contents at 64 MiB and 8 MiB per ZIP part, and comparisons at 10,000 change records or 24 MiB of serialized changes. The parser also caps serialized cells/rows at 100,000 and checks expanded merge, column and validation ranges before parsing. Exceeding a limit fails the comparison; a shortened report is never presented as complete.

Reports include changed cell data, source filenames and hashes. Treat HTML, report JSON and review JSON as sensitive as the workbooks. Sharing is manual. The page has no remote resources, analytics or automatic persistence. When used inside an AI host, tool results and imported comments may be sent to that host's configured model as part of its normal operation.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

`smoke:host` loads the shipped patch using a real Cordis loader and dispatches both tools through the real tool runtime, filesystem provider and sandbox policy. It also checks source bytes, overwrite rejection and plugin disposal. It uses a fresh temporary workspace; it does not change an existing Harness profile. The test is separate from a full CLI installation and does not use a live model.

## 中文简介

AI 改完表格后，先看清楚改了什么，再决定是否采用。SheetDiff 按订单号、账户号等业务主键对齐记录，避免把行列重排当成大量修改；数值、类型、公式和保存的计算结果分开显示。你可以在本地报告中逐条评论，导出后交回 Harness 继续处理。

首版只读 CSV/XLSX，不上传表格、不重算公式、不自动改文件。它不是表格编辑器，也不承诺检测格式、图表或所有 Excel 功能的变化。

MIT licensed. Bug reports are most useful with a small anonymized example and the expected comparison result. Please do not post confidential workbooks.

plugins.description: Use your Zed AI subscription (Pro / Student) from DeepSeek Harness: registers the zed-agent route with Claude + GPT models, an editable Models-page card and a model chooser.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zed-provider

Run your **Zed AI subscription** (Zed Pro / Student — the monthly prompt credits)
inside DeepSeek Harness. The bundle registers one LLM provider route,
`zed-agent`, whose turns are minted and streamed through Zed Cloud
(`https://cloud.zed.dev`) exactly as the Zed editor does it.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zed-provider
```

## Link your Zed account

Type `/zed-login` in the Harness composer. The command opens Zed's native-app
sign-in page, waits for the loopback callback, and stores the resulting grant in
the Harness credential store (`llm-zed/zed-agent`). Later requests reuse it, and
the short-lived gateway token is minted automatically and refreshed on demand.

Credentials are resolved in this order, so any one of them is enough:

1. `config.credentials` — a literal `"<userId> <accessToken>"` (or JSON) value.
2. `config.apiKeyEnv` (default `ZED_CREDENTIALS`) — resolved through the
   credential seam. The Models settings page shows this as the Zed card's key
   field, so a credential pasted there works without `/zed-login`.
3. The `llm-zed/zed-agent` grant record written by `/zed-login`.
4. The Zed editor's own local keyring entry, on macOS (`zed.dev`) and Linux
   (`secret-tool`), imported once into the grant record — sign in inside Zed and
   this plugin picks it up by itself.

`apiKeyEnv` is spelled that way because the Models page reads exactly that field
name; its value is a credential *reference*, and what it holds is the
`"<userId> <accessToken>"` pair Zed issues.

## Settings UI

Settings → **Models** → the **Zed** card carries this bundle's own editor
(`lib/client.js`, a client-module half registered on the page's
`settings.models.provider-card` seat for the `llm-zed` namespace):

- credential status, from the card's credential join plus a live
  `credentials/describe`;
- a credential field that stores `"<userId> <accessToken>"` under the reference
  `apiKeyEnv` names (read live from the settings document, default
  `ZED_CREDENTIALS`), with **Remove** to unset it;
- a refusal instead of a silent no-op when that reference is supplied by a
  read-only source such as an environment variable.

It also carries the **model chooser**: the Host registers
`llm.registerModelDiscovery` for this namespace, the page reads it through
`llm/discoverModels`, and the tick boxes write `visibleModels` through
`settings/mutate`. That field is volatile, so a tick changes the picker on the
next catalog read without a reload; an empty or complete selection unsets it,
meaning "offer every model this plugin can run".

`baseUrl` stays a composition-only field in `cordis.patch.yml`.

The client fiber hard-injects only `slots`, `locale` and `remote`, and picks the
credential remote up through `ctx.inject(['remote.credentials'], …)`. That is
deliberate: the web boot asserts that every client entry activated, so a root
client plugin that waits on a service the settings UI keeps private (such as
`settingsScope`) takes the whole GUI boot down with
`<package>: pending (waiting for service: …)`.

## Models

`listModels` reads `GET /models` with your credential and advertises the models
Zed reports for the backends this plugin implements — **Claude** (Anthropic
Messages) and **GPT** (OpenAI Responses). Zed's Gemini and Grok entries are
filtered out rather than offered broken; selecting one anyway fails fast with
`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`.

Each model carries Zed's own context window, output cap, and — when
`supports_thinking` — the effort levels `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`, mapped
onto Anthropic extended thinking budgets.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `ZED_CREDENTIALS` | Credential reference holding `"<userId> <accessToken>"`. |
| `credentials` | absent | Literal credential value; highest priority, composition-time. |
| `baseUrl` | `https://cloud.zed.dev` | Zed Cloud endpoint. |
| `visibleModels` | all supported | Narrow the catalog to these model ids. |

## Quota

Zed owns the accounting: no plan or no credits left answers HTTP 402, which
surfaces as a `QUOTA` failure naming https://zed.dev/account. The plugin does
not invent percentages or limits.

## Development

`pnpm install` (which runs the `prepare` hook), then `pnpm check` —
typecheck, build, tests. Sources are TypeScript under `src/`; `lib/` is build
output and is git-ignored, because the `prepare`/`prepack` hooks rebuild it
wherever the package is consumed and the published tarball carries the built
copy through the `files` allowlist.

A profile can install this bundle as a `link:` to a working copy, in which case
that copy's `lib/` is what the Host imports: rebuild after changing `src/`, or
the Host keeps running the previous build.

`node --test test/*.test.mjs` covers the pieces that fail silently in
production: the NDJSON → `StreamChunk` translation for both backends
(`src/frames.ts` framing, `src/parse.ts` Anthropic events, `src/responses.ts`
Responses events), the RSA sign-in handshake (`src/signin.ts`), the request
projections (`src/anthropic.ts`, `src/responses.ts`), and the card's slot
registration, credential and model-selection wiring (`src/client.ts`, loaded
under a stubbed module loader in `test/client.test.mjs`). The tests import the
built `lib/`, because that is what the Harness actually runs. Only
`src/index.ts` touches the Harness runtime.

Two install-time facts worth knowing: the Host half is re-imported only by a
profile restart (ESM caches by URL), and the client half is composed from the
Loader's entries at Host boot, so adding or removing `exports["./client"]` takes
a restart too — after that it is served per request under a content hash, so
client-side edits reach the browser on the next load.

plugins.description: Single-client session tabs preserving native sidebars and background work
plugins.readme_text:
# 轻量会话标签 / dsh-session-tabs

单客户端会话标签，复用 DSH 原生聊天视图和任务服务，保留左右侧栏及底部工作台。无 iframe，无运行时依赖。

[English](README_EN.md) · 版本 0.1.6 · MIT

[![verify](https://github.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/actions/workflows/verify.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/actions/workflows/verify.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-session-tabs.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-tabs)

![合成会话中的标签栏与面板按钮](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs/main/docs/assets/session-tabs.png)

## 当前状态

**0.1.6 修复了 0.1.5 中打开插件管理等全局页面时整个窗口卡死的问题，建议 0.1.5 用户更新。**

已针对 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2** 验证，源代码采用 MIT 协议。DSH 的客户端 API 仍在演化，升级宿主后需要重新验收。

## 使用

- 原生左栏打开的会话自动加入顶部标签。点击标签切换，`＋` 使用原生新建会话。
- 当前标签与内容区使用同一亮色表面，通过两侧底部反向圆角衔接；其他标签在较暗背景上，悬停时标题和关闭按钮共用一块灰色底色。跟随 DSH 的亮/暗主题。
- `＋` 紧跟标签，与 `×` 图标居中对齐，旁边不再显示 `⋯`。底部工作区和右侧栏入口位于标签行右端，复用对应原生按钮的图标、状态和点击事件。右栏展开后，中央的打开入口隐藏，只保留窗口最右侧原生收起按钮；打开按钮采用相同的 28px 点击区域和 15px 图标。原生其他标题栏按钮保持原位。缺少原生入口时不显示对应按钮，切回原生视图或卸载时恢复原入口。
- 右栏开关位置在动画期间固定保留，底部按钮不会挤进来。收起时若原生打开入口尚未恢复，该位置暂时禁用；就绪后恢复点击。两个按钮均使用 28px 点击区域并居中对齐，底部图标沿用原生 16px。
- `×` 只关闭标签，不删除、归档或停止会话。运行或待确认的会话在后台保留，结束后释放额外引用。
- 左栏底部的「标签窗口」线条图标用于显示/隐藏标签，悬停显示目标视图名称。焦点在标签栏内时，`⌘/Ctrl + Shift + T` 可恢复本次打开窗口内刚关闭的标签；输入框不拦截此快捷键。
- 拖动调整顺序；标签获得焦点后，左右方向键切换，`Alt + Shift + 左/右` 调整顺序。输入框没有新增全局快捷键，中文组字不受拦截。
- `●` 运行中，`!` 等待确认，`✓` 完成未读，`…` 正在连接；空闲时不显示状态圆点。

关闭整个客户端、卸载插件与关闭标签是不同操作。原生任务的存续仍由宿主负责。不同会话同时修改同一文件的冲突也仍由宿主与用户处理。

## 安装与回退

### 从 npm 安装和下载（推荐）

npm 页面：[dsh-session-tabs](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-tabs)。建议先在独立 profile 试用。

**Desktop：**在应用内插件管理器添加 `dsh-session-tabs`。

**Web：**使用 DSH 命令安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6
```

如果使用 npm 手动管理 profile，先进入目标 profile 目录，再执行：

```sh
npm install dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6 --ignore-scripts
```

手动安装包后，还需在该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中启用 `dsh-session-tabs`，再刷新或重开 DSH；DSH 插件管理器和上面的 `dsh plugin` 命令会处理插件启用。

**只下载离线安装包：**在希望保存文件的目录运行：

```sh
npm pack dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6
```

会生成 `dsh-session-tabs-0.1.6.tgz`，可在 DSH 插件管理器中用该文件的完整路径添加。

### 从 GitHub 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:QIN-SMART/dsh-session-tabs
```

CLI 的 `--profile desktop` 是保留名称，不能套用上述 Web 命令。已有本地安装的用户可在目标 profile 的包管理器更新为 `dsh-session-tabs@0.1.6`，再完全退出并重开应用。开发用的模拟模型和测试 profile 不包含在 npm 包中。

临时回退：点击左栏底部的视图切换图标。完整移除：在目标 profile 的插件管理器移除 `dsh-session-tabs`，再刷新客户端；注入节点、样式、订阅与会话引用会清理。浏览器本地标签清单仍保留，可在需要时清除该站点的 `dsh-session-tabs.v1` 键。

## 状态和性能

标签顺序、启用偏好及活动身份存于 `localStorage['dsh-session-tabs.v1']`。刷新恢复标签；失效/归档 ID 会剔除。不同窗口同步偏好与标签身份，但不会抢占另一个窗口的当前会话。

只有一棵原生聊天视图。重开客户端时，非活动标签只恢复身份，不立即加载全部历史。已经访问过的标签保留轻量会话绑定，以沿用原生草稿/附件状态；其数量仍会影响内存，因此本插件不承诺无限标签或固定内存开销。草稿沿用原生机制，本插件不提供跨重启草稿持久化保证。

标签节点按身份复用，点击后立即更新标签；后台状态通知合并更新，浏览器存储写入短暂合并。实际会话内容仍由宿主原生导航加载，不能保证所有开关操作即时完成。实际验证范围与兼容性边界见 [验收说明](docs/validation.md)。

中心挂载点使用稳定 `data-slot="main"`，没有专用的官方标签栏插槽；宿主结构变化是主要兼容性风险。原生 sidebar/rightbar 插槽和右栏服务没有被替换或代理。顶栏入口仅转发到仍留在原处的原生控件，不搬动 React 管理的节点。若挂载失败，回滚新增节点并保留原生界面。

## 开发与验收

开发本仓库时：

```sh
node --test test/verify.mjs
node tools/start-test-profile.mjs --runtime /absolute/path/to/installed/@deepseek-ai/dsh --port 3096
# 可选复用已安装的右栏插件：--better-sidebar /absolute/path/to/dsh-better-sidebar
```

测试数据、profile 和日志仅写入本仓库 `.tmp/`。测试模型 `Local delayed echo` 本地流式输出约 60 秒，无网络模型请求；需在界面中明确选择该模型后发送合成任务。它仅用于验证并发、关闭和取消隔离。

真实 GUI 冒烟：`node tools/real-ui-check.mjs --url-file /absolute/path/to/test-url.txt --out docs/real-ui.png`，URL 文件仅保存隔离服务启动时给出的本机认证 URL，不提交。连接自己启动的 Electron 验收副本可用 `--connect-port 9346 --target-match <observed-main-target>`。`--edge-ui-check` 检查右栏开关；配合 `--handoff-ui-check` 在上述合成会话中检查底部按钮规格、连续点击和动画期间的位置。范围见 [验收说明](docs/validation.md)。

源码不需要构建，`lib/client.js` 即真实客户端产物；`npm pack` 只包含生产插件和说明，不包含测试模型、日志、profile、桌面副本或截图。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: Three-level source-text pins for DeepSeek Harness that survive context compaction: recall on demand, resident background, or highlighted constraints.
plugins.readme_text:
# highlightpin

[![Check](https://github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/actions/workflows/check.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

**Pin any selected passage; compaction cannot take it away.**

[中文](README.zh.md) · [Design](DESIGN.md) · [Evaluation](EVAL.md) · [Live evidence](docs/PROBES.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin. Select any stretch of text in a conversation — a constraint, a number, a formula, a piece of code — and pin it with one click. From then on, no matter how the context is compacted, what the model receives is that **source text**, not a summary.

## Three levels

Each pin carries its own level:

| Level | Behaviour | Good for | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| **pin** (default) | Does nothing while the text is still in context; once compaction drops it, the extract text is re-inserted verbatim near the tail before the next request | Most pins | Never touches the system prompt, so it does not break the prefix cache on its own |
| **resident** | Lives in the system prompt with neutral wording: "consult it when relevant; no need to bring it up" | Important background: you want the model to match on it the moment it matters, without you mentioning it every turn | Costs one prefix-cache invalidation when you switch levels |
| **highlight** | Lives in the system prompt with emphatic wording: "follow it when relevant; if it conflicts with your latest explicit instruction, the latest instruction wins" | Constraints and priorities the model must keep honouring | Same as above; emphasis also raises how often the model brings it up on its own |

`resident` and `highlight` are deliberately two separate levels. "The model can always find it" and "the model always keeps it in mind" are different things, and emphasis has side effects of its own — so the choice is yours.

## Installation

From npm (published releases):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-highlightpin@0.1.2
```

Or straight from the GitHub source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'https://codeload.github.com/sbearbug/dsh-highlightpin/tar.gz/v0.1.2'
```

On the web profile, replace `desktop` with `web`. After installing or upgrading, **fully quit and restart DSH**, then refresh the page, so that host and client both load the new version. Existing pins survive.

### Compatible DSH versions

`peerDependencies` declares `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.2.0-0 || >=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`. The DSH plugin manager checks these peers with `semver.satisfies(runtimeVersion, range, { includePrerelease: true })` and blocks installation and activation on a mismatch.

The range carries an explicit prerelease branch on purpose: under ordinary semver semantics a single `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` does not match the `0.2.0-rc.*` builds, because node-semver admits a prerelease only when some comparator in the range shares its exact `major.minor.patch` tuple and itself carries a prerelease tag.

| DSH version | Status |
|---|---|
| 0.2.0-rc.2 | **Verified live** — development and real-machine checks both ran on this version |
| 0.1.7-rc.1 / 0.1.7-rc.2 | **Offline suite passes**; CI re-runs the same suite against this line on every push |
| Other 0.2.x | Inferred from the APIs used, not verified individually |
| ≤ 0.1.6 | **Unsupported**: `CommandDefinitionId` does not exist at 0.1.5 and below, and the 0.1.6 line's session-event validation already differs |
| ≥ 0.3.0 | Not claimed |

## Usage

1. Select text inside **one** finished user or assistant message.
2. Click the pin above the composer.
3. Click the arrow beside it to open the details panel: switch each pin between "recall / resident / highlight", check budget usage, or unpin.

When you select inside a formula, the selection is expanded to the whole formula and what gets stored is the TeX source. Select the rendered $\nabla_\theta J(\theta)$ and the plugin stores `$\nabla_\theta J(\theta)$` — not the glyphs on screen. Selections inside code keep their indentation and line breaks.

Everything is also available from the command line:

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/hlpin list` | List every pin, its level and budget usage |
| `/hlpin last` | Pin the most recent assistant reply in full |
| `/hlpin show <n>` | Show one pin's full text |
| `/hlpin drop <n>` | Unpin |
| `/hlpin level <n> pin\|resident\|highlight` | Change a pin's level |

## Design notes

- **What is stored is source text, not screen text.** The client serialises the selection first (formulas back to TeX, copy buttons and line numbers stripped out), and the host then locates the matching source substring in the session log. Alignment reports one of three fidelities: `source-exact` (a clean hit), `source-normalized` (matched after whitespace and Markdown normalisation, but still storing a source slice), or `rendered` (no match — it stores the display text and **tells you so**).
- **`pin` only re-inserts after the original is gone.** Right after pinning, the text is already in context, so re-injecting it would be pointless. It comes back only once compaction has shadowed it — and at that moment the prefix cache was already invalidated. So the default level cannot break caching by construction.
- **The decision is a pure function that keeps no ledger.** Every step re-decides from "is this text still in context", and records nothing like "already re-inserted". A rejected step, a plugin restart, or the recall notice itself being compacted later therefore cannot lose a pin.
- **The resident section and the recall notice never duplicate each other.** Each step records which pins actually went into the system prompt for that step, and the recall path excludes them. With no such record it re-inserts as usual: better to duplicate than to lose.
- **Over budget means rejection, not truncation.** `pin`, `resident` and `highlight` each have their own character pool. Adding or promoting past a pool's budget is rejected outright with an error code; demotion is always allowed. The plugin never quietly truncates, evicts, or demotes a pin.
- **The session log format is left alone.** Pins live in the official `storageDomain`, and recall uses a message type the host already has, so a session can never become unloadable from an unknown event. The HTTP API is origin-checked and accepts JSON only from the local page.

The full set of trade-offs is in [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).

## Verification status

- **Live**: "pin → `/compact` → next message" has been run end-to-end in DSH. The shadowed source text appeared in the next request's input, byte-identical to what was stored, with a matching SHA-256. Evidence: [docs/PROBES.md](docs/PROBES.md) and [docs/m1-live-0.1.4.json](docs/m1-live-0.1.4.json).
- **Offline**: alignment, selection serialisation, the decision function, all three injection paths, budgets, routes, commands and React interaction are covered by tests, run by CI on every push.


## Configuration

```json
{ "maxPinChars": 16000, "maxResidentChars": 6000, "maxHighlightChars": 2000, "holdSubagents": false }
```

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `maxPinChars` | 16000 | Total source characters across `pin` pins |
| `maxResidentChars` | 6000 | Total source characters across `resident` pins |
| `maxHighlightChars` | 2000 | Total source characters across `highlight` pins |
| `holdSubagents` | `false` | Whether subagent sessions are covered too (off by default, to avoid wasting tokens) |

Characters are counted in UTF-16 units. Neither the number of pins nor the length of a single pin is capped; only the total per level is.

## Limitations

- Selections must stay within a single message; cross-message selections are not supported.
- Streaming messages, reasoning content and tool output are not supported.
- Pins belong to one session; forked sessions do not inherit them.
- One writer host per profile is supported.
- "Highlight" here is an emphasis level in the model input; it does not draw a visual highlight on the original message.


## Development

```sh
npm ci
npm run check   # build the client + run all te

# DSH 提示词增强器

**简体中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件。在输入框写提示词，点一下按钮，模型改写后替换输入框内容。

- 包名：`@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer`
- 仓库：https://github.com/JianYiAG/dsh-prompt-enhancer
- 许可：MIT

---

## 安装

**桌面端**：

1. 左侧栏进「插件」页
2. 安装 bundle，填 `@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer`
3. 完全退出应用后重新打开

**CLI / Web 端**：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer
```

CLI 安装后若未生效，在「插件」页勾选该插件，或把包名加入 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，然后重启应用。

安装与常见问题见 [DISTRIBUTION.md](DISTRIBUTION.md)。

---

## 使用

1. 在输入框输入提示词
2. 点模型选择器左侧的按钮
3. 按钮停止转动后，输入框内容已替换为改写结果；不满意可在输入框内撤销

输入框为空时按钮不显示。

也可输入 `/prompt-enhance 提示词`，结果以命令结果行显示，不写回输入框。

---

## 配置

默认使用当前会话的模型。可在 profile 补丁中指定固定模型：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: prompt-enhancer
      name: '@jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer'
      config:
        provider: <provider-id>
        model: <model-id>
```

两个字段需同时提供；删除 `config` 即恢复使用会话模型。

---

## 卸载

桌面端在「插件」页卸载；CLI：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @jianyiagi/dsh-prompt-enhancer
```

---

MIT

plugins.description: Per-workspace persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): sidebar panel, automatic system-prompt injection, and an agent tool to save memories
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-memories

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered_by-dsh-4D6BFE?style=flat-square&logo=deepseek&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workspace-memories?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workspace-memories)
[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)

**Per-workspace persistent memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH)** — a plugin that gives every workspace its own durable memory files, injects them into every session running in that workspace, and lets both you and the agent manage them.

## Why this plugin exists

DSH agents are stateless across sessions: everything a session "learns" — your project's decisions, conventions, hard-won debugging facts — lives only in that conversation's context and is gone when it ends. The built-in mechanism for durable knowledge is `AGENTS.md`, but it is a static, project-owned instruction file: the agent cannot update it on its own, and **some things should not live in the project folder at all** — server addresses and topologies, local environment quirks, machine-specific paths, personal working conventions. Anything under the project tree risks being committed to git by accident.

This plugin closes that gap with a small, explicit memory loop whose default storage is **outside the project directory**:

1. **Every workspace gets a memory directory** — by default under the DSH data directory (`~/.dsh/workspace-memory/<workspace>/`), never inside the repo. Plain Markdown you can read, diff, and back up. (An opt-in `workspace` storage mode keeps memories in `<workspace>/.dsh/memory/` for teams who *want* them versioned alongside the code.)
2. **Memories are injected automatically** — each session created in a workspace carries that workspace's memory files in its system prompt, alongside `AGENTS.md`, so a fresh session starts already "remembering".
3. **The agent can write memories itself** — a global `save_workspace_memory` tool lets any session persist a decision, server detail, convention, or preference the moment you say "remember this".
4. **You stay in control** — a sidebar panel lists, creates, edits, and deletes memory files per workspace, so memory stays inspectable and correctable instead of hidden in a database.

## Features

| Capability | Where |
|---|---|
| Browse / create / edit / delete memory files | **Workspace Memory** sidebar panel (switch workspaces via the selector) |
| Ask the agent to remember something | Any session: "remember: …" → the agent calls `save_workspace_memory` |
| Automatic recall | Every session in the workspace gets its memory files injected into its system prompt |

Works in every built-in agent preset (Standard, PTC, Minimal, Creator): the tool is registered in the root composition, and global tools are visible to all presets unless a custom preset opts out with a `tools.restrict` allow list — add `save_workspace_memory` to that list if so.

## Installation

The package is plain JavaScript with no build step, so every install channel works:

```sh
# from npm (once published)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workspace-memories

# straight from GitHub (no build script needed — sources ship as-is)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lengfengng-tech/dsh-workspace-memories

# from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-workspace-memories
```

Or use the GUI: sidebar **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste a package name, GitHub address, or absolute local path, then **Enable now**.

Uninstall: the Plugins page, or `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-workspace-memories`.

## Usage

- Open the **Workspace Memory** entry in the sidebar. The selector defaults to the workspace of the current session. **New file** creates a `.md` memory (the extension is added when missing); select a file to edit, save, or delete it.
- Tell the agent "remember: this project uses pnpm, not npm" — it writes a memory file that every session of the workspace (and the panel) sees immediately.
- Storage and layout are configurable: `storage: home` (default, DSH data directory, outside the project) or `storage: workspace` (inside the project at `directory`, default `.dsh/memory`).

## Important: start a new session after installing or upgrading

Tool registration takes effect immediately on the host, but **a model's visible tool list is assembled when each conversation turn starts**:

- If a session's current turn began *before* the plugin was installed or reloaded, that turn's tool declaration is stale. This is most visible in **PTC mode**, where the model reads a pre-generated TypeScript binding (`ToolArgsMap`) that does not yet contain `save_workspace_memory` — the model may conclude "there is no memory tool", or fall back to probing the tool by name through the code channel (which actually works, since dispatch goes through the live host registry).
- **The fix is simple: start a new session, or just send a new message after the current turn ends.** The next turn regenerates the tool declaration and `save_workspace_memory` appears normally — no probing needed.

Memory injection into the system prompt is attached when an agent is created (session start, resume after a restart, clear, or compaction); once attached, a session picks up changed memory files on its next step automatically.

## Data layout and safety

Two storage modes, chosen by the plugin's `storage` config:

| Mode | Memory location | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| `home` (default) | `~/.dsh/workspace-memory/<workspace-key>/` — outside the project | Machine-local or sensitive notes: server configs, environment quirks, personal conventions |
| `workspace` | `<workspace>/.dsh/memory/` — inside the project | Team-shared memories meant to be committed alongside the code |

```
~/.dsh/workspace-memory/     # default memory store, one subdirectory per workspace
dsh-workspace-memories/        # this plugin
├── package.json             #   bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client)
├── cordis.patch.yml         #   plugin row declaration
├── index.js                 #   host: /api routes + prompt injection + the save tool
├── client.js                #   browser: sidebar entry + management panel
├── locale/                  #   panel copy (en, zh)
├── icon.svg
└── selftest.mjs             #   host-logic self-test: node selftest.mjs
```

Safety constraints: the browser panel can only address registered workspaces by `workspaceId` (no arbitrary host paths); file names are strictly validated (no path separators, `..`, whitespace, or control characters); one file is capped at 1 MiB; prompt injection truncates each file to 32K characters and caps at 20 files.

## Development

- Install with a `link:` dependency (local-path install does this): editing `client.js` hot-reloads in the page via the client HMR receiver; editing `index.js` (host code) requires a DSH restart to load the new module generation.
- Run the self-test: `node selftest.mjs` (mocks the plugin context; covers routes, prompt rendering, tool writes, and validation failures).
- Runtime checks: host entry `include:workspace-memory` should be `active`; the client slot `sidebar.panellist` should list a `workspace-memory` occupant; `save_workspace_memory` should appear in the tool list.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) — © 2026 lengfengng-tech

---

This is a community plugin built on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness); it is not an official DeepSeek product. Naming follows the [DSH brand guidelines](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md).

plugins.description: MCP Master for DeepSeek Harness: per-session MCP server picker with global and project (.mcp.json) catalogs, OAuth sign-in, and trust review
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-master

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**MCP Master for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).** Choose which MCP servers each session uses — from your **global** list and the workspace's **project** list — with a picker that sits right before the composer's model selector. Pick them when a session starts, and switch them at any time afterwards, just like the model.

- **Project servers** come from the files other agents already use: `.mcp.json` (Claude Code), `.cursor/mcp.json`, `.vscode/mcp.json`, `.dsh/mcp.json`.
- **Global servers** come from `~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json` (same `mcpServers` format). A project server shadows a global one of the same name.

```json
// <workspace>/.mcp.json  or  ~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "orion-mcp":            { "command": "uv", "args": ["run", "--project", ".", "orion-mcp"] },
    "atlassian-mcp-server": { "type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp/authv2" },
    "conduktor-console":    { "command": "npx", "args": ["mcp-remote", "https://…/api/mcp", "--header", "Authorization: Bearer ${CONDUKTOR_API_TOKEN}"], "enabled": false }
  }
}
```

## The picker

`[ 🔌 MCP 2 ● ]  [ model ▾ ]  [ ➤ ]` — in the composer row of every session, including a brand-new one.

- **Zero footprint when unused**: no global or project servers → nothing renders.
- **Chip**: number of servers active in this session and one status dot for them (green connected · amber sign-in needed · red failing · pulsing starting). A small blue dot means project servers await review.
- **Panel** (click the chip; Esc / click outside to close): *Project* and *Global* groups. Each row has a **checkbox = use in this session**, status, transport, a `default` tag, and inline **Sign in** / **Retry**. Expand a row for the command/URL (as written — never variable-expanded), auth, server version, tools, logs, Reconnect, Sign out, Revoke trust.
- **Footer**: what new sessions start with, and **Use for new sessions** to save the current selection as this workspace's default (**Reset** returns to the files' own `enabled` flags).
- Theme tokens only (light/dark follow the app); copy follows **Settings → General → Language**.

## How sessions get servers

| Topic | Behavior |
|---|---|
| New session | Starts from the workspace default: the saved one, or else every trusted server whose file entry is not `"enabled": false` / `"disabled": true`. |
| Forks & subagents | Inherit the parent session's selection (`parentSession`). |
| Switching later | Checking/unchecking registers/unregisters that server's tools in **this session only**, from the next step on. DSH itself records tool additions/removals in the session log (`developer/message` tool-addition/removal), so history, resume, and replay stay consistent — unlike an agent preset, which is a whole plugin composition and therefore locked once the session starts. |
| Persistence | Selections, defaults, trust, and OAuth tokens live in `~/.dsh/mcp-master/state.json` (0600). Config files are never modified. |
| Process lifetime | A server runs while a live session — or a session open in the UI but not started yet — selects it; it stops 2 minutes after the last one deselects it, and a workspace with no sessions or viewers shuts down after 15 idle minutes. |

## Trust (project servers)

A `.mcp.json` in a cloned repository can run any command, so project servers must be **trusted** before they run (same model as Claude Code's project-server approval). Checking an untrusted server shows the exact command/URL with **Trust & use**. Trust is per workspace and bound to the entry as written: if the command, args, env, URL, or headers change, the server becomes **Changed** and needs review again. Global servers are yours and always trusted. `autoTrust: true` skips the review.

## Transports and auth

- **stdio** (own process group, reaped with its children; cwd = workspace root), **Streamable HTTP** (session ids, SSE responses, `list_changed` stream), **legacy HTTP+SSE** (automatic fallback). Server→client `ping` / `roots/list` are answered.
- **OAuth** per the MCP authorization spec: RFC 9728 → RFC 8414/OIDC discovery → RFC 7591 dynamic client registration → authorization code + PKCE (S256) with RFC 8707 `resource`, then refresh. Tokens are keyed by server URL, so one sign-in covers every workspace. An explicit `Authorization` header is used as-is; `"oauth": { "clientId", "clientSecret", "scope" }` covers providers without dynamic registration.
- **Variables**: `${VAR}`, `${VAR:-default}`, `${env:VAR}`, `${workspaceFolder}` — resolved from DSH's environment layered over your login-shell environment (so `~/.zshrc` exports and your shell `PATH` work in the desktop app).
- **Tools** are named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` like the built-in MCP client; input schemas are folded into the registry's JSON-Schema subset (`$ref`, nullable `anyOf`, type arrays, `allOf`; dropped constraints become description hints); `readOnlyHint` tools may run in parallel.

## Configuration (optional)

```yaml
# your profile's cordis.patch.yml
- id: mcp-master
  name: dsh-mcp-master
  config:
    globalConfigFile: ~/.dsh/mcp-master/mcp.json   # false disables the global scope
    configFiles: [.mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, .dsh/mcp.json]
    autoTrust: false
    searchParents: true          # also look in parent directories of the session cwd
    startupWaitMs: 5000          # a new session waits this long for selected servers that are still starting
    connectTimeoutMs: 60000
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 300000
    idleShutdownMinutes: 15
```

## Security notes

- `/mcp-master/api/*` passes DSH's connection fence (Host/Origin + browser authentication); mutating calls also need a custom header that cross-origin pages cannot send without a CORS preflight; paths must be inside registered workspaces or live session directories.
- The OAuth redirect (`/mcp-master/oauth/callback`) opens in your system browser without the DSH cookie and is authorized by a single-use 192-bit `state`.
- Logs and the UI redact codes, tokens, and `Bearer` values; command lines are shown unexpanded. `state.json` holds tokens — treat it like a credentials file.

## Develop

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run verify          # build + typecheck + tests (node --test runs the .ts tests directly)
```

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | Host entry: options, agent lifecycle hooks, route mounting |
| `src/host/config.ts` | Catalog discovery (project + global), dialects, variable expansion, fingerprints |
| `src/host/runtime.ts` | Trust, defaults, per-session selections, server lifecycle, per-agent tool registration |
| `src/host/state.ts` | Persistent state (`~/.dsh/mcp-master/state.json`) |
| `src/host/stdio.ts`, `http.ts`, `jsonrpc.ts` | MCP transports and JSON-RPC plumbing (zero runtime dependencies) |
| `src/host/oauth.ts` | MCP authorization (discovery, DCR, PKCE, refresh) |
| `src/host/schema.ts`, `tools.ts` | Schema folding and ToolDefinitions |
| `src/host/api.ts` | HTTP API + OAuth callback |
| `src/client/*` | Composer picker (React; `__ModuleLoader__` bundle; portal popover like the model menu) |
| `src/shared/types.ts` | Wire contract between the halves |

After rebuilding an installed copy, restart DSH: the Host module is an ES module and is not re-imported in place.

plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的每条回复下面加一行：本次问答花了多少钱 + 账户余额（充值/礼金分开列，没有礼金就只显示充值余额）。鼠标悬停时显示饼图。按该轮 token 用量乘官方峰谷单价计算，内置节假日表；算不出价就写明原因，不静默出错。插件自身不联网（余额由 dsh 宿主查询）、不落盘、无依赖。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-cost-receipt [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/divineeagleblackhand/dsh-cost-receipt) 在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）每条回复下面加一行：**本次问答花了多少钱**，以及账户余额。鼠标悬停可看费用构成的饼图，按花费占比画。 ``` 本次问答花费 ¥0.165824 账户余额 ¥6.2164 礼金余额 ¥1.5366 ``` ## 特点 - **按"一问一答"计价**：每条回复下面一行，看的是刚才这一问花了多少。历史轮次也有数字，按它当时的时段定价，打开旧会话照样算得出来。 - **余额拆成两个数**：`账户余额`只算充值余额，`礼金余额`另起一项，相加才是钱包总额。没有礼金时第二项不显示。余额只出现在每条对话的最新一轮（历史轮次显示当时的钱没有意义）。 - **悬停看费用构成**：本次问答与整场对话**并排两个环，按花费占比画**，不是 token 占比。因为缓存命中的 token 通常占 99%，却只占不到四成花费；按 token 画会退化成一个看不见的细弧。 - **算不出价就写明原因**，绝不静默出错：角标会直接写 `未收录模型 xxx`、`混用多模型（a + b）`、`用量未标注模型`。拿别的模型的单价硬套会错好几倍，而且看不出来。 - **角标上的时刻表示"未变"，不是"刚读过"**：宿主会缓存账号查询，所以那个 `HH:MM:SS` 是**余额上次变化的时刻** —— 时刻不动＝数字没再变过。鼠标悬停还能看到**最后一次查询时刻**，两个一对比就知道是读数陈旧、还是余额真的没动。 ## 安装 从 npm 装（推荐：名字短，还能锁版本）： ``` dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-cost-receipt ``` 或直接从 GitHub 仓库装： ``` dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/divineeagleblackhand/dsh-cost-receipt ``` 也可以在 dsh 插件页的「添加插件」里粘上面任意一条地址（桌面版的 profile 名就是 `desktop`）。 装完刷新页面。若角标没出现，完全退出并重启桌面版。 > 若直连 GitHub 困难，用 npm 那条命令；或先把仓库克隆到本地，再用绝对路径安装。 ## 隐私与联网 - **插件自身不直接联网**：`client.js` / `index.js` 里没有任何 `fetch`、`XMLHttpRequest`、WebSocket 调用，可以逐行核对。 - **余额经由宿主查询**：插件通过 dsh 宿主的 `account/getBalance` 取余额（和你打开账号设置看到的是同一条路径），因此**每 30 秒会触发一次账号查询，页面不可见时降为每 3 分钟一次**。这是它唯一与外部有关的动作，走的是 dsh 自带的账号功能，账号令牌始终只在宿主手里。 - **零存储**：不写任何文件，不用 localStorage。 - **零凭据访问**：不读 API Key，不读任何配置文件。 - 唯一读取的本地数据是当前会话的 token 用量，也就是 dsh 自己「本轮用量」面板用的那一份。 > 仓库里的 `tools/fetch-holidays.mjs` 是**维护脚本**，用来刷新内置的节假日表：它需要联网（默认查第三方节假日 API，也可传入国务院通知原文的 URL 做交叉校验），由维护者**一年手动跑一次**，而且**不会随 npm 包发布给用户**（打包白名单 `files` 里只有插件运行必需的那几个文件）。 ## 计价口径与边界 | 项 | 口径 | |---|---| | 一轮 | 一次问答：一条用户消息 → 最终回复 | | 计价 | 缓存命中输入 / 未缓存输入 / 缓存写入 / 输出 四桶分别乘单价。缓存写入按未命中输入计价（官方没有单独的缓存写入价） | | 单价 | 人民币 / 百万 token，按模型分开，取自官方价目表 | | 时段 | 高峰＝北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，**不含法定节假日**，其余时间空闲价。判定与你的系统时区无关 | | 节假日 | 内置国务院 2026 年安排（19 天）。未收录的年份退回"不修正"，不会给错答案，只是不再修正 | | 币种 | **只支持人民币账户**。检测到非人民币钱包时一个金额都不显示，只提示「仅支持人民币账户」 | 已知误差： - **跨峰谷边界的轮次**按该轮结束时刻整轮定价，最坏偏 50%（一轮 5 分钟跨界的概率约 1.4%）。 - **整场累计**只覆盖已加载进视图的轮次；超长会话分页时这个数会偏低。 - **单价表与节假日表会随官方更新**，需要手动改常量（见下）。 ## 兼容性 - 需要 **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2**：插件依赖它内部的 turn-tail 数据与 account Remote。dsh 升级后如果角标消失，第一个要怀疑的就是这里。 - Web 版与桌面版均可，Windows 与 macOS 均可（纯客户端插件，不碰文件系统，也没有平台分支）。 - 非人民币账户不显示金额（见上）。 ## 开发 ``` npm test ``` 测试脚本会**从 `client.js` 里切片抽出真实的计价代码来执行**，而不是复制一份——避免"测的和跑的不是同一份"。覆盖：峰谷时段边界、节假日、三项拆解对账、饼图与角标同源、会话累计、悬停面板结构、币种判定、中英字典对齐。 - 改价格表：`client.js` 顶部的 `PRICES` - 刷新节假日表：`node tools/fetch-holidays.mjs <年份>`（可再传国务院通知原文 URL 做交叉校验） ## 许可 MIT --- **English** — A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin that adds one line under every reply showing what that exchange cost, priced from the turn's own token usage at the official peak/off-peak CNY rates, together with the account and bonus balances. Hover for a cost breakdown of the exchange versus the whole conversation. When a price cannot be computed it says why instead of guessing. The plugin makes no network calls of its own — the balance is read through the dsh host, which is also how dsh's own account page reads it; it stores nothing and never touches credentials. Requires dsh 0.2.0-rc.2; CNY accounts only.

plugins.description: DSH 文档批注台：在 DeepSeek Harness 里划词批注，批注落盘为 sidecar，Agent 读批注改稿并回标状态。
plugins.readme_text:
# @caihua/dsh-doc-review · DSH 文档批注台

在 DSH 里直接对方案文档**划词批注**，批注落盘成 sidecar 文件，Agent 用 `doc_review_*` 工具读批注改稿，改完回标状态。

## 30 秒装上

两个办法，任选一个。

**办法一：让你 DSH 里的 AI 自己装（推荐）**

把下面这句话整段发给你自己 DSH 会话里的 AI：

> 帮我装一个 DSH 插件：`github:caihua8669/dsh-doc-review`。
> 装到桌面端正在用的那个 profile（不是 web），用桌面端自带的 CLI（`resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd`）执行 `plugin --profile <profile名> add github:caihua8669/dsh-doc-review`。
> 装完确认三件事：①命令退出码为 0；②该 profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 都出现了 `@caihua/dsh-doc-review`；③`GET http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/dsh-doc-review/ping` 有响应（说明宿主半边挂上了）。最后刷新页面，确认会话页顶部页签栏出现「批注」。

**办法二：自己敲一行**

```bash
# 桌面端自带的 CLI；profile 名换成你正在用的（桌面端通常是 desktop）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:caihua8669/dsh-doc-review
```

装完刷新页面，会话页顶部页签栏里会出现「批注」。

**要求**：DSH 桌面端（或任意 profile）+ Node 20 以上。不需要构建，仓库里带的就是能直接跑的 `lib`。

## 它解决什么

以前的改稿回环：把段落复制到聊天窗口 → 下一行写建议 → 发出去。批注台把这一步改成：**在文档上划词 → 旁边写意见 → 点「交给 AI 改稿」**，Agent 拿到的是带行号、带原文引用、带作者与状态的结构化批注，不再丢上下文。

对话划词菜单的「添加到对话」在输入框插入原生引用徽章。发送时记录来源会话和完整选文，引用中的结束标记按原文保留。插件通过 DSH 的 `conversation.chat.node` 消息槽位显示可展开、可收起的引用徽章，刷新后从历史消息恢复，无需重建或替换桌面应用。普通消息继续使用宿主渲染器；停用插件后引用仍保留为带来源的文本。这里支持展开原文，暂不定位到来源消息。

## 界面在哪

DSH 会话页顶部页签栏里的 **「批注」**（与「对话轨迹」「上下文」「白板看板」并列）。三栏：

- 左：**按优先级列文档**。标题条右侧两个图标按钮切换视图（目录树 ⇄ 平铺，本机记忆选择）；
  结果行上是「N 篇」计数（详情挂在悬浮）加「范围」下拉——展开后选三档，末项是「重扫并刷新」：
  - **相关**（默认）：两层优先级，不扫文件夹全量。
    - 第一层「本会话产出 / 编辑」：这个会话里 agent 真正 read / write / edit 过的文档，加上 `deliverables/presented`（交付给你的文件）与 `agent/inbox/spliced`（子代理产出，子代理写的文档只在这里出现）。条目上标「产出 / 编辑 / 读过」，时间显示的是**会话里最后一次动它的时间**，并用它排序（比文件 mtime 更贴近「会话里最新那篇」）。
    - 第二层「本项目其它会话碰过」：同一工作区里**最近 15 个会话**（可配 `projectSessions`）碰过的文档并集，去重后按文档改动时间倒序。标「本项目」，悬浮显示来自几个会话。这一层回答的是「这个项目里被工作过的文档」，不是 `C:\业务\其他` 那 5,494 篇全量。
    - **有搜索词时**改在项目文件夹里全量找（否则只搜得到已经碰过的那几篇），提示行会写「搜索：项目文件夹全量」。
  - **工作区**：会话 cwd 下的全部 md（想翻整个文件夹时用）。
  - **全库**：配置 `roots`（缺省 `C:\业务`）下的全部 md，**24,856 篇**（深度不限，实测扫完 1.6 秒）。
  - 两层都空时，自动放宽到「工作区」并在提示行标注原因，不会给你一个空列表。
  - **层间不混排**：本会话的永远在最前，层内才按时间/待处理排；结果行右侧另一个按钮切「按最近 ⇄ 按待处理优先」。
  - 列表项显示相对时间（今天 16:20 / 昨天 09:05 / 08-29 14:00）、待处理条数与批注总数。底部输入框可直接粘绝对路径。
  - 返回给界面的始终是「最新 400 篇」（搜索时是命中的最新 400 篇）；批注数只挂在这 400 篇上算，所以「待处理优先」是在最近 400 篇里的排序。
  - 缓存：全库/工作区扫描 5 分钟，本会话转写 20 秒（会话进行中一直在长），本项目聚合 10 分钟。真实数据实测：本工作区 205 个会话 / 140MB 转写，取最近 15 个会话解码 + 合并统计共 **311ms**。
  - 会话碰过的文档即使不在 `roots` 里（比如插件源码、`~/.dsh/skills` 下的文件）也允许打开与写批注；没被碰过的域外路径仍然拒。
  - **踩过的坑（2026-10-11）**：①`getConfig()` 里曾写死 `Math.min(disk.maxDocs, 5000)`，把配置的 60000 静默压成 5000；叠加 `maxDepth: 9`，全库只扫到 7,960 篇（约三分之一）。现在钳位上限放到 200000 / 64 层。②**一个会话目录里可能有多份转写**（`session.jsonl.zstd` / `session.v3.jsonl.zstd` / `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`…），旧版文件按字母序排在前面；曾用 `files.find()` 取第一个 ⇒ 读到几个月前的旧转写，会话最近做的事全看不到（实测 `session-7c58dbd2`：v3=9/23 旧稿 306 次引用 vs v4=今天 519 次；修好后该会话第一层从 3 篇变 15 篇）。现在会把该目录下**所有**转写合并（同一路径累加次数、取较晚的发生时间），第二层按会话取最新那一份以省时间。
  - 回归断言覆盖上述两条（`test/scan-coverage.mjs` 对数量、烟测第 [15] 组对多转写）。
- 中：Markdown 正文（标题/段落/列表/表格/引用/代码块/分割线/行内强调）。**选中任意文字**弹出批注框，`Ctrl+Enter` 保存。
  - 批注框默认贴在**选区上方**（下沿离选区留 10px），上方放不下（选区在视口顶部 170px 内）才落到选区下方；横向与选区左沿对齐并夹在视口内——**任何情况下都不压住选中的文字**。定位算法抽成纯函数 `floatPlacement(rect, vw, vh)`，有 8 条断言。
  - 弹框抢走焦点后浏览器原生选区会变淡，所以用 CSS Custom Highlight（`::highlight(dr-pending)`）把选区持续标黄，并在框内显示所选文字前 28 字，避免「改着改着忘了选的是哪段」。
- **建议模式（改稿默认走这条路）**：AI 不再直接改文件，而是先用 `doc_change_propose` 登记改动提案（`quote` 原文 → `after` 新文 + `note` 为什么），落 `<文档目录>/.dsh-review/<文件名>.proposals.json`。**登记时文件一个字都不动**；用户在「批注」页的「待审改动」面板逐条 接受/拒绝（可填拒绝原因），**接受那一刻才真正写文件**，并按 `quote` 重新定位（文档后来被别人改过也能对上；原文彻底找不到就一个字都不写并说明是哪几条对不上）。受影响的段落在正文里会挂一条**内联预览**（红=原文、绿=拟改）+ 就地接受/拒绝按钮。
- 右：批注卡片（飞书式），底部是整篇级意见。
  - 卡片：#序号 / 行号 / 状态 / 原文引用 / 意见，可 已处理·退回·删除；自己写的批注可「编辑」（记 `x_updated_at`）。
  - **回复串**：每条批注下可来回回复（回车发送）；AI 的 `doc_review_reply` / `doc_review_resolve` 回填也追加进同一串，不覆盖上一条。
  - **双向联动**：点卡片，正文滚到锚点并加深高亮；点正文里的高亮，右栏滚到对应卡片。锚点用 CSS Custom Highlight 精确标到划词原文（`dr-anchor` / `dr-anchor-active`），不再整块染色。
  - 已处理的批注折叠进「已解决 (n)」，点开才展开；激活一条已处理批注时自动展开。
  - 正文右侧有一条位置轨（`dr-rail`），每条批注一个点，点了直接跳过去。
  - 快捷键按平台显示：Mac 是 `⌘↩` / `⇧⌘M`，其它平台是 `Ctrl+Enter` / `Ctrl+Shift+M`（后者把焦点送回批注框）。
- **会话批注**：在**正常对话界面**里选中一段文字，选区旁边会出现一条小工具条（批注 / 复制 / 划词提示词 / ⋯），点「批注」写意见即可——不用占用对话输入框，也不用把整段贴进来。落盘在 `~/.dsh/doc-review/session-notes/<sessionId>.json`，`doc_review_list` 之外的 `session_note_list` / `session_note_resolve` 负责给 agent 读与回标。
  - **保存即写进聊天输入框（攒批发送）**：保存后批注以 `【批注 · 请逐条回应】…【批注结束】` 的块追加进当前会话的输入框草稿，并保持焦点。可以连着划好几段逐条保存，块会**整体重算**（不会攒出两个块），你写在块下方的问题原样保留，攒够了一次回车发出。依据：GitHub pending review 的官方理由就是"别让 AI 在你没写完之前就按单条开工"。
  - 输入框是斜杠命令（`/…`）时不动它，只落盘；批注被处理/删除后再同步会把块自动摘掉。
  - 输入框走 `ctx.get('conversation').input.for(sessions.scope(sessionId))`（`.state.getSnapshot().draft` / `.setDraft()`）。**用 `ctx.get` 取而不声明依赖**：服务拿不到就只落盘、不碰输入框，绝不让客户端条目挂掉（v0.5.0 那次 boot 崩溃的教训）。抽出的纯逻辑有 16 条断言（`test/composer-block.mjs`）。
  - 为什么是「先出按钮再点开」而不是像文档那样直接弹框：对话里选文字经常是为了复制，直接抢弹框会烦。文档视口内仍是直接弹。
  - 「批注」页左栏顶部有「本会话批注 (待处理数)」区，可逐条 已处理 / 退回 / 删除，或一键「交给 AI」把这一批发给当前会话。
  - 浮层挂在 `shell.overlay` 插槽（全局，独立于「批注」页签），所以选中文字时人在哪儿都行。
  - **划词提示词**：工具条上「复制」之后直接列出前 3 个提示词（默认「翻译」「解读」），其余收进「⋯ → 更多提示词」。默认点击后将「提示词 + 选中文字」插入当前会话输入框；可在管理弹窗为单条提示词开启自动发送，但仅当输入框原本为空时提交，有草稿时只插入并提示确认。模板里用 `{{text}}` 指代选中文字，不写就附在末尾。
  - 管理入口在工具条末位：提示词不超过 3 个时是一个「编辑提示词」图标，点一下直接打开弹窗；超过 3 个时才变成 ⋯ 菜单（放不下的提示词 + 底部「管理提示词…」）。弹窗里可增删改、上移下移、恢复默认；缺名称或内容的行保存时忽略。提示词存本机 localStorage（键 `dsh-doc-review.prompts`），最多 30 条。
  - 工具条、菜单、弹窗、提示条按 DSH 官方 Menu / Modal / Button / Toast 规格写，颜色只用宿主 `--dsw-*` 变量，深色主题自动跟随。

工具条三个动作：

- **交给 AI 改稿 (n)**：把待处理批注组装成指令，直接往**当前会话**排队一条消息（`remote.session.prompt`），切回对话页就能看它逐条改。
- **复制指令**：同样的内容进剪贴板（remote 面不可用时自动降级为复制）。
- **刷新正文**：重新读盘。

## 数据落在哪

跟着文档走，Obsidian 不索引点开头目录：

```
<文档目录>/.dsh-review/<文件名>.review.json   结构化真源（MRSF / Sidemark 形状）
<文档目录>/.dsh-review/<文件名>.review.md     人读 / 别的工具读的导出
```

`.review.json` 落盘格式对齐 **MRSF v1.0（Markdown Review Sidecar Format，sidemark.org）**：

| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `id` / `author` / `timestamp` | 批注身份 |
| `text` / `resolved` | 意见正文、是否已处理 |
| `line` / `end_line` | 1 基源码行号 |
| `selected_text` | 划词原文（**权威锚点，任何情况下都不改写**） |
| `selected_text_hash` | `sha256:...` |
| `anchored_text` | 重锚后实际命中的文本；空串 = 已失锚 |
| `reply_to` | 回复串：每条回复是独立条目，`reply_to` 指向父批注 id |
| `x_status` / `x_reply` / `x_resolved_at` / `x_updated_at` / `x_created_at` / `x_role` | 本插件私有状态（MRSF 的 `x_` 扩展位）；`x_role` 区分回复来自用户还是 AI，`x_reply` 只留最后一条 AI 回复做兼容 |

为什么不自创格式：MRSF 已有 `@mrsf/mcp`、`@mrsf/cli`、VS Code 扩展等消费方，字段语义也写死了重锚规则（§7.4 / §8）。

## 锚点怎么保持有效

锚点**打在 .md 源文本上**，不是渲染后的 DOM 偏移：渲染时把源码行号写进每个块的 `data-ls` / `data-le`，划词时反查行区间。

文档被改过之后，打开文档那一刻按 MRSF §7.4 的重锚四步重新定位：**精确匹配 → 多命中按旧行号就近消歧 → 空白归一化再匹配 → 都失败标「已失锚」但保留**。孤儿批注绝不静默删除，也不做假锚定（行号保持原值，卡片上挂红色「已失锚」）。

## Agent 侧工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `doc_review_list` | 读批注。给 `doc` 读单篇；不给则巡检配置根目录下所有带批注的文档。返回行号区间 + 原文 + 意见 |
| `doc_review_resolve` | 改完标记已处理，可回填一句「改了什么」（追加进该批注的回复串，用户和同事都能看到） |
| `doc_review_reopen` | 改得不满意，退回待处理 |
| `doc_review_reply` | 在某条批注的回复串里追加一条 AI 回复（解释做法、追问），不改状态 |
| `doc_change_propose` | 建议模式：登记改动提案（`quote` → `after` + `note`），不动文件 |
| `doc_change_list` | 查看待审提案；不给 `doc` 则巡检所有带提案的文档 |
| `doc_change_decide` | 接受（此时才落盘，按原文重新定位）/ 拒绝（带原因）/ 退回待审 |
| `session_note_list` | 读会话批注（对话消息上的划词意见） |
| `session_note_resolve` | 会话批注 已处理 / 退回 / 删除 |

### `/doc-review` 技能相关工具（规则沉淀 + 预审）

装插件时自动在 `~/.dsh/skills/doc-review/SKILL.md` 落一份技能文件，skill-filesystem 自动发现，用户可用 `/doc-review` 调用。初始规则库 `~/.dsh/doc-review/rules.json` 为空；所有规则都来自用户历次批注的提炼，插件不自带任何通用规则。

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `doc_review_history` | 跨项目聚合所有历史批注，给技能做共性提炼 |
| `doc_review_mine_candidates` | 从历史里挖反复出现 ≥3 次 / ≥2 篇文档的意见模式作为**候选规则**（manual 粒度，用户入库前可换成启发式）|
| `doc_review_rules_list` | 列规则库（含 candidate/active/deprecated）+ 自动健康检查（拒绝率、修改占比、90 天未命中）|
| `doc_review_rules_add` | 加规则。detect.kind：regex / line_length / para_lines / heading_level / manual |
| `doc_review_rules_update` | 改规则（status 变更 / 字段修改）|
| `doc_review_rules_remove` | 删规则（想保留历史痕迹改用 update 置 deprecated）|
| `doc_review_preview_apply` | 读 active 启发式规则，扫一篇文档，把命中结果挂进 `doc_change_propose` 待审改动（用户在批注页逐条 ✓/✗，这些 ✓/✗ 决定规则的 accept/reject 统计）|

**自我进化闭环**：批注（手打反馈） → `mine_candidates`（提炼候选） → `rules_add`（固化成规则） → 打开新文档时 `preview_apply` 做预审 → 用户 ✓/✗（强化/弱化规则） → `rules_list` 健康检查自动降级坏规则 / 建议细化。

**"交给 AI 改稿"的 prompt 现在额外带一句**：处理完批注后请调 `doc_review_mine_candidates`，发现 ≥3 条同质就提醒用户固化为规则。没发现就不打扰。

plugins.readme_text:
# Opfield plugins for DeepSeek Harness

[![M8ven Score](https://m8ven.ai/badge/mcp/opfield/dsh-plugins)](https://m8ven.ai/mcp/opfield/dsh-plugins?s=readme)

Plugins for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

| Package | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`@opfield/dsh-mcp-hub`](packages/mcp-hub) | Every MCP server in one place: eager / lazy / auto tool exposure per server, OAuth for HTTP servers, direct launch of `npx` packages, and an API for plugins that bring their own servers. Works with any MCP server, not only Opfield. |
| [`@opfield/dsh-opfield`](packages/opfield) | Opfield instances as MCP servers, models from one instance with an automatic inference token and model sync, plus budget, prompt-cache timer and `/compact` offer components. Requires MCP Hub. |
| [`@opfield/dsh-multi-repo`](packages/multi-repo) | Multi-root workspaces: attach other repositories to a workspace. Attached roots are writable under `workspace-write`, listed in the model context with their `AGENTS.md`, and edited from the composer or `/roots`. Works on its own. |

## Install

In DSH open **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter a spec from the table, then **Enable now**. Install MCP Hub first: the Opfield plugin needs it. Restart DSH after adding Opfield.

| Plugin | From npm | From this repository |
|---|---|---|
| MCP Hub | `@opfield/dsh-mcp-hub` | `github:opfield/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/mcp-hub` |
| Opfield | `@opfield/dsh-opfield` | `github:opfield/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/opfield` |
| Multi-root workspaces | `@opfield/dsh-multi-repo` | `github:opfield/dsh-plugins#path:/packages/multi-repo` |

To pin a version from the repository, add its tag before `path`: `github:opfield/dsh-plugins#mcp-hub-v0.4.1&path:/packages/mcp-hub`, `github:opfield/dsh-plugins#opfield-v0.5.2&path:/packages/opfield`.

Then open **Plugins → Opfield → Add instance**, enter the instance address and press **Sign in**. Each package's README covers the details: [MCP Hub](packages/mcp-hub#install), [Opfield](packages/opfield#install), [Multi-root workspaces](packages/multi-repo#install).

DSH does not update plugins yet: to upgrade, remove the plugin and add the new version.

## Development

```sh
npm install   # Harness packages the tests run against
npm test
```

The plugins have no build step. To try a working copy, add it in DSH by absolute path (`/path/to/dsh-plugins/packages/mcp-hub`).

## Release

Bump `version` in `packages/<dir>/package.json`, commit, and push a tag `<dir>-v<version>`, for example `mcp-hub-v0.4.1`. The Release workflow tests, publishes the package to npm with provenance, and creates a GitHub release.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Model Navigator

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.3.2-blue.svg)](https://github.com/EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator/releases)
[![Host](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.2-0f172a.svg)](https://github.com/EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](./LICENSE)

简体中文 · [English](./README.en.md) · [下载安装包 (v0.3.2)](https://github.com/EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator/releases/download/v0.3.2/dsh-model-navigator-0.3.2.tgz) · [Releases](https://github.com/EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator/releases) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator/issues)

**DSH Model Navigator** 是为 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** 设计的模型选择器插件。它替换聊天输入框中的默认模型选择入口，直接沿用你已有的供应商、账户和模型列表，提供全局搜索、收藏夹、模型家族分组和思维强度切换，并支持随时一键切回原选择器。

---

## 核心功能

- **跨供应商全局搜索**：在所有已配置的供应商中即时搜索模型，支持显示真实模型 ID，方便区分同名或不同版本的模型。
- **收藏夹与最近使用**：置顶常用模型并自动记录最近使用的模型。两类列表均支持鼠标悬停、点击或键盘展开子菜单；当窗口空间不足时，子菜单会自动调整展开方向。
- **模型家族导航**：按模型家族归类展示，替代冗长的平铺列表，浏览和定位更直观。
- **思维强度选择**：直接读取并切换宿主提供的思维强度档位，在选定模型的同时完成档位切换。
- **配置零迁移**：复用宿主的模型目录与当前会话的选择状态，无需重新配置供应商或账户。
- **一键恢复原选择器**：可在设置中随时关闭替换；关闭替换、停用或卸载插件后，会自动恢复之前生效的选择器。

---

## 安装与升级

### 环境与前置条件

| 项目 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **插件版本** | `0.3.2` |
| **已验证宿主版本** | DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| **前置要求** | **必须保持官方模型选择插件启用**（它负责提供共享目录服务和 `/model` 命令） |

### 方式一：通过安装包安装（推荐）

1. 前往 [Releases](https://github.com/EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator/releases) 下载安装包 [`dsh-model-navigator-0.3.2.tgz`](https://github.com/EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator/releases/download/v0.3.2/dsh-model-navigator-0.3.2.tgz) 到本地。
2. 打开 DeepSeek Harness Desktop，进入 **插件 → 添加插件**。
3. 在 **包名或地址** 栏中填写下载文件的**本地绝对路径**（例如 `/Users/yourname/Downloads/dsh-model-navigator-0.3.2.tgz`），确认添加并启用。

### 方式二：通过本地源码安装

1. 克隆本仓库并在本地完成构建（详见[开发与构建](#开发与构建)）。
2. 打开 **插件 → 添加插件**，在 **包名或地址** 栏填写本地仓库目录的绝对路径，确认添加并启用。

### 升级方式

- **安装包升级**：先在插件列表中卸载旧版本，再按上述步骤添加新版 `.tgz` 安装包。
- **源码链接升级**：拉取最新代码并重新构建后，在宿主插件管理页**先关闭再重新启用**插件以加载新产物。

---

## 恢复默认选择器

如果你想切回宿主原有的模型选择器，可通过以下任一方式操作：

1. **在设置中关闭替换**：关闭本插件的替换开关后，立即恢复之前生效的选择器，无需卸载插件。
2. **停用或卸载插件**：在插件管理页停用或卸载本插件，输入框会自动切回之前生效的选择器。

---

## 兼容性与技术说明

### 实现机制

- **槽位与优先级**：插件通过更高优先级接管输入框的模型选择槽位；当关闭替换、停用或卸载时，自动将槽位交还给此前生效的选择器。
- **状态复用与原子提交**：直接复用宿主共享的模型目录与会话 `current` 状态；在切换模型及思维强度档位时执行原子提交，确保模型与思维强度状态同步更新。
- **官方插件依赖**：宿主的官方模型选择插件提供底层共享目录服务与 `/model` 命令，使用本插件期间请保持官方插件处于启用状态。

### 已知限制

- 暂未实现 Codex 专属的速度（Speed）与输出详略（Verbosity）控件。

---

## 开发与构建

本项目构建与测试均无需安装外部 npm 依赖（无需执行 `npm install`）。

- **Node.js 要求**：`^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- **打包环境**：发布包使用 BSD `tar` 打包，已在 macOS 环境验证。

```bash
# 构建插件
npm run build

# 运行完整验证（包含 140 项测试）
npm run check
```

更多技术细节与文档请参阅 [`docs/`](./docs/) 目录。

---

## 许可证与声明

- **开源协议**：[MIT License](./LICENSE)
- **第三方声明**：[THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](./THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
- **反馈与建议**：欢迎提交至 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/EventHorizonXT/dsh-model-navigator/issues)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-asmrone

**开源**（MIT）的 **DeepSeek Harness 专用**插件：把 [asmr.one](https://asmr.one)
（DLsite 同人音声整库镜像，六万余部）、B 站、DLsite 官方免费试听、以及**手机本地已经下好的音声**
四个来源接进对话 —— 搜作品、看音轨、在线播放（后台播放 + 拖进度）、按自己的权重重排结果、
批量下载与删除，全程不必离开 DSH。带 Web 面板，也带一条让 agent 直接推歌出声的通道。

**四个来源对网络的要求不一样**：asmr.one 与 DLsite 要代理；B 站和本机曲库不用 ——
没挂梯子的时候也有得听。

## 装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/root/dsh-asmrone
```

装完要**重启 dsh** 才生效（`dsh plugin` 只是 pnpm 转发，没有 reload 子命令）。

## Web 面板

侧边栏底部一枚 **音声库** 按钮（跟会话管理插件同款双行样式），点开是居中面板：

- 顶部：搜索框（回车即搜）、排序下拉（销量 / 评分 / 发售日 / 最新上架）
- 筛选 chips：「只要中文」「排除女性向」，以及一枚 **权重排序** 开关
- 权重面板：销量 / 评分 / 评价数 / 新鲜度 四条滑块（0~2），松手即重排；
  另有候选池深度（1~5 页）与「推荐配置 / 归零」两个预设。权重全 0 时走官方排序
- 作品卡片：封面、标题、社团、评分、销量、时长、声优、标签；开权重时右下角显示归一化得分
- 点卡片 → 音轨清单**内联展开在该卡片正下方**（不跳页、不开新窗口）
- 底栏常驻播放条：播放/暂停、可拖动的进度条、当前 / 总时长、音量

界面用 dsh 自己的设计令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`）与 `#4f7cff` 主色，纯 SVG 图标，
跟随系统深浅色 —— 跟余额、会话管理两个插件是同一套观感。

### 后台播放

`<audio>` **不在 React 树里**，它是挂在 `document.body` 上的页面级元素。所以容器怎么重建
都不影响它，具体表现：

- 关掉面板 → 继续放，屏幕底部留一条**悬浮迷你条**（播放/暂停、进度、停、展开）
- 切回对话页 → 继续放，迷你条跟着在
- 锁屏 / 通知栏 → 有系统媒体控制（MediaSession，含 ±15s / ±30s 跳转）

藏 audio 用 `1px + opacity:0`，没用 `display:none` —— 后者在部分 WebView 上会直接停播。

音频走 host 代理 `/asmrone/stream` 而不是前端直连 —— asmr.one 的 CDN 不回 CORS 头，
前端 `fetch` 会被浏览器挡死；走代理还能把 302 与 Range 一并透传。

## 七个工具

| 工具 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| `asmr_search` | 搜作品。关键词 / 排序 / 分页 / 中文版筛选 / 性别过滤，返回评分、销量、时长、声优、标签和作品页地址 |
| `asmr_work` | 列某部作品的完整音轨树，可顺带并发探测每轨体积 |
| `asmr_local` | **本地音声库**：列已经下到手机上的作品与音轨、按名字/RJ 号找、直接推给面板播放。不需要网络 |
| `asmr_play` | 取音轨播放直链，**并默认推给面板播放器立即出声**（`push:false` 只取地址不打扰） |
| `asmr_download` | 批量下载音频到本机。默认只下 MP3、跳过已存在的文件、按作品名建子目录 |
| `asmr_trial` | 抓 DLsite 官方试听包（免费公开，免登录），自带 zip 解压与 Shift-JIS 文件名修复 |
| `asmr_config` | 查看 / 修改偏好；`action=tags` 直接列 asmr.one 的 422 个中文标签 |

典型用法：

```
asmr_search  query=简体中文版 order=dl_count chineseOnly=true
asmr_work    id=1006912 resolveSizes=true
asmr_play    id=1006912 index=2      # 推第 2 轨到面板开始放
asmr_download id=1006912 title=舔耳按摩店 keyword=通常
asmr_trial   workno=RJ01726233 download=true
```

## agent 推歌

模型侧没有播放能力 —— `asmr_play` 顶多算出一串 URL，用户在对话里点了也听不到任何东西。
所以工具在返回直链的同时，往一个**单槽待播队列**里压一条；前端每 3 秒轮询
`/asmrone/pending` 取走并播放。配上 `asmr-ambience` 技能，用户说一句「失眠了」
或「写东西想听点东西」就能直接出声，不用自己开面板。

队列刻意做得很小：只留最后一条 + 自增 `seq` + 2 分钟 TTL。

- 带 `seq` 轮询 → 同一首不会被反复重播
- TTL → 迟到的推送不会在半小时后突然响起来
- 单槽 → 连推三首只放最后一首，避免攒出一屋子「早就忘了的曲子」

技能在 `/root/.dsh/skills/asmr-ambience/`，里面还写了按音轨名判断**开头直入还是慢热铺垫**
的挑片规则（`導入` / `ご挨拶` 这类第 1 轨是铺垫，`本番` / `いきなり` 这类是直接开始）——
助眠要挑前者，直奔主题要挑后者。

## 没开代理时：本地曲库

asmr.one 是境外站。**没有代理时在线那条链路（搜索 / 音轨 / 封面 / 在线播放）整条不通** ——
`fetch failed`、超时、连接重置都算。这时候面板不该变成一块砖，所以有一条完全离线的路：

- **面板**：顶部「本地曲库」标签页。列出已经下到本机的音声（`asmr_download` 落的，
  加上 `localDirs` 指向的目录），点开是音轨，点了就放。
- **模型**：`asmr_local` 工具。`action=list` 看有什么，`action=play key=<作品> index=2` 直接推给播放器。
- **播放**：音频走 `/asmrone/local-stream`，从磁盘直读，支持 Range 拖进度，**一个字节都不出网**。
  跟在线播放共用同一个播放器 —— 一样能后台播、一样有悬浮条。

扫盘带 60 秒缓存（5 G / 154 个文件要遍历目录树 + 逐个 `stat`），面板上的「重扫磁盘」强制刷新。
配置的目录不存在时面板会明确标出来，不会静默算成 0 部。

文件绝对路径只留在 host 侧：前端用 `key`+`index` 取流，不回传路径。
`/asmrone/local-stream?path=` 那条入口只对**配置过的根目录内、且是音频扩展名**的文件放行 ——
前缀比较带分隔符（挡住 `/x/asmr-evil` 蹭 `/x/asmr`），并走 `realpath` 解析，符号链接也绕不出去。

## HTTP 数据面

面板用的接口，挂在 `webServer` 的 `/asmrone` 前缀下。

| 方法与路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `GET /asmrone/config` | 读配置 + 可用排序字段 |
| `POST /asmrone/config` | 改配置（白名单键） |
| `GET /asmrone/search` | `q` / `order` / `page` / `pageSize` / `chinese` / `female` |
| `GET /asmrone/work` | `id=` 取音轨树 |
| `GET /asmrone/sizes` | `POST {hashes}` 批量探测体积 |
| `GET /asmrone/stream` | `hash=` 音频代理，透传 302 与 Range |
| `GET /asmrone/pending` | `since=` 取待播条目（agent 推歌的拉取端） |
| `GET /asmrone/local` | 本地曲库列表；`q=` 过滤、`force=1` 绕过 60 秒缓存重扫 |
| `GET /asmrone/local-stream` | 本地文件流；`key=`+`index=` 或 `path=`，支持 Range |
| `POST /asmrone/play` | `{id, hash?, index?}` 解析音轨并入队，供 agent / 脚本推歌；带 `localKey` 时推本地文件 |
| `POST /asmrone/download` | `{id, title?, hashes?, keyword?, includeWav?}` |
| `GET /asmrone/trial` | `rj=` 探 DLsite 试听包 |
| `GET /asmrone/tags` | 标签表 |


## 配置

容器里的 JSON：`<DSH_HOME>/asmrone/config.json`，用 `asmr_config` 改，改完立即生效。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `outputDir` | `/sdcard/Download/ASMR`（无外置存储时退回数据目录） | 下载落盘目录，同时是本地曲库的第 0 个根 |
| `localDirs` | `[]` | 额外的本地音声根目录（试听包解出来的、手动拷进去的都算） |
| `languageFilter` | `male` | `male` 剔除女性向/乙女向/BL；`all` 不过滤 |
| `defaultOrder` | `dl_count` | 默认排序字段 |
| `downloadConcurrency` | `4` | 下载并发，1~8 |
| `maxWorkMb` | `800` | 单个试听包体积上限 |
| `pageSize` | `20` | 搜索默认每页条数 |

基础设施项（接口地址、超时）在同名 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖，别改随包的
`cordis.patch.yml` —— 升级时会被覆盖。

## 接口依据

全部端点都实测过（2026-10）：

| 端点 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/search/{q}` | 关键词搜索，支持 `page` / `pageSize` / `order` |
| `GET /api/works` | 全库列表 |
| `GET /api/tags/` | 标签表，422 条，带 `zh-cn` 译名 |
| `GET /api/tracks/{id}` | 音轨树（folder / audio 嵌套） |
| `GET /api/media/stream/{hash}` | 音频流，302 跳 CDN，支持 Range |

`GET /api/works/{id}` 返回 401，作品详情从列表/搜索结果里取 —— 那些对象本身带全部字段。

## DLsite 试听的坑

试听**不是 mp3**，是 zip 包。早期按 `.mp3` 拼 URL 全部 404，就因为后缀猜错了。
真实地址在 touch 页的 Nuxt payload 里：`"trials":<索引>` 指向无服务器序列化数组，
展开后拿到 `//trial.dlsite.com/doujin/RJ01727000/RJ01726233_trial.zip`。

`play.dlsite.com/api/viewer/work/<RJ>` 只有元数据（`sample_type: "image"` 那类），拿不到音频。
不少音声作品确实只有图片试听，这时工具会明确报「无音频试听」。

zip 解压自己实现了（只用 `zlib.inflateRawSync` + 中央目录解析），因为宿主机器不一定有
`unzip`。老 DLsite 包的 Shift-JIS 文件名靠 `TextDecoder('shift_jis')` 还原。

## 开发

```bash
npm run check       # 语法检查（src/ + src/tools/ + client/）
npm test            # 45 个用例；在线用例网络不通时自动跳过
npm run verify:http # 起假 webServer 打真实端点（需要能访问 asmr.one）
```

`test/rank.test.mjs` 用了一个取巧但不偷工的做法：它**从 `client/client.js` 里把
`#region rank-core` 那段纯函数截出来**再求值。被测的就是线上那一份代码，不存在
「测试跑的是另一份复制品」的漂移；谁把那段改成不纯（引用 `window` / `react`）会当场报错。
`test/http-pending.test.mjs` 则用假 api 顶掉 asmr.one，所以推歌链路**离线也能验**。

## 硬约束

**运行期零依赖。** 只 import Node 内置模块，`dependencies` 是空的。装了插件的人不需要
往插件目录里塞 `node_modules` 软链 —— 也就不会出现「在插件目录跑一次 npm install 却写进
宿主 node_modules」这类事故。`src/define-tool.js` 顶部有完整说明。

**不内置内容偏好。** 插件不预设任何题材倾向，性别过滤、排序、落盘目录全部来自可改的配置。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件列表里的插件自定义中文备注名，支持分组、折叠与自定义标签
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh插件名称修改

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

给 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件列表里的插件自定义中文备注名，直接显示在原生插件设置页；支持按备注/标签分组、分组折叠、官方插件保护与自定义标签。

## 功能

- 自动把插件列表里的英文包名替换成自定义中文备注，悬停显示原来的英文包名
- 可视化编辑面板：左下角「📝 备注」按钮，或按 `Ctrl+Shift+N` 打开
- 自动扫描当前已安装的所有插件，直接编辑备注；备注保存在浏览器 localStorage 里，永久生效
- 🛡 官方插件默认不可改名：`@deepseek-ai/*` 与 dsh 内置 bundle 标「官方」且输入框禁用；面板「高级」可开「改官方」开关放开限制
- 🗂 分组显示：可按「是否有备注」或「按标签」分组，分组标题可点击折叠/展开，状态记忆
- 🏷 自定义标签：条目内「+ 标签」新建并打标，可切换/删除；固定分类「官方 / 已修改 / 未修改」自动打标
- 🔍 搜索框、按原名/备注名排序、导出/导入备份、按钮拖动、总开关、一键重置

## 安装

### 方式一：GitHub 仓库直接安装（推荐）

桌面端（DSH 0.2.0-rc.2）：在侧栏打开「插件 → 添加插件」，粘贴下面的地址，安装后选择「立即启用」。若应用提示需要重启，按提示操作。

```
github:sanlisanxun/dsh-plugin-nickname
```

### 方式二：本地目录安装

1. 下载本项目，解压到本地文件夹
2. 打开 dsh → 插件 → 添加插件
3. 输入本地文件夹的完整路径，点安装
4. 刷新页面生效

## 使用

安装后：
- 点左下角的「📝 备注」按钮，或按 `Ctrl+Shift+N` 打开编辑面板
- 在输入框里直接改中文名字，按 Tab 键保存
- 留空则恢复原来的英文包名

## 目录结构

```
dsh-plugin-nickname/
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js      # Host 端插件入口
│   └── client.js     # 客户端脚本（注入到浏览器页面）
├── cordis.patch.yml  # Cordis 挂载补丁
├── package.json      # 包配置
├── README.md         # 项目说明
└── LICENSE           # 开源协议
```

## 更新日志

完整更新日志见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

### v0.3.2
- 🏷 新增分组标签：面板「按…分组」新增「按标签分组」（与「按是否有备注分组」并存）；固定分类「官方 / 已修改 / 未修改」自动打标；用户可自建自定义标签并在条目内点选打标，「高级」区可管理/删除

### v0.3.1
- 🗂 分组可折叠：分组显示时点击分组标题可展开/收起，折叠状态持久化，标题左侧指示符 `▾` 展开 / `▸` 收起

### v0.3.0
- 🛡 官方插件默认不可改名：`@deepseek-ai/*` 与 dsh 内置 bundle 不再被替换，面板里标「官方」且输入框禁用
- ✨ 新增「改官方」开关：需要时勾上即可解除屏蔽
- ✨ 保存备注前增加官方插件拦截，绕过界面也写不进去

### v0.2.9
- 🐛 修复真实浏览器下备注不生效：替换守卫用 `childNodes.length <= 2` 计数，换行空白文本节点会让它变成 3 而被挡掉；改为只按元素子节点计数，与渲染方式无关
- 🐛 修复插件改写自己界面：编辑面板里的包名标签会被自己的替换逻辑覆盖，导致标签显示成备注名；现在跳过所有 `[data-nickname-ui]` 内部节点
- ✅ 新增真实浏览器验证 `npm run test:browser`（Chromium 加载 `tests/harness/index.html`，7 条断言）

### v0.2.8
- 🐛 修复备注完全不生效：dsh 的插件名在 `<button class="cardTitle">` 里，外层还有两层 `div`；「只改写文本节点」后容器里没有直接文本节点，替换被整体跳过。现改为向下定位真正承载文本的叶子节点再写入
- 🐛 修复标题按钮被抹掉：旧版用 `textContent` 覆盖容器会连 `<button>`、图标、描述一起清空，列表项点不开
- ✨ 支持 dsh「显示名 (包名)」标题形式，如 `dsh-context` 的 `上下文 (dsh-context)`
- ✨ 默认扫描选择器补上 `button`
- ⚡ 面板列表改以 dsh 卡片上的 `data-plugin-package` 为准收集已安装插件，不再只靠文本猜测

### v0.2.7
- ✨ 支持无 `__ModuleLoader__` 的宿主环境（dsh web 版）：检测不到模块加载器时自行启动
- ✨ 存储读写增加内存兜底：localStorage 不可用（隐私模式 / web 版）时不再中断
- ⚡ 取消固定等待 1 秒：改为立即初始化 + 最多约 2 秒重试，按钮与备注即时生效
- ✨ 面板「高级」新增扫描选择器与包名正则配置，dsh 改版导致 DOM 结构变化时无需改代码
- 🐛 dispose 改为按会话标记多轮清扫（0 / 200 / 600ms），清掉宿主在 dispose 之后补渲染的残留
- ✨ 检测不到插件列表时给出「点此刷新页面」提示，面板新增「刷新页面使改动生效」按钮

### v0.2.6
- 🐛 修复替换插件名时误伤子元素：改为只改写直接文本节点，不再用 `textContent` 覆盖整个卡片
- 🐛 修复包名前缀冲突：`dsh.plugin` 与 `dsh.plugin-manager` 这类存在包含关系时，改为长包名优先
- 🐛 修复备注名含引号/尖括号时破坏面板结构：包名与备注在渲染前做 HTML 转义
- 🐛 修复重置或导入备注后面板被关闭：修正 `openEditPanel` 的开关语义
- 🐛 修复反复开关面板在 `<head>` 累积 `<style>` 标签，关闭时同步移除样式与外部点击监听
- 🐛 完善 dispose：补充清理 MutationObserver 防抖定时器与 `window.__setPluginNickname` 等全局挂载
- 🐛 修复导出 JSON 时 URL 回收过快可能中断下载
- ⚡ 优化 MutationObserver：防抖定时器收进闭包，扫描后丢弃自身写入触发的变更记录

### v0.2.5
- 🐛 修复编辑面板样式注入变量未声明（`style` → `styleEl`）：严格模式下不再抛 `ReferenceError`，面板可正常打开
- 🐛 修复 dispose 时样式标签无法移除导致的残留

### v0.2.4
- ✨ 新增卸载插件按钮：一键清除所有本地数据，并提示在 dsh 插件列表完成卸载

### v0.2.3
- 🐛 修复关闭插件后 UI 残留，完善 dispose 清理逻辑

### v0.2.2
- ✨ 新增排序功能：支持按原名/备注名排序
- ✨ 新增分组功能：按是否有备注分组显示
- ✨ 优化 UI 样式：更美观的深色主题设计

### v0.2.1
- 🎨 优化 UI 样式，和 dsh 深色主题更匹配
- 按钮加了悬停效果和动画

### v0.2.0
- ✨ 新增总开关：一键启用/禁用所有备注替换
- ✨ 新增重置按钮：一键清除所有自定义备注
- ✨ 新增按钮拖动：左下角的备注按钮可以拖到任意位置
- ✨ 按钮位置自动保存，刷新后位置不变

### v0.1.2
- 🐛 修复 bug：关闭插件后遗留按钮的问题
- 卸载插件时自动清理所有 DOM 元素和事件监听

### v0.1.1
- ✨ 新增搜索框：插件多的时候快速查找
- ✨ 新增导出/导入功能：备份你的备注设置
- ✨ 优化交互：点击面板外面自动关闭

### v0.1.0
- 🎉 首次发布
- 支持自定义插件中文备注名
- 支持可视化编辑面板
- 支持快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+N 打开面板

## 技术文档

详见 [docs/技术文档.md](docs/技术文档.md)

## 免责声明

1. 本软件仅供个人学习、研究和技术交流使用，不得用于任何非法或商业用途。
