plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-manager

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager)](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DeepSeek%20Harness-4f6ef7)](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager)

Archive manager plugin: manage **archived sessions** and **active sessions** of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) in one place.

> **Quick install** (restart DSH afterwards and you are done)
>
> ```bash
> dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager
> ```
>
> Other install methods: see [Installation](#installation) | Version downloads: see [Releases](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases)

## Why this plugin exists

DSH has built-in session archiving: archiving a session keeps its data **fully on disk** and merely hides it from the active list. But the built-in archive handling offers only a single filter ("Hide archived / All conversations / Archived only") and **no dedicated place** to review, archive, or clean up sessions in one spot — archived sessions simply pile up on disk.

This plugin fills that gap: it **reuses DSH's native archiving mechanism** and adds a dedicated management UI where "archive" and "delete" sit side by side.

## Features

### Sidebar entry

A new "Archive Manager" icon at the bottom of the sidebar (next to Settings); click it to open the management panel.

### Two-tab panel

The panel has two tabs, and **every session row offers archive-type actions and delete side by side**:

| Tab | Contents | Actions per row |
|---|---|---|
| **Archived** | All archived sessions | [Unarchive] [Delete] |
| **Active sessions** | Currently active sessions | [Archive] [Delete] |

Each entry shows:
- Session title ("Untitled session" when there is no title)
- Session ID (monospace)
- Bound workspace directory (**clickable** — opens directly in the file manager)
- Status badges: `session log` / `cache` / `data missing` / `running`

### Three operations

- **Archive**: calls DSH's native `archiveSession`; the session is hidden from the active list and its **data is kept exactly as is**
- **Unarchive**: calls DSH's native `unarchiveSession`; the session returns to the active list and its **data was never moved**
- **Permanent delete**: removes the session's **session log directory + projection cache** (irreversible)
  - The **bound workspace directory is never deleted** (by design, so your project files cannot be removed by accident)
  - A confirmation dialog guards the operation
  - The archive record is queued and cleaned up automatically by the plugin on the **next DSH start** — no manual step required,
    and after a delete no "empty-data session" will reappear in the active list

### Ghost entry detection

Entries in the archived list whose data was deleted long ago and only an archive record remains are marked "data missing"; deleting such an entry clears that leftover record.

### Agent tools

`archive_list` / `archive_add` / `archive_remove` / `archive_delete`, drivable with natural language.

## Screenshots

The **Archived** tab — every entry offers [Unarchive] and [Delete], and shows the bound workspace directory and on-disk data status:

![Archived sessions](assets/screenshot-2-archived-sessions.en.png)

The **Active sessions** tab — [Archive] and [Delete] side by side:

![Active sessions](assets/screenshot-1-active-sessions.en.png)

## Installation

> Replace `<profile>` in the commands below with your profile name; the DSH desktop app uses `desktop` by default.
> After installing, **restart DSH** and the "Archive Manager" icon appears at the bottom of the sidebar.

### Option 1: Install directly from GitHub (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager
```

DSH pulls the plugin from this repository and installs it into the profile as a bundle. To pin a specific version, add a ref:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager#v0.1.0
```

### Option 2: Download a release and install locally

1. Open the [Releases](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases) page,
   download **Source code (zip)** of the latest version and extract it
2. Install using the path of the extracted directory:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:<absolute path of the extracted directory>
```

### Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-archive-manager
```

Uninstalling removes only the plugin itself; it does **not** delete any session data or archive records.

## Usage

1. Click "Archive Manager" at the bottom of the sidebar to open the panel
2. In the "Active sessions" tab, click [Archive] on sessions you no longer need — they are hidden from the active list while their data is kept as is
3. In the "Archived" tab, review all archived sessions
4. Click [Unarchive] when needed to put a session back into the active list
5. For sessions you no longer need, click [Delete] → confirm → permanent delete (irreversible)

## Safety notes

- **Deletion is irreversible**: the session log and projection cache are removed outright, and a confirmation dialog is shown first.
- **The bound workspace directory is never touched**: even if a session is bound to `D:\projects\xxx`, deleting an archived session removes **only session data**;
  your project directory and the files in it are completely unaffected.
- **Archiving itself carries zero risk**: it only writes a marker; no data is moved or copied, and you can unarchive at any time.
- Session data is located by **scanning `$DSH_HOME/sessions/*/` for an exact sessionId match** rather than re-deriving
  the path encoding, which avoids deleting the wrong directory.
- Deletion is idempotent: if the target directory or cache is already gone, it counts as "already deleted" instead of raising an error.

## Implementation notes

- **Source of the archived list**: the runtime projection is preferred (`workspaceController.follow()`'s first-frame baseline carries
  `archivedSessionIds`; the stream is aborted as soon as it is read), with a fallback to the persistent snapshot in
  `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json`. The panel therefore reflects the in-memory truth rather than a possibly stale disk copy.
- **Active sessions**: `sessionQuery.listSessions()` (which already excludes archived sessions), plus a defensive de-duplication pass.
- **Session title / cwd**: read from the projection cache at `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
  (the cache embeds these values in a `{ <key>: { val } }` structure).
- **Session log directory**: `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace encoding>/<sessionId>/`, located by exact-match scanning;
  after deleting a session, if its workspace encoding directory becomes empty, that empty directory is cleaned up as well.
- **Archive / unarchive**: calls DSH's native `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id, { stopActivity: true })`
  and `unarchiveSession(id)` — the plugin does not implement archiving semantics itself.
- **Removal from the archive set goes through the "pending-cleanup queue" (key design)**: permanent delete has three steps — delete the log, delete the cache, and
  **enqueue** the id, but **does not unarchive at that moment**.
  The reason: `unarchiveSession` means "send this session back to the active list", not "forget this id".
  If you previously opened a session in the archive panel, it stays in the harness's memory; deleting the on-disk data
  and then unarchiving makes the harness put this session — no data, but still in memory — back into the active list,
  where opening it necessarily fails with `session/not-found` — and **only a restart clears it**.
  Once queued, the session stays archived (so it can never appear in the active list) and the plugin runs
  `unarchiveSession` on the **next start** to finish the job — at that moment memory is clean, so unarchiving cannot trigger a ghost.
  Queue file: `$DSH_HOME/storages/archive-manager-pending.json`;
  queued entries are hidden from the panel immedi

plugins.description: Hide unused models, rename them, keep the billing rate visible — a model list manager for DeepSeek Harness. 隐藏用不到的模型、给模型改备注名、保留厂商计费倍率。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-tidy

**中文** · [English](README.en.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md)

一个让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器保持整洁的插件——决定哪些模型出现、给它们起你认得的名字，并保住厂商标注的计费倍率。

![模型整理设置页](docs/screenshots/main.png)

## 它解决的问题

装两三个 provider 插件，模型菜单就变成一堵墙。一条免费车道、一个工作台 App、两个自己配的网关，转眼三十来项——大多数你根本不会选，还有几个是同一模型走了不同渠道的近似重复项。

模型选择器是**做决定的地方，不是仓库**。它应该只摆你真正在用的那几个，用你认得的名字。

## 它做什么

安装后，DSH 设置里会出现「**模型整理**」分区。模型按来源渠道分组，每一项各带一个开关：

```
┌─ WorkBuddy ───────────── 8/12 ─ [恢复默认排序] [隐藏全部] [显示全部] ─┐
│ ▲▼  Auto                                            ●───              │
│ ▲▼  GLM-5.3 · x0.79                                 ●───              │
│ ▲▼  GLM-5.2 · x0.79 · 夜间折扣          [改备注]    ───●              │
│ ▲▼  Grok-4.7 · x1.90                                ───●              │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
┌─ our-free-model ───────── 6/6 ── [恢复默认排序] [隐藏全部] [显示全部] ─┐
│ ▲▼  Kilo Auto Free                                  ●───              │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **每个模型一个开关**：关掉即从模型选择器消失，打开即回来。
- **上下箭头排序**：调整模型在列表里的先后，渠道头可一键恢复默认顺序。
- **备注名**：给模型起个你认得的名字，选择器就以它显示；厂商的计费后缀会原样留在末尾。
- **搜索**：按模型名、渠道或备注名过滤。
- **渠道级批量**：一键隐藏或显示某个渠道的全部模型。
- **全局显示 / 隐藏**：两个按钮作用于整个目录。
- **恢复**：一个按钮清空全部备注，另一个让全部模型回来。

## 自定义排序

每个模型左侧有一对箭头，用来调整它在所属渠道内的先后顺序。排序是**显式保存**的：调完重启 DSH、换一台机器同步配置，顺序都还在。

- **只影响排列，不影响可见性**：排过序的模型被隐藏后，它的位置记在保存的顺序里；重新显示时回到原来的位置。
- **新模型排在你排过的那些之后**：渠道以后上架新模型，不会插进你精心安排的那一段中间。
- **搜索时可以继续排序**：筛选状态下点箭头，交换的是**当前可见的相邻两项**，所以点一下就能看到变化；被筛掉的模型保持它自己的相对位置。
- **一键回退**：渠道头的「恢复默认排序」清掉该渠道的自定义顺序，回到目录原本的排列。

排序记录在插件自己的设置命名空间里（`order` 字段，按渠道存一组模型 id），不改动任何渠道配置。


## 改备注不会弄丢倍率

厂商把计费倍率拼在模型的**显示名**里——`GLM-5.3 · x0.79`——因为 harness 的模型目录没有倍率字段。直接替换这个名字（大多数改名的做法）会把倍率一并丢掉。

本插件按厂商自己的分隔符切开名字，并保留后半段：

| | 选择器里显示的名字 |
|---|---|
| 厂商原名 | `GLM-5.3 · x0.79` |
| 改备注为「GLM 便宜」 | **`GLM 便宜 · x0.79`** |
| 带促销标签时改备注 | **`GLM 便宜 · x0.79 · 夜间折扣`** |
| 本身没有倍率的模型 | `自动` ← 不会多出分隔符 |

## 隐藏一个模型不会让它跑位

被隐藏的模型不在目录里（harness 会把它过滤掉），所以它的行只能靠保存下来的信息重建。**顺理成章地把行追加到末尾，会让它一被隐藏就跳到分组底部**。本插件记住每一行首次出现的位置，所以隐藏五个里的第三个，它仍然排在第三。

## 它刻意不做的事

**整理是显示层的决定，绝不是配置改动。**

- 不重写你的渠道配置。隐藏列表与备注表只存在本插件自己的设置命名空间里。
- 正在使用某模型的会话不受影响——路由按模型 id 走，改的只是显示名。
- 卸载插件后列表完全恢复原样。
- 渠道新上架的模型默认可见。本插件记录的是「要隐藏什么、要改什么名」，从不是「要显示什么」。

## 覆盖范围

开关作用于**所有**模型来源，不限于手工配置的渠道。插件过滤的是 harness 自己的目录枚举——`ctx.llm.listModels`，也就是每个界面都会读的那一份列表。其他插件通过 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter` 注册的模型、以及 `llm-pi-ai` 下声明的渠道，都落在这一份列表里，因此都被覆盖。

行按 **渠道 + 模型** 作键，所以同一模型名经两条路由进来仍是两行独立控制：`workbuddy/gemini-3.8-flash` 与 `gemini/gemini-3.8-flash` 是不同的上游服务，各有各的开关和备注。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-model-tidy
```

然后重新打开 DSH Web GUI，设置导航里会出现「**模型整理**」。

## 开发

无需构建：两半都以 harness 直接加载的原始文件形式发布。宿主半是 ES 模块；浏览器半是 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 工厂——客户端模块系统调用的格式。

```sh
npm test
```

一次跑完九套测试：目录过滤器、倍率后缀切分、浏览器半行为、备注后缀抓取、行序保持、自定义排序、排序渲染、渲染结构，以及与另一个包装同一个方法的插件共存。

`npm run check:packaging` 校验客户端依赖声明指向的包在 harness 中真实存在。

## 兼容性

针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 开发。要求 DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.1`——该版本起设置层才提供本插件分区写入所用的 `configForms` 服务。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 主题工坊 — 可自定义背景色/背景图、字体、输入框、边栏颜色的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件（实时生效，43 项测试）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-theme-studio · DSH 主题工坊

> A theme plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web / desktop clients:
> custom background (colour, opacity, wallpaper, sidebar image), text, composer and sidebar colours,
> with a live settings page in **Settings → Theme Studio**. No restart, no DOM hacks — the colours are
> stacked through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`, plus a guarded `!important` layer for surfaces that an
> installed skin repaints itself. Package shape is a standard DSH bundle, so
> `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <this repo>` is enough. Test suite included (`pnpm test`, 43 checks).

给 DSH Web / 桌面客户端用的「自定义配色」插件。装好之后在 **设置 → 主题工坊** 里就能改：

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 背景色 + 背景透明度 | 整个会话区的底色，不透明度可调（0% 全透明 → 100% 不透明） |
| 字体颜色 | 主文本色 + 次要文本色（说明、时间戳、占位提示） |
| 输入框颜色 | 底部输入卡片的底色，同样带不透明度 |
| 边栏颜色 | 左侧会话列表栏的底色，同样带不透明度 |
| 边栏背景图 | 给边栏单独放一张图（和主背景图互不影响）：本地图片或 URL、填充方式、3×3 位置、暗化；图片留白处露出边栏底色 |
| 背景图 | 本地图片或图片 URL；可调填充方式（智能 / 铺满 / 完整 / 原始大小 / 平铺 / 拉伸）、显示位置（3×3 锚点）、暗化程度或**按图片亮度自动暗化**；**每张图分别记住自己的填充/位置** |

所有改动 **即时生效**，不需要重启；配色保存在浏览器 localStorage，可导出 / 导入 JSON 备份。

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：交给 DSH 自己装（推荐）

从 GitHub 直接装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/baizz-520/dsh-theme-studio
```

或者从本地目录装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本目录绝对路径>
```

也可以在 DSH 的 **Plugins / 插件市场** 页面里安装，或手动把本目录放到 profile 的 `node_modules` 下（见方式 B）。

### 方式 B：手动放进去

1. 把本目录复制（或建软/硬链接）到 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-theme-studio`；
2. 在 `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-theme-studio
      name: dsh-theme-studio
```

3. 重启 DSH（或让 HMR 重新计算配置）。

`<DSH_HOME>` 默认是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`，桌面端的 profile 名一般是 `desktop`。

## 使用

1. 打开 **设置**（左下角齿轮）→ 左侧导航选 **主题工坊**；
2. 顶部的 **启用主题** 是总开关；
3. 每张卡片右上角的开关表示「是否覆盖内置配色」，关掉就沿用 DSH 自带配色；
4. 想快速换个风格，先点一个 **预设**，再逐项微调；
5. 用 **背景图** 时记住：启用／选图会自动把「背景」的不透明度降到 78%，图片才有地方透出来；想要更清楚就把不透明度再往下调。
6. **填充方式**决定图片怎么放进这块区域：`智能`（默认）= 图片比例和窗口接近就铺满、差太多就完整显示，避免竖图被横窗裁掉大半；`铺满`= 等比放大裁掉多余；`完整`= 整张图都看见、四周留底色；`原始大小`= 按图片像素显示（小于区域就按锚点摆放）；`平铺`= 按原始尺寸重复铺开（适合小图案/纹理）；`拉伸`= 强行拉满会变形。
7. **显示位置**是 3×3 锚点（左上 … 右下）：`铺满`时决定裁切保留哪一块，`原始大小`/`完整`时决定图片贴在哪一边，`平铺`时决定重复的起点。
8. **自动暗化**打开后，插件会把图片缩到 16×16 取样、算平均相对亮度，越亮压得越暗（0–45%），并把结果显示在开关下面；图片本身暗就几乎不压。跨域且没有 CORS 头的图读不到像素，这时会自动回退到手动暗化并在页面上说明。
9. **每张图单独记忆**：换图时如果这张图以前调过填充/位置，会自动恢复；最多记 20 张（按图片内容哈希存，不存图本身）。
10. **边栏背景图**是独立的一张图：画在 `[data-slot="sidebar"]` 的列容器上，垫在边栏底色之上（所以「完整」留白处露出的是你设的边栏色，不是主背景）。它不受主背景图的开关影响，两者可以同时启用。

### 「跟随 / 自定义」与透明度的关系

- 每项默认「自定义」关闭（即沿用内置配色），所以刚装好时界面不会变化 —— 动一下任意颜色或点预设即可。
- 背景不透明度为 100% 时，背景图基本看不到；想让背景图（或窗口后面的内容）透出来，就调低这一项。
- 边栏 / 输入框的不透明度低于 100% 时，会透出「背景」那一层（即背景色或背景图）。

### 和皮肤（Skins）的关系

- 装了立绘类皮肤（如 maid-atelier）时，插件在**启用背景图**期间会隐藏皮肤自己那条整屏立绘（统一的 `[data-skin-chrome]` 约定），否则它会把你的图整块盖住；皮肤的版式、字体、其它装饰都保留。
- 皮肤给「列 / 面板」写死的底色，令牌和继承都碰不到（自己的声明永远赢），所以插件会**在运行时找出真正不透明的那些表面，就地画上背景图**。对话框、菜单、弹层不参与，保持自己的底色。

## 实现说明（给想改代码的人）

- 浏览器端是一个 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 形式的 CJS 形态 bundle（`lib/client.js`），宿主端 `lib/index.js` 是空实现 —— 该功能没有任何 Host 侧行为。
- 颜色走两条并行通道，缺一不可：
  1. `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-theme-studio', tokens)` 叠一层令牌覆盖层（不改内置主题、卸载即移除）；
  2. 一组带 `!important` 的"直接绘制"规则，用 `html[data-dts-*]` 属性门控 —— 因为**皮肤在自己作用域上重新声明同名令牌时，继承来的值永远赢不了**，只靠令牌会出现"改了一半"。
- 覆盖的令牌：

| 控件 | CSS 令牌 |
| --- | --- |
| 背景 | `--dsw-alias-bg-base` |
| 边栏 | `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` |
| 输入框 | `--dsw-specific-input-major` |
| 主文本 / 次要文本 | `--dsw-alias-label-primary` / `--dsw-alias-label-secondary`，并由次要色派生 `-tertiary` / `-caption` / `-dimmed` / `-primary-dimmed` |

- 背景图**不是一个独立图层**：它按需画在"运行时发现的、真正盖住视口的那些不透明表面"上（`background-attachment: fixed` 保证多层严格对齐成一张图）。独立图层方案在装了皮肤时不成立 —— 画布层会被壳的 `wFrame` 和列底色挡住，`::before + z-index:-1` 会被所有不透明内容挡住，`z-index` 抬高又会盖住整个界面。
- 背景图的图层字符串在 JS 里拼好后以**内联 `!important`** 写入，不用 `var()` 代入 `url(...)`：多图层 `background-image` 里只要有一层解析失败，整条声明作废，图片会静默消失而底色还在。
- 设置页通过 `ctx.slots.register({ name: 'settings.section', ... })` 注册，文案走 `ctx.locale.register('settings.theme-studio', { zh, en })`。

## 测试

包内自带一套行为测试，直接跑真实 bundle（不是 mock 实现）：

```powershell
node test/client-harness.mjs     # 或 pnpm test
```

它搭一个够用的 DOM 桩（含 `window.getComputedStyle`、`MutationObserver`、`Image`、canvas、localStorage、`URL.createObjectURL`、`FileReader`），把设置页真正渲染出来、逐个点过每一个控件，然后断言：

- 令牌层叠/替换/释放次数与内容（含 `-tertiary`/`-caption`/`-dimmed` 派生色）；
- 四条"直接绘制"属性、根变量、颜色/不透明度的 `rgba()` 换算；
- 背景图 6 种填充 → `background-size`/`background-repeat` 映射、3×3 锚点、暗化梯度、URL 转义；
- 每图独立记忆的往返（A → B → A）；
- 边栏背景图只落在边栏列、不串到主区；
- 超大文件被拒、坏 JSON 被拒且不改动已有配置、有效导入被应用、恢复默认；
- 总开关关闭后令牌层被释放、所有内联绘制被清掉；
- 卸载后再 `apply()`（HMR 反复启停）能恢复；
- 卸载后延迟回调不再重绘；
- 每条文案键在 zh/en 都存在；
- 全程 `console.error` 为零。

当前基线：**43/43 通过**。

## 兼容性

- 需要客户端提供 `slots` / `locale` / `theme` 三个服务，以及 `theme.overrideTokens`（DSH 0.2.0 起具备）。
- 只在 `platform: web` 的客户端加载；不涉及模型、工具、网络请求。

## 卸载

在插件页停用，或删掉 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那三行 insert，然后 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-theme-studio`。

## License

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-recollection 🧠

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的**跨会话长期记忆**：按**工作区**隔离、**跨会话**共享。

DSH 的会话一关，上下文就散了。这个插件把「做过什么、当时怎么决定的、那个坑是什么」沉淀下来，
需要时再**分层、按需**地取回 —— 常驻 prompt 的永远只有最便宜的那一层。

核心是**分层检索**：常驻的只有**浅层要点**（「大概有什么」一眼可见）；条目很长时，中间还有一层
**段级引索** —— 先定位到「哪一段」，只把那一段取回来；**深层原文**（当时的思考、命令、结论）
留在本地向量库里，真要细节时才取。实测一条 1.5 万字的记忆取回一段约 1200 字，**省 92%~97%**。

---

## 快速开始（安装插件）

> 以下命令都在你的**命令行终端**（PowerShell / CMD / bash 等）中运行。

```sh
# ① 前置要求：确认 Node.js 已安装
node -v

# ② 安装 DSH 启动器与 pnpm（已装可跳过；装完请重新打开终端）
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh pnpm
dsh --version   # 验证 dsh 命令可用

# ③ 安装本插件：--profile 填你实际在用的那个
#    桌面应用（Electron 版）→ desktop；dsh web → web
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-workspace-recollection
```

装完**重开桌面应用**（`dsh web` 用户则重启 `dsh web`）才生效 —— 运行中的进程持有内存里的旧插件。
之后点会话头部的「🧠 记忆」就能打开记忆面板。

> **兼容性**：本插件在 dsh **`0.2.0-rc.2`** 下开发并测试（`dsh --version` 可查看你的版本）。
> 建议使用相同版本；其他版本如遇问题欢迎反馈。

### 从源码安装（clone 本仓库后）

本插件是**纯 JavaScript、无构建步骤** —— clone 下来就能直接挂载：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/reaxlll/dsh-workspace-recollection.git
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/path/to/dsh-workspace-recollection
```

改源码后重开应用即可（宿主半侧改动必须重启；浏览器半侧刷新页面即可）。

### 首次启动会自动装好嵌入模型

语义检索需要一个本地嵌入模型（`Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5`，512 维，ONNX 量化版约 23MB）。
**不用你动手**：插件启动时会检查它是否在位，缺了就自己从镜像（`hf-mirror.com`，失败自动回退
`huggingface.co`）逐个文件拉下来，下完自动加载 —— 实测 24MB 约 18 秒。
之后**运行时零联网**，也**不调任何云端 API**。

网络不通或下载失败也不会影响使用：`memory_recall` 自动退回关键词检索，其他功能照常；
面板状态条上的「加载模型」可随时重试。

## 💬 反馈与发版节奏

欢迎提 [issue](https://github.com/reaxlll/dsh-workspace-recollection/issues) 与 PR —— bug、体验问题、优化想法都行。
可以随意对插件进行修改因为作者很可能没空维护，也对应了dsh那句，想要啥自己做(*^_^*)
但动手前请先翻一眼 [提交记录](https://github.com/reaxlll/dsh-workspace-recollection/commits/main)，
确认不是已经修掉的同款问题。

- **小修不单独发版**：不影响使用的小 bug 与优化会**累计**到下一个版本一起发。
  所以「`main` 上已经修了」不等于「你装的这版已经包含」—— `latest` 没更新时，以 `main` 的提交记录为准。
- **报 bug 时请带上**：插件版本、`dsh` 版本、操作系统、复现步骤（有日志或截图更好）——
  直接用 [issue 模板](https://github.com/reaxlll/dsh-workspace-recollection/issues/new/choose) 会把这些列好。
- **想改代码**？先看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)：代码地图、三条硬规矩（纯函数要配单测 / 阈值必须用真实回放来定 /
  约束行为要用代码而不是提示词）、常见改动配方，以及一份提 PR 前的检查清单。

## 插件功能

- **跨会话记忆**：记忆按会话 header 的 `cwd` 分桶 —— **一个工作区一份**，这个工作区里的所有会话共享同一份记忆
- **分层检索**：浅层要点（常驻）→ 段级引索（定位到段）→ 深层原文（按需取整条），三层都有工具，**够用就停**
- **噪音过滤**：`memory_recall` 的结果自动过四路信号（绝对底线 / 硬特征 / 相对长尾 / 平局），跑题的别冒充「找到了」；被筛掉的**永不静默丢弃**，折成一行 `id + 分数` 留着你复查
- **时间通道**：问「10月6日」「九天前」「昨天」这类问题时，按本地日历日**直接筛出那天的条目**，并给出涉及到的会话 id（可顺着读会话原文）
- **排序分层**：深层分是靠正文块「撞」出来的，容易虚高 —— 只有要点分够高、或命中 query 的硬特征、或能被段级引索复核出「实词」的，才承认它的深层分
- **本地嵌入 · 零联网**：`bge-small-zh-v1.5`（512 维，ONNX q8）跑在本机，**不调任何 API**；加载约 35ms、编码约 2ms/条
- **模型自己装**：启动时检测嵌入模型是否在位，缺了就自动从镜像拉取（约 23MB，实测 18 秒），下完自动加载
- **AI 压要点**：写完记忆直接走人，后台队列用 `ctx.llm.stream` 把长正文压成一句话要点（也可自己给，或手写）
- **会话导入**：把本工作区的历史会话一键收进长期记忆（一条记忆 = 你当时说的话 + 思考原文 + 用到的工具 + 结论）
- **面板**：会话头「🧠 记忆」抽屉 —— 状态条 / 记忆列表 / 新增编辑 / **预览注入** / **检索测试** / **Memory.md**（预览 + 编辑手记区块）
- **不碰内核**：只用官方插件 API（`systemPrompt.section` / `tools.register` / `webServer.register`），前后端走 `/api/session-memory/*`

## 分层结构

| 层 | 位置 | 角色 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **事实源** | `$DSH_HOME/session-memory/memory.json` | 每条 = `text`（深层原文，可长）+ `summary`（浅层一句话） |
| **索引** | `<工作区>/Memory.md` | 常驻注入 system prompt，写的是**浅层要点**；底部「手记」区块原样保留 |
| **向量** | `$DSH_HOME/session-memory/vectors.json` | 每条**两份向量**：`s`（浅层，检索定位）/ `d`（深层，兜底补齐） |
| **段索引** | 不落盘，运行时现算（`lib/segments.js`） | 把正文按 `##` 切成段，用**纯 CPU 的 BM25** 关键词定位到段号 |

## 检索流程（为什么省 token）

```
memory_recall("那个编码的坑")            →  浅层向量检索 → 噪音过滤 → 只回「要点 + id + 相似度」
        ↓ 条目很长时（清单里标了「长文」，上万字的会话导入都是）
memory_locate({ id, query: "zstd" })     →  段级 BM25 定位 → 只回「段号 + 小标题 + 字数 + 命中词 + 预览」
        ↓ 挑好段号
memory_detail({ ids, segments: [2, 7] }) →  只取这两段切片
```

浅层文本短、语义集中，定位更准也更省；深层只在真要细节时才付 token；
**段级引索让「真要细节」也不必整条取回** —— 一个字都不多花。
浅层向量缺失时自动回退；嵌入不可用再回退关键词检索。

取用顺序（也写进了工具描述与每轮注入）：**按需逐层、够用就停** ——
① `memory_recall` 拿要点 → ② 要点不够就用要点里的关键词 `memory_locate` 拿段号、`memory_detail({segments})` 取切片 →
③ 浅层和切片都还不够（要当时的思考、命令全文）才 `memory_detail({ids})` 整条兜底。**别为了「完整」把三层都调一遍。**

## 八个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_write` | 写记忆：`text` 写**完整**深层内容，`summary` 可选（省略则 AI 总结） |
| `memory_recall` | **浅层**语义检索（带时间通道），只回要点 + id；自带噪音过滤（`filter` / `min_score` 可覆盖；被略去的折成一行 id+分数） |
| `memory_locate` | **段级引索**：在已命中的那条里按关键词定位段号，只回段号/小标题/字数/命中词/预览 |
| `memory_detail` | 按 id 取**深层完整原文**；给 `segments: [段号]` 就只取那几段切片 |
| `memory_search` | 关键词精确检索（不走向量） |
| `memory_forget` | 删除（两份向量一并清；锁定条目删不掉） |
| `memory_import` | 把本工作区的历史会话导入长期记忆（一条用户消息 = 一条记忆） |
| `session_read` | 读历史会话原文/摘要的**正门**（不带 id 列会话；`mode:"raw"` 取指定轮次原文含思考） |

> 手工解压 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/` 下的 zstd 会话文件已被插件在**工具层硬拦**（`tools/pre-execute` deny）——
> 不是靠提示词自律，而是那条路走不通。要走正门用 `session_read`。

## 检索噪音过滤

**要解决的问题**：`memory_recall` 原本是「排序后取 top-K」，没有任何过滤。
导入大批历史会话后，无关条目照样挤进前几名 —— bge 的相似度**整体偏高**（无关也能到 0.5+），
绝对阈值不可信；而**单一分数也切不干净**：实测同主题查询里，无关条目的分甚至高于相关条目。

**做法**（`lib/noise.js`，纯函数零依赖，可脱离 DSH 单测）—— 四路信号，从硬到软：

| 信号 | 判定 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ① 绝对底线 | `top1 < 0.45` → 一条都不留，明说「没有明显相关的记忆」 | 纯噪音查询的 top1 实测落在 0.40 附近 |
| ② 关键词硬特征 | query 里的专有名词 / ASCII 词 / emoji，在**要点或标签**里一个都没命中 → 略去（分数多高都不留） | 跨主题噪音靠这个切，分数上看不出来 |
| ③ 相对长尾 | 低于 `top1 × 0.88` **且**绝对差 > 0.08 → 略去 | 砍掉明显跟不上的尾巴 |
| ④ 平局 | 前四条挤在 0.05 跨度内 → 只留前三条 | 没有谁真正胜出时，后面的往往正是跑题的 |

两条**反误杀**的护栏（都是实测踩出来的）：

- **硬特征只查要点 + 标签，不查正文**：两万字的会话正文里随便提过一句「PowerShell」就算命中，
  会把「配置某个工具」这种跑题条目留下来。
- **只在 query 给出两个以上硬特征时才开硬切**：单个硬特征（如「emoji」）会误杀真相关的条目
  （它讲了这件事，只是没写那个词）。另外硬特征命中的条目**豁免③的长尾规则**（主题对上号了，分低一点也留）。

**可覆盖**：`memory_recall({ filter: "auto" | "off" | "strict", min_score: 0.5 })` ——
`off` 回到旧行为看原始排名，`min_score` 是显式下限（一律生效、不豁免）。
阈值集中在 `lib/noise.js` 顶部常量，调完跑 `npm test`（用例里的分数直接取自回放，是「阈值有没有被改坏」的回归网）。

### 排序分层：深层分要有「资格」

深层的排序分是**正文分块取最大值**得来的 —— 块越多，撞上一个高分块的期望越高，
于是长文天然占便宜，无区分度的查询也会被刷出虚高的分（实测里三条八竿子打不着的长文霸占了前三名）。

所以深层分现在**要有资格**才被承认，三条任意一条成立即可：

1. query 的**硬特征**（专有名词 / ASCII 词 / emoji）命中了这条的要点或标签；
2. **要点分本身够高**（≥ 0.45，与绝对底线同语义：连底线都够不着 = 这条在要点层没有落点）；
3. 通过**段级引索的二级验证** —— 用 BM25 在这条正文里复核，且命中的词里至少有一个是「实词」。

第 3 条的门槛是**文档频率**（词出现在多少条记忆里）：中文 bigram 的泛词毫无区分度
（实测「什么」出现在 98 条里、「10」122 条、「日」60 条），拿「命中 ≥2 词」当判据时
8 条跑题条目里 7 条都能蒙混过关；限到「至少一个词的文档频率 ≤ 15」之后，跑题组 **0/8** 通过、
真相关组 **6/6** 通过。三条都不成立的条目会被**降级**（退回要点分排序，结果里标「要点弱命中」）——
它不会被丢弃，但不再用正文撞出来的高分冒充相关。

## 段级引索层

**要解决的问题**：`memory_recall` 只能定位到「哪一条」，`memory_detail` 一给就是整条正文（上限 2 万字）——
记忆越长取一次越贵，而里面常常只有一小段是真正要找的。

**做法**（全部本地 CPU：零依赖、零联网、零模型、确定性；代码在 `lib/segments.js`，可脱离 DSH 单测）：

| 步骤 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 切段 | `##` 小节是唯一可靠的语义边界 → 按标题切「节」；一节短于 900 字就整节成一段，长了才按 600 字在空行/句末断开，每片带 `节名 (i/n)` 序号；不足 40 字的碎屑节（如一行代码围栏）并入前节，标题写回正文保证信息不丢 |
| 抽词 | 中文 **bigram** + ASCII 词元 —— 不引 jieba；路径、命令、常量名原样保留（`MAX_TEXT_CHARS`、`pnpm`、`/srv/app/deploy`） |
| 打分 | 段级 **BM25**（k1=1.2, b=0.75）；含 `_ - . : / \` 的精确形态词加权 ×2.2（这类词命中率极高，也正是记忆里最常搜的东西） |
| 返回 | **只回段号 / 小标题 / 字数 / 命中词 / 命中位置的上下文片段**（围绕命中的词取，不是固定截开头），正文一个字都不回 |

性能与效果：切段 + 全量定位在几百条量级只要**几十毫秒**（纯 CPU）；
用每条记忆自己的要点当 query 回查，能**全部命中**到自己的正文段；1.5 万字的记忆取 2 段 ≈ 1200 字。

**三个坑（都已处理）**：

1. **空行不是硬边界**：会话导入的「当时的思考」内部全是空行，按空行切会把它剁成几十个没名字的碎片
   （实测 1.5 万字 → 64 段、段名全丢）。→ 先按标题切节，节内不打散。
2. **段数超上限时必须合并尾部，不能截断**：一份 1.2 万字的部署命令清单有几十个小节，截断会静默丢掉后半截
   （实测覆盖率 81.8% → 91.5%）。另外覆盖率不到 100% 是正常的 —— 段里不含小标题行与 `---` 分隔线，
   标题信息在段号的 label 里。

3. **预览不能固定截段开头**：关键词常落在段的中后部（实测一条 532 字的段里，
   `font_*.png` / `click_font` / 路径全在中后段），而预览只截前 80 字，于是模型看到的是开头那句闲聊 ——
   它据此判断「词碰上了、内容没对上」，直接跳过 `memory_detail`，白白浪费一次**已经成功**的定位。
   → 预览改成**围绕最先出现的命中词取上下文**（前 36 / 后 76 字，两端补省略号）。

**边界**：短条目（不足 900 字）整条就是 1 段，切片对它没意义 —— 直接用 `memory_detail` 取全文即可。

## 时间通道

「九天前我问了什么」「10月6日做了什么」这类问题，向量检索**答不了** ——
记忆的各层文本里从来没有时间戳，日期型 query 在向量层没有任何落点（只会靠正文块零散撞词，
把语义相近但时间无关的长文刷上来）。

所以 query 里带日期或相对时间时，直接走**结构化过滤**：按本地日历日筛出那天的条目，按发生时间列出，
并把涉及到的会话 id 一并给出（顺着 `session_read` 就能读回那天的对话原文）。认这些形态：

| 形态 | 例子 |
| --- | --- |
| 绝对日期 | `2026-10-06`、`2026年10月6日`、`2026/10/6` |
| 月日 | `10月6日`、`10月6号`（晚于今天则算去年） |
| 相对日 | `今天`、`昨天`、`前天`、`大前天` |
| N 天前 | `9天前`、`九天前`、`十五天前`（中文数字也认） |

> ⚠️ **时间字段的可信度是分来源的**：只有助手自己写的条目（`source.origin` 为 `agent` / `panel`），
> 时间字段才代表「事件发生时间」；从旧环境**导入的存档**，时间字段是**落库时间**（那批条目全挤在导入那一天），
> 拿它做时间反查会把整批一起捞出来 —— 所以这类来源不参与时间反查。

## AI 要点总结

- **可以不写 summary 直接写记忆**：后台队列自动用 `ctx.llm.stream` 压成一句话（实测 600~900ms）。
- **也可以直接给 summar

plugins.description: DSH plugin: offline official Godot documentation as agent tools - ranked search, class/member/enum lookup, and API checks against the engine version the project really uses. / 把本地 Godot 官方文档变成 DSH 的离线文档工具链。
plugins.readme_text:
# godot-docs — offline Godot documentation tools for DSH

A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that turns a local
checkout of the **official Godot documentation** into agent tools. Instead of relying on
model memory (which is usually Godot 3.x or an older 4.x), the agent answers Godot API and
engine questions from the documentation that matches the project's engine build, and quotes
the page and line it used.

> Repository: <https://github.com/TheoiNabiy/godot-docs-dsh-plugin> · 中文文档见
> [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

```
docs tree ──▶ index (classes, members, body tokens) ──▶ godot_docs_* tools ──▶ the agent
```

## Why

* **Correct version, not remembered version.** The docs in the tree are the authority for
  this project. The plugin detects the documented revision (e.g. `4.7`) and reports it.
* **Exact signatures, not paraphrases.** `godot_docs_member("CharacterBody2D","move_and_slide")`
  returns the real signature, defaults, flags and description, with the file line.
* **Cheap to consult.** Search is 25–90 ms per query over 1 600 pages / 32 MiB of RST.
* **Offline.** No network access at any point; the docs tree is indexed from disk.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `godot_docs_search` | Ranked full-text search over the tree (all / classes / tutorials), returns an excerpt and a `root-relative path#Lline`. Results on a conventions page are flagged with `convention_topic`. |
| `godot_docs_class` | Class reference lookup: inheritance chain (both directions — ancestors and direct subclasses), description, tutorials, **enum members with their values**, and the full member map with exact line numbers |
| `godot_docs_member` | One member in full: signature, arguments, defaults, description, file line (`kind:name` forces a kind). Inherited members resolve through the chain and report `declared_on`; enums list every value; constants report theirs. |
| `godot_docs_find_member` | Reverse lookup: which classes declare a member with this name (`signal:body_entered` → every class that has it) |
| `godot_docs_project_settings` | Look up documentation for a setting or a whole branch (`debug/gdscript/warnings/` lists every GDScript warning), or validate a real `project.godot` and report keys that are not documented |
| `godot_docs_get` | Read a page or one section of it as cleaned, line-numbered text (`path#L120-L180`, `path#Method Descriptions`) |
| `godot_docs_code` | Extracted documentation code samples (`gdscript`, `csharp`, `glsl`, `cpp`, …) to adapt instead of inventing API calls |
| `godot_docs_conventions` | The official Godot **conventions** for a topic (GDScript style, project/scene organisation, static typing, exports, autoloads, signals, warnings, C# style and API differences, shader style, file paths, i18n, performance, threads, editor plugins, …) together with the page that defines it |
| `godot_docs_project_search` | Literal/regex search over the **current project's own sources** — see how an API is already used, find every call site, check whether a recommended pattern is followed |
| `godot_docs_api_check` | Validate identifiers (`Class`, `Class.member`), a pasted GDScript/C# snippet, or **whole project directories** — scripts *and* `.tscn`/`.tres` scenes and resources — reporting use sites (`file:line`) for names that do not exist in this docs version |
| `godot_docs_status` | Which docs trees are indexed, the detected docs version, page/class counts, cache state, probes and resolution errors |
| `godot_set_docs_path` | Persist the docs tree location into the plugin configuration (applies immediately) |

The plugin also installs three system-prompt sections, so an agent in this session knows to
consult the docs first, how to wire up the docs path, and — importantly — to follow the
engine's own conventions rather than another engine's habits or remembered advice.

## Conventions, not just API

The docs tree already contains this project's coding standards. `godot_docs_conventions`
maps a topic or alias to the authoritative page (and reports whether that page exists in
this tree), `godot_docs_search` flags convention pages in its results, and the
`godot-docs:conventions` prompt section states the rules of thumb the docs establish:
GDScript style guide naming and code order, static typing, `@export` for tunables, signals
instead of polling, shallow node trees split into scenes, `%UniqueName`, restraint with
autoloads, writing to `user://` rather than `res://` at runtime, keeping translatable text
in `tr()` without concatenation, handing work back to the main thread instead of calling
engine APIs from threads, and not ignoring engine warnings.

40 topics are catalogued, each verified to exist in the docs tree by the test harness:
GDSCRIPT style/typing/exports/doc-comments/warnings/format strings, C# style, C# API
differences and C# features, project/scene organisation, scenes versus scripts, autoloads,
signals, groups, resources, nodes versus objects, logic versus data, data preferences,
interfaces, notifications, idle versus physics processing, overridable functions, pausing,
input, multiple resolutions, file paths, i18n, performance, thread-safe APIs, shader style,
editor plugins, unit testing and more.

## Checking real code

`godot_docs_api_check(paths=[...])` walks a project's own **scripts and scenes** and reports
every reference that is not documented for this engine version, with each use site
(`file:line`). It is deliberately conservative — a false positive costs more than a missed
finding — so it only asserts what it can prove.

For scripts:

* `Class.member` on a documented class, with members resolved through the **inheritance
  chain** (`Node.get_property_list` is found on `Object`; `TCPServer.new` is a language
  constructor, not a missing method);
* members of a variable whose type is provable: an `is` check, an `as` cast, a constructor,
  or a documented return type;
* never: string literals (`"res://levels/Node2D.tscn"`), container keys (`Dictionary` /
  `Array` property bags), variables shadowed with `:=`, `self.`/`super.` members, or
  GDScript language built-ins.

For `.tscn`/`.tres` scenes and resources:

* **node types** must be documented classes (`type="Sprite2Dxx"` is reported);
* **node and sub-resource properties** are checked against the node's class, so a typo'd or
  renamed property is caught without ever running the editor;
* properties declared by the node's own script — `@export var max_health` — are resolved from
  the project's scripts, **including inherited ones** (`extends Entity`), and so are the
  exports of an **instanced scene's root script**;
* **signal connections** are checked against the resolving node's class;
* the format/editor furniture that is not class API is recognised and counted, not reported:
  `layout_mode`, `anchors_preset`, `theme_override_*`, `metadata/*`, block headers;
* the `.tres` root `[resource]` block is checked against its `gd_resource type`.

`godot_docs_project_settings(path=<project dir>)` does the same for `project.godot`: it
reports every key that is not documented for this engine version, with its file line and
close matches. `config_version` and `application/config/features` (engine-written) plus the
user-defined `[input]`, `[autoload]`, `[layer_names]` and `[editor_plugins]` sections are
recognised as structure rather than API.

Across the author's seven real Godot projects the script checker reports about 2 findings per
6 000 API usages, and both were genuine mistakes (`Camera3D.get_environment()`, which only
exists on `World3D`, and `ThemeDB.get_fallback_font()`, which is a property rather than a
method).

### Which project a call searches

Tools that read project files take the **session workspace** as their base: an omitted
`path`/`paths` starts there, a relative entry resolves against it, and a `project.godot` at it
or in one of its parents is what names the project. The host process's own directory is never
used for this — in the desktop app it is the DSH profile directory, and a search that silently
scanned `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>` used to answer "no matches" while calling that the project.

When no `proj

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows the current session's spend, priced by DeepSeek's peak and off-peak rate windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-session-spend

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that shows what the current
session has cost so far, split by DeepSeek's peak and off-peak rate windows.

![The cost pill and its breakdown panel](docs/screenshot.png)

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

## What it shows

A pill in the composer dock, beside the shipped token-usage pill:

```
   [shipped] 11 turns 191 steps · 226 tok/s   51.5M tok · 99.5% cached        (¥) ¥2.75
```

Click it for the breakdown. A session that stayed inside one window shows a single block:

```
(¥) Cost                                          ¥1.09
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Off-peak · 110 requests
Uncached input                          187K tok · ¥0.187
Cache read                            20.77M tok · ¥0.415
Output                                  121K tok · ¥0.482
```

A session spanning both windows splits into two blocks, each with its own subtotal:

```
(¥) Cost                                          ¥3.30
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Peak · 3 requests
Uncached input                         1.00M tok · ¥2.00
Output                                  100K tok · ¥0.800
Subtotal                                          ¥2.80
Off-peak · 7 requests
Cache read                             5.00M tok · ¥0.100
Output                                  100K tok · ¥0.400
Subtotal                                          ¥0.500
```

The figure is the **whole session**, not the loaded window: paging, compaction, and
resuming a session do not change it, and a retried model request is not billed twice.

## Install

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/dtxovo/dsh-plugin-session-spend
cd dsh-plugin-session-spend
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

The script does two things: copies the package to `<profile>\plugins\session-cost\`, and
appends the mount entry to `<profile>\cordis.patch.yml` (skipped when it is already there).
Then **refresh the DSH page (Ctrl+R)**.

The profile directory is resolved in this order: the `-ProfileDir` argument, then
`$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR`, then `~\.dsh\profiles\desktop`.

`-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` is needed because Windows blocks unsigned `.ps1` files by
default. On a machine whose execution policy already allows local scripts, `.\install.ps1`
works as-is. On macOS or Linux, do the same two steps by hand under PowerShell 7.

## Configure

Edit the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and save — the patch layer is watched, so no restart
is needed. Refresh the page afterwards so the browser picks up the new rates.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-cost-v2
      name: ./plugins/session-cost/host.js
      config:
        currency: "¥"     # display symbol
        per: 1000000      # the four rates below are per this many tokens
        input: 1          # uncached input     <- off-peak rate
        cacheRead: 0.02   # cache read         <- off-peak rate
        cacheWrite: 0     # cache write (DeepSeek does not bill this separately)
        output: 4         # output             <- off-peak rate
        holidays: []      # Beijing dates, e.g. ["2026-10-01", "2026-10-02"]
        # peak:           # omit to default to off-peak x 2
        #   input: 2
        #   cacheRead: 0.04
        #   cacheWrite: 0
        #   output: 8
```

The built-in defaults are **DeepSeek `deepseek-flash` off-peak list prices** in CNY per
million tokens, taken from the official pricing page on 2026-10-15:

| | Off-peak | Peak |
|---|---|---|
| Input (cache hit) | ¥0.02 | ¥0.04 |
| Input (cache miss) | ¥1 | ¥2 |
| Output | ¥4 | ¥8 |

**Check them against your own bill.** A third-party gateway does not bill these numbers,
and this table covers only `deepseek-flash`.

## Limitations

- **Holidays are yours to fill in.** `holidays` defaults to empty. China's public holidays
  are announced yearly and cannot be derived, so top the list up each year. Weekends that
  are worked as make-up days stay off-peak: the published rule only looks at Monday-Friday
  plus the holiday list.
- **One rate table, not one per model.** Switching models mid-session is not detected; every
  token is priced with the same rates.
- **Reasoning tokens are not added on top.** `reasoningTokens` is a subset of what output is
  billed for, so adding it would double-count.
- **An estimate, not an invoice.** Token cost only — no minimum spend, tiered pricing,
  currency conversion, or granted credit.
- **The peak window is fixed** at Beijing time Monday-Friday 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00.

The design behind the numbers, and the DSH internals this plugin had to work around, are in
[docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md](docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md).

## Development

```powershell
node .\check.mjs         # 44 assertions on the client half, against ./client.js
node .\check-host.mjs "<profile>\plugins\session-cost\host.js"   # 33 assertions on the host half
```

`check.mjs` needs nothing but Node: it renders the client half through a small React
stand-in that covers exactly the API surface the component uses.

`check-host.mjs` imports the host half, which resolves `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` and `zod`
from its own location — both are supplied by DeepSeek Harness. Point it at an installed copy
(the normal case), or install those two packages first. Run it with no argument and it says
so instead of failing silently.

## Releasing

Publishing happens in CI, never from a laptop: [`.github/workflows/publish.yml`](.github/workflows/publish.yml)
publishes on a `v*` tag through npm **Trusted Publishing** (OIDC), so this repository holds no
`NPM_TOKEN` and no long-lived write credential — nothing to leak and nothing to rotate.
Provenance attestations are attached automatically for a public package in a public repository.

1. Bump `version` in `package.json` and commit.
2. `git tag v0.1.0 && git push origin v0.1.0`.

The tag-driven run needs a Trusted Publisher configured once on npmjs.com: the package's
Settings → Trusted Publisher → GitHub Actions, with user `dtxovo`, repository
`dsh-plugin-session-spend`, and workflow `publish.yml`.

## License

MIT © 2026 dtxovo

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：Google Antigravity 直连代理核心与模型服务，支持双模型池额度监控、热切换网络代理与长文本防御
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-antigravity-direct

[![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-Plugin-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.3.2-green.svg)](package.json)

**dsh-antigravity-direct** 是专为 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 打造的本地直连代理核心插件。

它在本地启动高性能回环代理服务（默认 `127.0.0.1:8790`），将标准 OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions` 协议无缝转换为 Google Antigravity（Cloud Code PA）的 `v1internal` 协议，使 DSH 能够以原生级体验调用 **Gemini 3.8 / 3.1** 与 **Claude 4.6** 等高配云端模型。

---

## ✨ 核心特性

- 🔄 **协议双向实时转接**：
  - OpenAI `/v1/chat/completions`（流式/非流式）⇄ Google Antigravity `generateContent` / `streamGenerateContent`。
  - 完整适配流式思考过程（Reasoning/Thinking Stream）、多模态图文输入（Vision）与原生工具调用（Function Calling / Tools）。
- 📊 **双模型池额度可视化仪表盘**：
  - 在 DSH 设置面板「Antigravity 直连」中提供原生 UI。
  - 独立监控 **GEMINI 模型池** 与 **CLAUDE / GPT 模型池**。
  - 实时展示 5 小时会话限额与每周限额的双重进度条、剩余百分比、相对刷新时间及精准重置时刻。
- 🌐 **网络代理运行时热切换**：
  - 面板内置「网络代理设置 (HTTP / HTTPS Proxy)」卡片。
  - 支持免重启动态保存与切换代理地址（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:7890`，留空即走直连）。
  - 内置即时端点连通性测试与延迟探测。
- 🛡️ **长文本与工具调用多重防御**：
  - **路径降级与防政策误判**：自动净化 Tool Result 中的绝对路径与包裹标签，避免上游政策层审查误触。
  - **工具语法防截断与闭合保护**：超长上下文生成时，深度防御残缺工具语法泄露与 JSON 尾部碎屑。
  - **长思考保活心跳**：内置 TCP Keep-Alive 与指数退避重试，杜绝深度思考下的 502 / Socket Hang Up。
- 👥 **多账号管理与无缝切换**：
  - 支持多 Google 账号 OAuth 凭据轮换与状态持久化。
  - 支持在 Web 界面一键发起 OAuth 登录授权或移除失效账号。

---

## 📦 支持的模型矩阵

| 模型 ID | 展示名称 | 上下文窗口 | 最大输出 Token | 核心特性 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `gemini-3.8-flash` | Gemini 3.8 Flash | 300,000 | 128,000 | 极速响应、多模态、支持 Low/Medium/High 思考 |
| `gemini-3.8-flash-high` | Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) | 300,000 | 128,000 | 强化深度推理、复杂长文本创作 |
| `gemini-3.1-pro-high` | Gemini 3.1 Pro (Agent) | 300,000 | 128,000 | Agent 规划、高难度工具调用 |
| `claude-sonnet-4-6` | Claude Sonnet 4.6 | 200,000 | 64,000 | 代码架构、复杂逻辑重构、稳定输出 |
| `claude-opus-4-6-thinking` | Claude Opus 4.6 | 200,000 | 64,000 | 极致文学创作与长程严谨推理 |

---

## 🚀 安装指引

> ⚠️ **关于 DSH 桌面端安装的重要提示**：  
> 在 DSH 官方桌面客户端（Electron 架构）中，`desktop` profile 受到官方内核独占保护，在终端中直接运行 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ...` 会被内核闸门拦截并报错：  
> `error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`  
> 因此，请根据你的使用环境选择以下对应的安装方式：

### 方式一：DSH Desktop 桌面端一键安装（推荐）

1. 克隆或下载本仓库代码到本地任意目录：
   ```sh
   git clone https://github.com/LingK9999/dsh-antigravity-direct.git
   ```
2. 进入目录，直接运行内置的一键安装脚本即可：
   ```powershell
   cd dsh-antigravity-direct
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
   ```
   *脚本会自动完成插件目录部署、依赖同步与 profile bundles 注册，完成后重启 DSH Desktop 即可生效。*

### 方式二：DSH 客户端「插件市场 / 设置页」安装

若你的客户端安装了 `dshmarket`（插件市场）或支持在图形界面安装插件：
1. 打开 DSH 界面中的 **「设置」→「插件」**（或 **DSH 插件市场**）。
2. 在搜索或安装框中填入本仓库名：
   ```text
   github:LingK9999/dsh-antigravity-direct
   ```
3. 点击安装并重启 DSH。

### 方式三：命令行 Web Profile 安装（适用于 `dsh web` 纯网页端用户）

如果你使用的是在终端通过 `dsh web` 启动的非桌面端环境：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LingK9999/dsh-antigravity-direct
```

---

## ⚙️ 配置与使用

### 1. 注册 Provider 配置

插件随 DSH 启动时会在本地启动端口 `8790` 的回环服务。你需要将 Antigravity 模型注册进 DSH 配置文件：

在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`（或对应 profile 的配置文件）中，找到 `llm-pi-ai` 插件的 `config.providers` 节点，添加以下内容：

```yaml
      antigravity:
        displayName: Antigravity直连
        apiKeyEnv: GEMINI_API_KEY
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8790/v1
        models:
          - id: gemini-3.8-flash
            name: gemini-3.8-flash
            contextWindow: 300000
            maxTokens: 128000
            reasoningEfforts:
              low: low
              medium: medium
              high: high
            input: [text, image]
          - id: gemini-3.8-flash-high
            name: gemini-3.8-flash-high
            contextWindow: 300000
            maxTokens: 128000
            reasoningEfforts:
              low: low
              medium: medium
              high: high
            input: [text, image]
          - id: gemini-3.1-pro-high
            name: gemini-3.1-pro (agent)
            contextWindow: 300000
            maxTokens: 128000
            reasoningEfforts:
              low: low
              medium: medium
              high: high
            input: [text, image]
          - id: claude-sonnet-4-6
            name: claude-sonnet-4-6
            contextWindow: 200000
            maxTokens: 64000
            input: [text, image]
          - id: claude-opus-4-6-thinking
            name: claude-opus-4-6
            contextWindow: 200000
            maxTokens: 64000
            input: [text, image]
```

*(详见仓库内的 [`provider-config-snippet.yml`](provider-config-snippet.yml) 完整范例)*

### 2. 账号凭据导入与登录

插件默认自动扫描以下目录下的 OAuth 凭据文件（含有 `refresh_token` 的 JSON）：
- 默认目录：`~/.dsh/credentials/antigravity/*.json`
- 自定义环境变量：可通过 `AG_CREDS_DIR` 指定凭据文件夹，或通过 `AG_CREDS` 指定单凭据文件。

同时，你也能够在 DSH 设置页内点击 **「登录新账号」**，通过浏览器 OAuth 流程直接完成凭据绑定。

---

## 🛠️ 高级环境变量

| 变量名 | 说明 | 默认值 |

# dsh-xwide-annotation > **X-WIDE fork** — `dsh-xwide-annotation` is a derivative of [@changfenhuang/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation) v1.4.11 (by **omdsh-dev**, MIT), adding the **color studio** and the **annotation outline**. Upstream notice and MIT terms are retained verbatim in [LICENSE](./LICENSE). > > 📖 **Usage guide (with screenshots)**: **[docs/USAGE.md](./docs/USAGE.md)** · 简体中文：**[docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md](./docs/USAGE.zh-CN.md)** — quick start, outline panel, color studio, self-check pill, FAQ.
**English** · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Selection-annotation plugin for DSH Web: select text → annotate → press Enter to send it along with your message; the model replies to each annotation by number.

🌐 Live Product Site — Explore dsh-annotation in DSH

**Current UI (v1.5.6)** ![Two floating pills: color studio 🎨 and annotation outline 📋](./docs/img/10-floating-pills.png) ![Annotation outline strip — numbered entries per chat](./docs/img/11-outline-strip.png) ![Color studio panel: swatches, custom colors, self-test switch](./docs/img/12-color-studio-panel.png) ![Self-test badge: pill with live event counter](./docs/img/13-badge-pill-live.png) ![Self-test details: mount / style / contrast / hit-area numbers](./docs/img/14-selftest-detail.png)

Select any text in an assistant reply to annotate it (the annotation body may be left empty = just mark the passage). Annotations accumulate across messages and turns. An **Annotations ×N** chip appears next to the input box — hover to view all annotations, remove them one by one. Press Enter and the annotation block goes to the model together with whatever question is in the input box. **The annotation block never shows up as text in your own message bubble** — only the question plus the chip (content visible on hover; hidden before paint, zero flicker). The model replies with `Annotation 1: …` … `Annotation N: …`, one per annotation, and every Annotation label in the reply is a hoverable chip showing the annotated passage and your note. Form: official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + a `dsh.client` declaration in package.json, injected into the browser via client-modules; the Node half is an empty implementation). **Zero core changes** — no DSH files are touched; `cordis.patch.yml` only inserts its own id once, and the profile patch stays `[]`. ## Features Sidebar file annotations (DSH 0.1.6-alpha.1): select plain text, Markdown, or code in a workspace file preview and use the same annotate, save, and Enter-to-send flow. The editor and model-facing quote include the file path. After reloading and reopening the original file, its markers are restored; identical passages in different files remain separate. PDF, images, and HTML inside iframes are not covered. | Feature | Description | |---|---| | Select-to-annotate | Select assistant text → toolbar "Annotate" → write your note (may be empty); dismiss by clicking elsewhere or pressing Esc | | Numbered marker + highlight | A blue numbered marker + highlight anchored to the passage, viewport-anchored with collision avoidance, never lost when scrolled out of view | | Cross-turn collection | Any number of annotations accumulate across messages/turns, numbered from 1 | | "Annotations ×N" chip | Small chip beside the input box; hover shows every annotation, deletable individually | | Enter sends with your message | Annotation block + the question in the input box are sent to the model together (the model receives the full content) | | Hidden in your bubble | The annotation block is removed from your bubble's DOM the moment you send (before the browser paints), leaving only the question + the chip (hover to view); historical messages self-heal after a refresh | | Numbered reply correspondence | A format instruction is injected into the message so the model replies `Annotation 1: …` … `Annotation N: …` one by one | | Reply annotation chips | `Annotation N:` in the reply renders as hoverable chips showing the passage + your note | ## Interaction flow ``` Select assistant text ──▶ Toolbar "Annotate" ──▶ Write note / save empty ──▶ Blue numbered marker + highlight ▲ │ └────────────── any number, accumulate across turns ◀────┘ │ ▼ "Annotations ×N" chip beside the input (hover to view / delete) │ Press Enter ▼ Model receives: annotation block (number + passage + note) + your question Your bubble: question only + "Annotations ×N" chip (zero flicker) Model reply: Annotation 1: … Annotation 2: … (hoverable chips) ``` ## Install (official bundle path · the only one) ```sh # Public npm package (works without an npm account) dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-xwide-annotation # Or install directly from the public GitHub source dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/XWIDE/dsh-xwide-annotation.git # local path install (development / debugging) cd /path/to/dsh-annotation dsh plugin --profile web add . # restart the web service — see "Restarting the web service" below ``` To add it only as a Node dependency in an existing project: ```sh npm install dsh-xwide-annotation ``` > `npm install` only adds the dependency; it does not register the plugin with DSH. Use `dsh plugin add` above when installing it into DSH. ### Migrating from the old `@omdsh-dev` package name If you installed the plugin before v1.4.2, remove the old dependency before installing the renamed package: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-xwide-annotation ``` If `dsh web` still fails and mentions `@omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation`, remove only the stale `dsh-annotation` entry that uses that old name from `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`. The plugin now supplies the `dsh-xwide-annotation` entry itself. | Do | Don't | |----|------| | Only `dsh plugin add` / only write `bundles` | **Never** insert the same id again in the profile/home `cordis.patch.yml` | Self-check: ```sh dsh --profile web --dump-config | rg "id: dsh-xwide-annotation" # must be exactly 1 line dsh web --no-open # open the printed one-time token URL in a browser ``` In the browser console, `window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries.find(({ id }) => id === 'dsh-xwide-annotation')` must return an entry with a `url`. dsh 0.1.2 no longer exposes the old bare per-plugin URL. ## Restarting the web service Pick the command for your platform: ```sh # macOS (launchd) launchctl kickstart -k "gui/$(id -u)/com.dsh.web" # WSL / Linux with systemd user services # The unit name may differ by install method; check with: # systemctl --user list-units | rg dsh systemctl --user restart dsh-web ``` Environments without a service manager (e.g. some containers) often need **no restart at all**: `client.js` is served per request with no caching, so a hard refresh (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R) picks up plugin changes. The self-check commands above are platform-neutral. ## Architecture notes - **Pure browser-side**: everything lives in `client.js` (a hand-written CJS bundle, no build step, served no-cache per request) - **Message format** (the literal protocol block sent to the model; follows the DSH `locale` preferen

plugins.description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness: move conversations to a trash, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-session-trash · Session Trash

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds **Move to trash** to each session's sidebar menu. Sessions are not deleted outright: they go to a trash, where you can **restore** them from Settings → Session trash, or **delete them permanently after a second confirmation**. The trash is never emptied automatically.

- DSH 0.2.x (`engines.dsh: >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`, including the 0.2.1-alpha previews)
- macOS and Linux; on Windows the plugin disables itself (the session write lock cannot be checked there)
- The official JSONL session storage only (the DSH default)

## Install

**Desktop**: open **Plugins** in the sidebar → **Add plugin**, enter one of the following, choose **Install**, then **Enable now** (a new plugin starts switched off):

- the GitHub address `https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash`, or `github:ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash#v0.2.1` for a fixed version
- the npm package name `dsh-plugin-session-trash`
- the absolute path of a local package such as `/path/to/dsh-plugin-session-trash-0.2.1.tgz` (made by `pnpm pack`)

The repository includes the built `lib/`, so a GitHub install runs no build script. If DSH cannot reach GitHub, use a network that can; the npm mirror DSH offers serves npm packages, not GitHub repositories.

Do not enter the source checkout: its `node_modules` holds development copies of DSH packages that would shadow the ones DSH runs.

**Command line** (optional): install Desktop's own `dsh` command from the application menu **Manage dsh Command…**, quit DSH completely, then run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-session-trash
```

**Remove** it from the **Plugins** page, or quit DSH and run `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-session-trash`. Sessions in the trash stay in `~/.dsh/session-trash/`; removing the plugin does not delete them.

## Use

1. In a session's "…" menu choose **Move to trash** and confirm; the session leaves the sidebar. A session opened in this run is hidden first and moves into the trash the next time DSH starts.
2. Open **Settings → Session trash**:
   - **Restore** puts the session back where it was, with its previous archive and pin state;
   - **Delete permanently** removes the local session logs after a second confirmation;
   - **Empty trash** deletes every entry after confirmation, stopping at the first failure.

## Safety

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Sessions in use are never moved | Running work (a turn, subagents, background jobs, schedules) refuses the move; so does a session another DSH process writes (its `session.lock` is held) |
| Opened sessions move at the next start | An idle session opened in this run is hidden at once (the official archive) and moves into the trash at the next DSH start, before any session opens; every check still applies then, and a move that cannot run waits for the following start. You can cancel it on the trash page meanwhile |
| Move, never copy | Moving to and from the trash is a same-volume `rename`; a trash on another volume refuses |
| No recursive removal | Permanent deletion unlinks only the files DSH writes in a session directory (log generations, publish temporaries, `session.lock`) and removes directories with non-recursive `rmdir`; any other file refuses the whole deletion |
| Path checks | Entry ids must be UUIDs; session directories and their parents must be plain directories (no symbolic links) that resolve inside the session root; the trash must not be inside the session root |
| Crash safety | A move is prepared in `.staging-<id>` and published by one rename; an interrupted move is rolled back at the next start |
| Authenticated calls | The browser calls through DSH's `/api` gateway (Typert Remote, connection-authenticated); no unauthenticated HTTP route is registered |
| Official APIs | Hiding and restoring use the registry's `archiveSession` / `unarchiveSession` / `pinSession`; DSH's own storage is never rewritten |

Subagent sessions move and restore with their parent; forks are independent conversations and stay. Project folders and workspace files are never touched.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trashDirectory` | `<DSH home>/session-trash` | Trash directory; outside the session root and on the same volume |

## Permanent deletion is local only

**Delete permanently** removes the copies on this machine. It cannot reach what DSH has already sent to DeepSeek:

- With the official DeepSeek API, DSH uploads the session log along with each request by default (the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek` plugin). Turning off **Settings → General → Upload Session Log when using the official model API** stops later uploads only; turning it back on also uploads what was recorded while it was off.
- Images sent to the official API are uploaded as files that DSH asks DeepSeek to expire after 7 days; DSH does not guarantee their remote deletion.

This plugin makes no network requests and sends nothing anywhere.

## Known limitations

- A session opened in this run moves into the trash only at the next DSH start (a plugin cannot safely release the write ownership DSH holds); until then it is hidden.
- Only session log directories are handled; attachments, caches, and spill files other features keep for a session stay where they are (see the Attachment Library below for attachment usage).
- Relies on the DSH 0.2.x JSONL directory layout; re-verify after a DSH major upgrade.

## Related plugin

**[Attachment Library · dsh-plugin-attachment-library](https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library)**: Session Trash handles session logs only; the images and files attached in conversations stay on this machine. Attachment Library is a read-only page (Settings → Attachment Library) that lists how much space every attachment takes and which conversations still use it, including those in the trash, and can show a file in Finder or open an image in Preview. With both plugins installed, the library counts conversations in the trash too.

Install: in **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `github:ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library#v0.4.1`.

## Develop

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test        # builds lib/ then runs every test
```

`lib/` is committed so a GitHub install can use it directly; after changing sources run `pnpm run build` and commit `lib/` with them.

The client tests render the real 0.2.0-rc.2 UI components from unmodified MIT-licensed source copies in `tests/vendor/ui-primitives` (tag `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2`; see `tests/primitives-shim.ts`), because the published component build only runs inside the DSH page; no DSH source checkout is needed. Tests run against the DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 packages published on npm: real JSONL session storage, the real Workspace registry, and the real Typert gateway, with sessions generated in temporary directories.

plugins.description: A local, model-readable knowledge-base plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Vector generation mode that supports local, LLM enhancement and external API integration. Support the import of text files, PDFs and Office files. Also support multi-user management, content encryption and access to MCP tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-knowledge-base-local

[简体中文](README.zh.md) | English

A local, model-readable knowledge-base plugin for **DeepSeek Harness** (DSH). It stores everything as plain Markdown you can open in any editor, and gives three independent ways in — agent tools, a CLI, and a Web settings panel — plus PDF/Office text extraction, an MCP server for external clients, at-rest AES-256-GCM encryption and role-based multi-user access.

Three design goals:

1. **You own the location** — any absolute path, changeable at any time.
2. **Any model can read it** — Markdown *is* the data; no lock-in.
3. **Store anything** — text, Markdown, code, web pages, any binary attachment; chunked and vectorised automatically.

> Zero runtime dependencies: Node built-ins only. Nothing to compile on install.

---

## Contents

- [dsh-knowledge-base-local](#dsh-knowledge-base-local)
  - [Contents](#contents)
  - [Install](#install)
  - [Quick start](#quick-start)
  - [Features](#features)
  - [Agent tools](#agent-tools)
  - [CLI](#cli)
  - [PDF / Office extraction](#pdf--office-extraction)
  - [MCP server](#mcp-server)
  - [Encryption \& multi-user](#encryption--multi-user)
  - [Bulk \& full delete](#bulk--full-delete)
  - [Web panel](#web-panel)
  - [Storage layout](#storage-layout)
  - [Configuration](#configuration)
  - [Vector modes](#vector-modes)
  - [Retrieval scoring](#retrieval-scoring)
  - [Security model](#security-model)
  - [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
  - [Development \& tests](#development--tests)
  - [Uninstall](#uninstall)
  - [License](#license)

---

## Install

Requires Node.js ≥ 22 and a running DeepSeek Harness.

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-knowledge-base-local
```

## Quick start

1. Open **Settings → Knowledge base** and pick a folder, or tell the agent *"set my knowledge base to /path/to/knowledge"*.
2. Or from the CLI:

   ```
   node kb.mjs config --root /path/to/knowledge
   ```

The chosen root and every preference live in the per-user data directory (default `~/.dsh`):

```
<DSH_HOME>/knowledge-base/settings.json
```

That file is independent of the current workspace and profile, so your knowledge base follows you between projects and is not lost when a profile changes.

## Features

- **Markdown as the source of truth** — each document is `docs/<id>.md` with frontmatter; a generated `CATALOG.md` gives models and humans a table of contents.
- **Six agent tools** — `kb_search`, `kb_read`, `kb_list`, `kb_add`, `kb_import`, `kb_manage`.
- **Hybrid retrieval** — BM25 lexical + vector cosine + title/substring bonus; results carry document id, line numbers and a snippet.
- **Three vector modes** — `local` (offline TF-IDF feature hashing), `llm` (model enrichment + local vectors), `api` (OpenAI-compatible embeddings, falls back to local on failure).
- **Collections & tags** — namespace multiple knowledge bases; scope any query.
- **Trash & versions** — delete is soft (recoverable); every edit keeps a version (20 by default).
- **Inbox watcher** — files dropped into `<root>/inbox/` are imported automatically and updated on change (PDF/Office included).
- **URL import** — fetches readable page text (prefers Harness's `web` service).
- **PDF / Office text extraction** — `.pdf` `.docx` `.xlsx` `.pptx`, zero dependencies. [Details](#pdf--office-extraction).
- **MCP server** — expose the library to Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP client over stdio or Streamable HTTP. [Details](#mcp-server).
- **At-rest encryption** — AES-256-GCM per document; the passphrase only wraps a random data key via a scrypt-derived KEK. [Details](#encryption--multi-user).
- **Multi-user access** — `owner > admin > editor > reader`, per-collection narrowing, and SHA-256-hashed API tokens. Off by default (single-user). [Details](#encryption--multi-user).

## Agent tools

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `kb_search` | Hybrid retrieval; `collection`, `tags`, `limit`, `mode` |
| `kb_read` | Read a document in full, or by line range / chunk |
| `kb_list` | Browse documents, collections and stats |
| `kb_add` | Store text / a local file / a URL; automatic de-duplication |
| `kb_import` | Recursively import a folder or a single file/web page (runs PDF/Office extraction) |
| `kb_manage` | status / configure / collection / update / delete / restore / purge / reindex / scan / export, **and** security operations: `security_status`, `enable_encryption`, `disable_encryption`, `unlock`, `lock`, `change_passphrase`, `rotate_key`, `set_metadata_encryption`, `reencrypt`, `rbac_enable`, `rbac_disable`, `user_*`, `grant`, `revoke`, `token_issue`, `token_revoke`, `mcp_info`, `bulk_delete`, `empty_trash`, `wipe` |

Every turn, the agent sees a short system-prompt section with the root, scale, collections and usage — it updates whenever the store changes. You never need to paste the path into a conversation.

> **Passphrase privacy.** A passphrase typed to the agent travels in the session log. Prefer entering it in the Web panel (Settings → Knowledge base → Security); `kb_manage`'s `passphrase` argument is the convenience path, not the private one.

## CLI

Run from anywhere in the package (or via the installed `dsh-kb` bin):

```
node kb.mjs status
node kb.mjs search "hybrid retrieval" --limit 5
node kb.mjs read <id> --offset 1 --limit 120
node kb.mjs add --title "Title" --text "Body" --collection notes --tags a,b
node kb.mjs add --file /path/notes/todo.md
node kb.mjs import /path/Notes --collection notes
node kb.mjs import /path/Papers/report.pdf --collection papers   # body extracted
node kb.mjs reindex --full
node kb.mjs export --format md
node kb.mjs security          # encryption / multi-user state and on-disk coverage
node kb.mjs unlock            # reads DSH_KB_PASSPHRASE or --passphrase
node kb.mjs lock
node kb.mjs users             # users, collection grants, tokens
node kb.mjs mcp               # how to connect an external MCP client
node kb.mjs --json status     # machine-readable
```

Global flags: `--root <dir>` (one-shot override), `--json`. `kb.mjs` shares the same `src/` as the plugin and needs no running Harness. While the library is encrypted and locked, commands fail loudly with "locked" rather than emitting garbage — unlock first (`node kb.mjs unlock` or `DSH_KB_PASSPHRASE`).

## PDF / Office extraction

Detection is magic-bytes first, extension second. Everything degrades gracefully — a file that cannot be parsed is kept as an attachment with the reason recorded, never silently dropped.

| Format | Supported | On failure |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.pdf` | objects + xref (incl. object streams), `FlateDecode`, content-stream ops `Tj/TJ '/"/T*/Td/Tm`, simple fonts (Standard/WinAnsi + `/Differences`), Type0/CID with `/ToUnicode` (CJK), `/Info` title, page count | scanned images / encrypted → attachment + placeholder + reason |
| `.docx` | paragraphs, heading levels, lists, tables, sections, `docProps` title | missing part → error + attachment |
| `.xlsx` | multiple sheets, shared strings (rich runs included), inline strings; formulas are not evaluated | empty sheet skipped |
| `.pptx` | title/body/notes per slide, sorted by slide number | no slide part → invalid |
| `.doc/.xls/.ppt` | legacy OLE is **not** parsed | clear "re-save as docx/xlsx/pptx" message, attachment kept |

Extraction results are recorded in each document's `extract` field (`kind`, `pages`, `warnings`, failure reason) and shown in the panel and `kb_list`. Body gets a `> extracted from report.pdf (pdf · 12 pages)` header for provenance. The size cap is `import.maxFileBytes` (8 MiB by default).

## MCP server

```bash
# stdio (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cherry Studio …), no running Harness required:
node mcp-stdio.mjs
node mcp-stdio.mjs --root /path/to/knowledge --readonly
node mcp-stdio.mjs --help

# standalone Streamable HTTP:
node mcp-stdio.mjs --http 8765 --token kb_…

# in-process endpoint inside Harness (same origin as the Web GUI):
POST http://127.0.0.1:<gui-port>/kb-mcp
```

Client config (stdio):

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "knowledge-base": {
  "command": "node",
  "args": ["/absolute/path/to/dsh-knowledge-base-local/mcp-stdio.mjs"]
} } }
```

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 鲸鱼跳跃小游戏 / whale jump plugin
plugins.readme_text:
- 🌐 [English](README.en.md) ｜ 简体中文

# DSH 小鲸鱼跳（dsh-whale-jump）

![小鲸鱼跳](assets/whale-hero.png)

DeepSeek Harness 等回复时的小游戏挂件：对话流下方一行轻量入口，点开是 canvas 跑酷小游戏（跳跃 / 下潜 / 氧气 / 计分 / 最高分），**纯本地、零依赖、不联网**。

> 代码部分 MIT 许可（见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)）；`assets/` 美术素材不在 MIT 范围内，来源与权利状态见 [`PROVENANCE.md`](PROVENANCE.md)。

## 特性

### 入口与状态

- 🐳 **一行入口**：注册在 `conversation.input.dock` 插槽，**空状态页和对话中都会渲染**，一处注册覆盖两个场景
- 🔔 **三态文案**：新会话空状态页 → **🐳 小鲸鱼跳**；空闲对话 → 🐳 等太久了？先玩个小游戏~；宿主已跑 20 秒以上 → 🐳 还在跑…要不要来一局？（**提亮并开始摆动**）
- 🌫️ **不打扰**：这行字平时很淡，等待越久越显眼，共用同一个插槽组件，不重复注册

### 玩法

- 🏝️ **三层空间**：露出水面的珊瑚 / 漂浮木要**跃过**（按住跳更高）；**灯塔**（128px 高）和海鸥要**下潜**；沉在水下的水母要**留在水面**
- 🗼 **灯塔跳不过去**：最高速下跳跃峰值 107.7px，灯塔顶部在 74px——唯一必须下潜的障碍；下潜到 -45 以下可完全躲开
- 🎈 **开局水母更密集**：开局 25 秒内水母权重 ×3（占比约 **34%**），之后回落到约 14%
- 🫧 **氧气系统**：满氧可连续下潜 4 秒，从空回满需 8 秒；耗尽**强制上浮**并锁定下潜，回到 30% 才解锁；低于 50% 氧气条转橙、低于 25% 转红并脉动
- 🎮 **操作**：空格 / ↑ / 点击 = 跳跃（按住跳更高）；↓ = 下潜（空中按下 = 急坠）；Esc = 退出；结束后空格或按钮重开

### 交互与手感

- ⏱️ **帧率无关**：位移统一 `× dt/16.67`，60fps 与 144fps 位移误差 <0.01%
- 🤗 **宽容碰撞**：碰撞盒比绘制范围窄（44%），贴边蹭过不算撞
- 📏 **公平间距**：`gap = w×speed + 72`，随速度放大，高速时给同样的反应时间
- 🪜 **难度阶梯**：障碍高度 24/30/44/58px 四档，轻点可过最低档，最高档必须按住
- ↔️ **动作冲突保护**：相邻障碍要求相反动作时，间距再 ×1.7，避免来不及切换

### 语言

- 🌐 **跟随 DSH 语言设置**：首选 `ctx.locale` 服务（「设置 → 通用 → 语言」），退回 `<html lang>` 与 `navigator.languages`，最后落到简体中文
- ⚡ **切换即时生效**：文案表挂在 `Proxy` 上读取时才解析语言，入口行订阅 locale 变更事件，切完立即重渲染，**不需要重建任何东西**
- 🛡️ **优雅降级**：语言服务缺席时插件照常工作（走浏览器推断），不会因为缺依赖挂掉

### 美术与实现

- 🎨 **程序化动画**：只有一张正面立绘、没有跑动帧——上下浮动、起跳拉长 / 下落压扁（squash & stretch）、下潜前倾随深度变淡、落水水花粒子全部由代码表现
- 🖼️ **立绘兜底**：立绘加载失败时退化成**代码绘制的鲸鱼**，任何情况下画面里都有主角
- 🧱 **珊瑚、漂浮木、灯塔、海鸥、水母、云、气泡、波纹、音效全部代码现画 / 现合成**，不引用任何第三方素材
- 🔌 **官方注入通道**：走 DSH 官方 client module 通道（`dsh.client` + `exports["./client"]`），由 DSH 模块系统在 `/plugins/dsh-whale-jump/client.js` 下发加载，**完全不碰 index.html**，绕开桌面端 `script-src` 注入失败连坐整个 boot 的坑
- 🔒 **安全边界**：状态写接口（POST）**只接受回环来源**，非本机一律 403；请求体上限 8KB，分数范围校验；不读写凭据、不联网、不碰 profile 配置

## 目录结构

```text
dsh-whale-jump/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client + files 白名单
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 挂载声明
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          # 宿主侧：状态路由（GET/POST）+ 立绘路由 + 诊断
│   └── client.js         # 客户端侧：入口行组件 + 游戏引擎 + 浮层（无构建步骤）
├── assets/
│   ├── whale-hero.png    # 角色立绘（透明底）
│   └── whale-icon.png    # 插件列表图标
├── docs/
│   └── miniwhale-source.jpg  # 角色原图（来源存档，不参与运行）
├── _study/               # 开发工具：测试套件 / 抠图 / 预览渲染 / 校准
│   ├── test-*.cjs        # 8 个测试套件，共 128 项
│   ├── make_assets.py    # 由原图生成 assets/（可复现字节一致）
│   └── dino-game-study.md# 恐龙游戏机制的学习笔记
├── .github/workflows/test.yml  # CI：语法检查 + 全部测试
├── PROVENANCE.md         # 素材来源与许可范围
├── LICENSE                # MIT（仅代码）
└── README.md
```

**没有构建步骤**：`lib/client.js` 是手写的、DSH 客户端模块系统可直接消费的格式，仓库里没有打包配置，clone 下来就能用。

## 安装

同一份代码支持两种官方形态，装法只差 profile 名：

| | Web（`dsh web`，浏览器 UI） | 桌面端（Electron 客户端） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| profile | `web` | `desktop` |
| 安装 | `dsh plugin --profile web add "<源>"` | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<源>"` |
| 启动 | `dsh web` 后打开它打印的地址 | 直接打开客户端 |
| 前置条件 | `dsh` 在 PATH 上 | **先完整启动一次桌面客户端，再完全退出** |

> 桌面端缺少「开机一次」这一步时，`dsh plugin --profile desktop` 会以这个错误退出：`Open DeepSeek Harness Desktop once to initialize its profile, then fully quit it before running dsh plugin --profile desktop.` 这不是插件的问题，是桌面端的 profile 由客户端首次启动时生成。

### 方式 A：从 npm 安装（最简单）

**Web：**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-whale-jump
dsh web
```

**桌面端：**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-whale-jump
```

### 方式 B：从 GitHub 安装（想跟 main 分支走时用）

**Web：**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:CharlieChang1216/dsh-whale-jump"
dsh web
```

**桌面端：**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:CharlieChang1216/dsh-whale-jump"
```

固定版本（`<tag>` 换成 Releases 里的标签，例如 `v0.1.1`）把源写成 `github:CharlieChang1216/dsh-whale-jump#v0.1.1` 即可，两种形态同理。

首次从 GitHub 安装要 clone 整个仓库，网络慢时 pnpm 会先报几次 `HEAD https://github.com/... ETIMEDOUT` 再重试成功（实测约 2 分钟），属正常现象。

### 方式 C：本地开发安装（软链，改源码即时生效）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:<你的仓库路径>"
# 或
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:<你的仓库路径>"
```

装完**完全退出客户端（含系统托盘）再重新打开**；Web 形态则是重启 `dsh web`。`link:` 是软链安装，改源码即时生效（宿主侧改动需重启），但**不要移动仓库目录**，移动后要重新 `add` 一次。

### 给 AI 的安装说明

- 本插件是标准 DSH bundle 插件，`main` 为 `lib/index.js`，靠 `cordis.patch.yml` 挂载、`exports["./client"]` 下发前端，**不需要构建**。
- 桌面端若命令行安装被拒（注入链只支持一次性收集、`dsh plugin` 需要 pnpm 在 PATH 上），请改用**桌面端会话里的内置 `plugin_manager`**，来源填 `https://github.com/CharlieChang1216/dsh-whale-jump`。
- 运行时数据写在 `$DSH_HOME/.dshwj-state.json`（最高分、局数），不碰 profile、不碰 node_modules（可能只读）。

## 兼容与运行要求

| 项目 | 要求 | 实测环境 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DSH | **≥ 0.2.0** | 桌面端 `0.2.1-rc.2`（同版本 CLI） |
| Node.js | **≥ 20**（仅跑测试需要，插件本身零依赖） | `24.19.0` / `24.21.0` |
| pnpm | `dsh plugin` 内部使用，需在 PATH 上 | `11.28.5` |
| 操作系统 | 无平台特定 API | Windows 11 x64（macOS / Linux 未实测） |
| 浏览器 | 需要 Canvas 2D；`backdrop-filter` 可选（不支持只是背景不模糊） | Chromium / Edge |

**为什么是 DSH ≥ 0.2.0**：插件用到了 `dsh.client` 客户端模块通道（`/plugins/<id>/client.js`）、`conversation.input.dock` 插槽、`locale` 服务与 `webServer` 服务注册路由。实测环境是 `0.2.1-rc.2`；0.2.0 系列预期可用，0.1.x 未做验证，不做承诺。

**无需 `npm install`、无需构建、无运行时依赖**：`lib/client.js` 是手写的 DSH 客户端模块格式，`lib/index.js` 只用 Node 内置模块（`node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:url` / `node:os`）。

## 验证

```powershell
# 1) 插件已登记（桌面端把 web 换成 desktop）
Select-String -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\package.json" -Pattern "dsh-whale-jump"

# 2) 宿主路由活着。端口每次启动都可能变——以 `dsh web` 打印的地址或客户端窗口地址栏为准
$port = 52135   # 换成你实际看到的端口

curl "http://127.0.0.1:$port/dsh-whale-jump/diag"       # 诊断：版本 / 立绘状态 / 最近错误
curl "http://127.0.0.1:$port/dsh-whale-jump/state"      # → {"best":0,"plays":0}
curl -o hero.png "http://127.0.0.1:$port/dsh-whale-jump/hero.png"

# 3) 状态文件
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\.dshwj-state.json"
```

游戏里拿到分后，`state` 的 `best`/`plays` 会变——这是确认「路由 + 前端 + 落盘」整条链路都通的最终证据。

## 常见问题

**路由返回空的 400**

宿主把 handler 抛出的异常吞成了 `400` 空响应，真实原因记在 `/dsh-whale-jump/diag` 的 `heroError` / `lastError`（该接口仅回环可读）。这个坑实际踩过一次（2026-10 的 `/hero.png` 恒定 400 就是靠它定位的）。

**改了 `lib/index.js` 但没生效**

宿主侧代码**不热重载**，必须完全退出客户端（含系统托盘）再重开。`lib/client.js` 是热读的，改完刷新页面即可。

**移动/改名了仓库目录，角色变成一只代码画的蓝色小鲸鱼**

宿主在加载插件时就把包根路径（`PACKAGE_ROOT`）固化了，之后读立绘还在用旧路径，于是 `/hero.png` 返回 404，前端退化成内置的兜底鲸鱼。修法：

```powershell
# 1) 把软链指向新目录（junction 而不是拷贝，才不会丢实时生效）
Remove-Item "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-whale-jump" -Force
New-Item -ItemType Junction -Target "<新路径>" -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-whale-jump"

# 2) 改 profile/package.json 里的 link: 路径，否则下次 pnpm install 会指回去
# 3) 完全退出客户端再重开
```

判断是否已生效：`/dsh-whale-jump/diag` 的 `hero.exists` 应该从 `false` 变 `true`。

**陈旧进程假象**

如果宿主进程还在跑旧版 `lib/index.js`，新加的路由会 404、改过的路由可能返回空 400。这不是代码缺陷，重启即好。第一次部署时 `/hero.png` 恒定 400 就是这个原因。**移动目录不需要重新 `add`，但一定需要重启**：软链改了只解决「包能不能被找到」，包根路径是进程启动时算好的，不重启不会重新计算。

## 开发与维护

- 测试只用 Node 内置模块（`node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:vm`），**不需要 `npm install`**：

```bash
npm test          # 跑全部 8 个套件（128 项）
npm run test:engine
npm run test:oxygen
```

- CI（GitHub Actions，Node 20/22 矩阵）在每次 push / PR 时跑语法检查 + 全部测试 + 清单自检，本地与 CI 用同一组脚本。
- 运行时数据：`$DSH_HOME/.dshwj-state.json`（最高分、局数）。
- **版本号规则**：`0.1.x`，`x` 等于已发布的次数——第 1 次发布是 `0.1.1`，第 2 次是 `0.1.2`，`0.1.0` 保留为发布前的初始 tag。每次打 tag 前先改 `package.json` 的 `version`，再 `git tag v0.1.x && git push --tags`。

## 致谢

- 玩法机制参考了 Chromium T-Rex Runner（BSD-3-Clause）的公开设计（不受版权保护的规则/方法层），**代码全部重写**，不含其任何代码或美术素材；机制学习笔记见 `_study/dino-game-study.md`。

## 许可证

- **代码**：MIT（见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)）。
- **美术素材**（`assets/`、`docs/`）不在 MIT 覆盖范围内，来源与权利状态见 [`PROVENANCE.md`](PROVENANCE.md)：角色立绘为第三方用户发布的 AI 生成 DeepSeek 鲸鱼形象二创（原发布者声明可自由使用），插件里只做背景抠图与缩放，未做任何重绘。
